hindi: साफ़ नीयत से — कोई छिपाव नहीं
definition: completely honest, hiding nothing, every arrangement visible where anybody could inspect
example: He insisted the sale stay above board, showing every receipt to both families before anybody signed anything.

hindi: झगड़े से ऊपर — विवाद में शामिल न होना
definition: remaining calmly neutral, refusing involvement while others quarrel bitterly beneath you
example: The headmistress stayed above the fray during the parents' shouting match, waiting until everyone tired before speaking softly.

hindi: आस्तीन में इक्का — छिपा हुआ बचाव का पत्ता
definition: hidden advantage kept quietly in reserve, protecting you until the situation turns dangerous
example: Everyone thought the team was finished until the coach sent on the substitute he had kept as an ace up his sleeve.

hindi: आग में घी डालना — गुस्से को और भड़काना
definition: worsen existing annoyance deliberately, saying something certain to inflame greater anger
example: Reminding them who had lost the keys only added fuel to the fire, so their neighbour quietly made everyone tea instead.

hindi: जले पर नमक — चोट पर अपमान
definition: worsening existing trouble deliberately, adding humiliation onto someone already suffering painful visible damage
example: Losing the match stung, and the trophy photograph pinned outside their gate added insult to injury until somebody removed it.

hindi: चिड़िया चुग गई खेत — नुकसान के बाद सावधानी
definition: acting sensibly only after damage happened, taking precautions once every chance prevent trouble disappeared
example: The society installed cameras after the horse had bolted, three weeks past the night both scooters vanished.

hindi: तमाम मुश्किलों के बावजूद कामयाबी हासिल करना
definition: succeeding despite hopeless chances and narrow prospects, when almost nobody expected victory
example: Against all odds, the village library reopened, funded entirely by wedding-season donations.

hindi: घड़ी से होड़ — समय-सीमा से पहले पूरा करने की दौड़
definition: working hurriedly toward a deadline, racing to finish before limited time expires
example: The bakers worked against the clock all night so the wedding cake would reach the hall by morning.

hindi: सबसे आगे — दूसरों से पहले तैयार
definition: holding early advantage, prepared position ahead of rivals before serious competition begins
example: She revised through the summer holidays and stayed ahead of the game while everybody else panicked through November.

hindi: किसी की निजी बात सबके सामने रखना — पर्दा उठा देना
definition: reveal another person's private matters publicly, broadcasting gossip details they wanted hidden
example: Ravi aired his brother's business in front of the whole wedding party, and their mother changed the subject to the caterer's paneer.

hindi: घर की बात बाज़ार में लाना — पारिवारिक झगड़े सबके सामने
definition: discuss shameful family quarrels publicly, embarrassing relatives instead of hiding private matters
example: Uncle began airing the dirty laundry between courses, and his sister quietly refilled everyone's glasses until the subject drifted toward cricket.

hindi: हवाई जहाज़ मोड — दुनिया से कटकर सुकून
definition: deliberately unreachable condition, ignoring every message and notification until calmness slowly returns
example: Sunday afternoons became airplane mode for the whole household, and the neighbours learned to knock instead.

hindi: घंटी बजना — भीतर चेतावनी महसूस होना
definition: sudden warning feeling arrives about somebody's behaviour, suggesting hidden trouble ahead
example: Alarm bells rang when he refused to introduce anybody from his family, though she waited politely before deciding.

hindi: सिर चकराना — कुछ भी समझ में न आना
definition: completely confused about events, unable to understand the situation happening around you
example: Handed the ledger on her first morning, Priya sat all at sea, turning pages that seemed written in another language.

hindi: पूरी तरह सजी-धजी — बनाव-सिंगार करके
definition: dressed prettily with careful grooming, wearing party clothes rather than ordinary everyday things
example: The twins were all dolled up an hour early, sitting stiffly on the sofa so nothing would crease.

hindi: काला अक्षर भैंस बराबर — कुछ भी पल्ले न पड़ना
definition: completely incomprehensible language, an explanation that leaves the listener unable to understand anything whatsoever
example: The tax form was all Greek to him, so he took it to the neighbour who reads such things for pleasure.

hindi: सब मिलकर जुट जाना — हर हाथ काम पर
definition: situation demanding everyone helping together urgently, nobody excused during serious crisis
example: With relatives arriving before dawn it became all hands on deck, cousins peeling vegetables while grandmother directed traffic from her chair.

hindi: बातों का शेर — कहने में शेर, करने में ढेर
definition: someone loudly boastful whose empty talk never becomes action carrying real substance
example: He promised to fix the fence every Sunday; all mouth and no trousers, said my aunt.

hindi: ऊँची दुकान फीका पकवान — दिखावा ज़्यादा, दम कम
definition: impressive surface presentation covering complete absence of real substance underneath the confident display
example: The new restaurant was all sizzle and no steak, with copper lamps everywhere and cold rice underneath them.

term: all your eggs in one basket
hindi: एक ही जगह पूरा दाँव लगाना — जोखिम बिल्कुल न बाँटना
definition: every resource concentrated inside single risky choice, leaving nothing protected against sudden failure
example: Papa spread the savings between three schemes, muttering that only fools keep all their eggs in one basket.

hindi: मुफ़्त की सवारी — बिना मेहनत किए साथ चलते रहना
definition: present without contributing, avoiding work that other people quietly carry while enjoying benefits
example: Three cousins cooked the whole feast while the fourth, purely along for the ride, tasted everything.

hindi: अपने पापों का हिसाब देना — जवाबदेही आख़िर आती है
definition: face questioning about past wrongdoing, forced eventually toward consequences nobody escapes
example: Twenty years later he answered for his sins across a kitchen table, quietly, with tea going cold between them.

hindi: पैरों में चींटियाँ — बेचैनी से इधर-उधर हिलते रहना
definition: restless fidgeting, nervous excitement making anybody wriggle instead sitting quietly
example: The child had ants in his pants all through the ceremony, so his uncle quietly walked him around the courtyard twice.

hindi: डूबते को तिनके का सहारा — मुश्किल में जो मिले वही सही
definition: shelter accepted gratefully during trouble, however unsuitable, because desperate people cannot choose
example: The station waiting room was hardly comfortable, but any port in a storm, and the chai seller kept refilling their cups.

hindi: कुछ कहा नहीं जा सकता — नतीजे का किसी को अंदाज़ा नहीं
definition: completely uncertain outcome that nobody predicts confidently, chance weighing possibilities evenly against each other
example: Whether the monsoon would arrive before the wedding was anybody's guess, so they hired the tent anyway.

hindi: आँखों का तारा — सबसे प्यारा इंसान
definition: person cherished above everyone else, watched constantly with helpless proud tenderness
example: The youngest granddaughter was clearly the apple of his eye, receiving both slices of guava without argument.

hindi: बैठे-बैठे नुक्ताचीनी करनेवाला — खुद कुछ न करके सिर्फ़ आलोचना करना
definition: person judging difficult work confidently while never attempting anything themselves
example: The armchair critic explained exactly how the roof should be tiled, then declined the ladder when somebody politely offered it.

hindi: सिर पर आ जाना — बहुत जल्द होने वाला
definition: expected extremely soon, arriving shortly after months spent waiting patiently
example: Grandmother kept the sweets tin sealed because the wedding season was around the corner, and every grandchild knew better than to argue.

hindi: मुसीबत मोल लेना — खुद खतरे को बुलावा देना
definition: behaving in a dangerous manner that keeps inviting serious harm steadily closer
example: Leaving the cake unguarded with three cousins and a Labrador in the room was asking for trouble.

hindi: दोराहे पर खड़ा होना — निर्णय की घड़ी
definition: facing an important decision, standing between separate directions your future might take
example: Standing at a crossroads between medicine and music, Anil spent the monsoon playing harmonium and eventually chose both.

hindi: चींटी की चाल — बेहद धीमी रफ़्तार से
definition: moving painfully slowly, making progress that seems barely visible over long hours
example: The holiday traffic crawled at a snail's pace, so they sang every song they knew twice and invented terrible new verses.

hindi: सरपट दौड़ना — गर्दन टूटने की हद तक तेज़ रफ़्तार
definition: moving forward extremely quickly, fast enough that carelessness becomes genuinely dangerous
example: She took the mountain road at breakneck speed, and even the goats on the verge looked faintly disapproving.

hindi: आमने-सामने की ग़लतफ़हमी — एक कुछ समझे, दूसरा कुछ और
definition: people misunderstanding each other completely, quietly working toward different intentions
example: She was packing for the picnic while he cancelled it; they spent the whole morning at cross purposes.

hindi: मौत के मुँह में होना — मरने के कगार पर पहुँचना
definition: gravely unwell and close to death, barely holding onto life through severe illness
example: The puppy arrived at the shelter at death's door, and three weeks later she was stealing socks from the laundry basket.

hindi: आमने-सामने — कट्टर मतभेद में उलझे हुए
definition: locked into bitter dispute with opposing sides stubbornly refusing every possible compromise
example: The two housing societies stayed at loggerheads for months over a single shared mango tree.

hindi: हक्का-बक्का रह जाना — कुछ भी समझ में न आना
definition: feeling utterly lost and unaware, lacking the knowledge needed to follow what surrounds you
example: On his first morning in the new city he stood at the crossing completely at sea, holding a map printed in another alphabet.

hindi: अस्त-व्यस्त — सब गड्डमड्ड
definition: thoroughly disordered and confused (British), everything scattered without proper arrangement
example: The kitchen stood at sixes and sevens before the festival, until Amma assigned everyone exactly what tasks belonged where.

term: at the drop of a hat
hindi: बात की बात में — बिना सोचे तुरंत तैयार हो जाना
definition: responding instantly, without hesitation, willing to leave within moments whenever someone merely suggests going
example: Uncle Ravi will drive anyone to the station at the drop of a hat, even at four in the morning.

term: at the end of your tether
hindi: सब्र का बाँध टूटना — ताक़त और धीरज ख़त्म
definition: exhausted and unable to endure more, with patience and remaining energy entirely spent
example: By the fourth teething night both parents were at the end of their tether, laughing helplessly.

hindi: उँगलियों पर होना — हर जानकारी तुरंत हाज़िर
definition: remembering every detail instantly, keeping useful knowledge available without searching records
example: The old librarian kept every shelf number at his fingertips, so nobody ever bothered with the catalogue.

hindi: हाथ-पाँव फूल जाना — कोई उपाय ही न सूझना
definition: exhausted past patience, strength finished, unable to invent another remedy before complete collapse arrives
example: Three nights of teething and Sameer was at his wits' end, rocking the pram around the balcony at four in the morning.

hindi: चारों खाने चित कर देना — ऐसा किया कि कहने लायक कुछ बचा नहीं
definition: performed flawlessly, delivering complete excellence nobody watching afterwards could criticise anywhere
example: Her closing speech ate and left no crumbs, and the judges simply looked toward each other, already agreeing.

hindi: जा अपना सिर धो — बकवास सुनने से इनकार
definition: dismissing somebody scornfully in Scottish usage, declaring their argument deserves nothing further
example: When the stranger explained football to her, granny said away and boil your head, then poured him another cup anyway.

hindi: ख़यालों में गुम — दुनिया से बेख़बर
definition: dreamily distracted in Irish usage, drifting through conversation without noticing anything
example: She was away with the fairies through the entire meeting, watching rain crawl down the window while everybody argued about parking.

hindi: अपना उल्लू सीधा करना — छिपी नाराज़गी या स्वार्थ
definition: private resentment shaping somebody's argument, carried quietly through several later years
example: Everyone listened politely, but the retired teacher clearly had an axe to grind about the library committee.

hindi: दूध पीता बच्चा — दुनिया की चालाकी से अनजान
definition: somebody charmingly unaware of danger, lacking knowledge that experience normally teaches about dishonest people
example: He handed over the deposit without reading anything, a babe in the woods among landlords who had seen every trick.

hindi: मौत के मुँह से लौटना — गंभीर हालत से बचकर स्वस्थ होना
definition: recovered from critical condition where death seemed almost certain, surviving against medical expectation
example: The nurses still talk about the patient who came back from the brink and later returned with sweets for the whole ward.

hindi: बिल्कुल दूर-दराज़ इलाका — जहाँ बस्ती ही नहीं
definition: somewhere extremely remote in Australian usage, impossibly distant from towns, shops, neighbours
example: Her cousin teaches at a school back of Bourke, where the nearest bakery sits three hours along a dirt road.

hindi: कच्चा हिसाब — मोटा अनुमान, बिना पूरी गिनती
definition: rough approximate calculation sketched quickly, accurate enough guiding immediate practical decisions
example: A back of the envelope estimate on the newspaper margin told them the tiles would cost less than expected.

hindi: फिर से आज़ाद — दोबारा रिश्ते की तलाश में
definition: romantically available again following relationship ending, openly seeking somebody fresh
example: Two aunts declared him back on the market before he had finished explaining the breakup.

hindi: फिर से पैरों पर खड़ा होना — बीमारी के बाद सामान्य होना
definition: recovering from illness enough to resume normal activity, with strength and health returning
example: By Diwali he was back on his feet, carrying the ladder up alone despite everybody's protests.

hindi: ग़लत घोड़े पर दांव लगाना — हारने वाले का साथ देना
definition: support losing contender through misjudged gamble, forfeiting resources when chosen favourite collapses badly
example: The whole street backed the wrong horse in that election, and for months nobody mentioned the posters on their gates.

hindi: फिर वहीं से शुरू — सारी मेहनत बेकार
definition: returned to the original starting position after earlier progress collapsed completely
example: The kite string snapped twice, sending them back to square one, until his sister brought fresh thread from downstairs.

hindi: नए सिरे से योजना — पहली कोशिश नाकाम
definition: returning toward fresh planning because earlier attempt failed, starting whole design again
example: When the cardboard rocket folded during launch, the children went back to the drawing board with tape and fresh confidence.

hindi: तारीफ़ के पर्दे में ताना — मीठी बात में छिपा कटाक्ष
definition: praise disguising insult underneath, seemingly kindly remark carrying quiet criticism about someone
example: Telling her she looked rested was a backhanded compliment, and she smiled thinly while passing the sweets along.

hindi: पीछे बैठकर हिदायत देने वाला — बिना ज़िम्मेदारी सलाह
definition: an American phrase for somebody offering constant criticism about decisions while carrying none of the actual responsibility
example: Grandma rode along as cheerful backseat driver, announcing every turn three streets before anybody needed the warning.

hindi: मनमुटाव — पुरानी दुश्मनी की कड़वाहट
definition: lasting bitter hostility between opposing people whose earlier dispute never properly healed
example: There was bad blood between the bakeries since the day one copied the other's birthday cake design.

hindi: लालच देकर पलट जाना — दिखाया कुछ, थमाया कुछ
definition: tricking eager victim with tempting false promise, then quietly substituting something noticeably worse
example: The poster advertised a sunny sea-facing room, and the hotel handed them keys to a storeroom window; classic bait and switch.

hindi: गेंद आपके पाले में — अब फैसला आपका
definition: responsibility for deciding rests entirely with you, everyone else waiting until your response arrives
example: They named their price, poured more tea, and told him gently that the ball was now in his court.

hindi: अंदाज़ का आँकड़ा — मोटा-मोटा हिसाब
definition: an American phrase for roughly approximate estimate offered from uncertain information, also heard as ballpark it
example: The plumber offered a ballpark figure over the fence, promising proper numbers once he opened the bathroom wall.

hindi: ऊपरी मरहम-पट्टी — जड़ छोड़कर बस दिखावटी इलाज
definition: shallow temporary remedy covering damage briefly while leaving underlying cause completely untreated
example: Taping the leaking pipe was a band-aid solution, and everybody knew the plumber would arrive eventually anyway.

hindi: पैसा वसूल — दाम के मुकाबले भरपूर फ़ायदा
definition: good value gained for the money spent, worth more than the modest price suggests
example: That little pressure cooker gives more bang for your buck than any gadget in the kitchen.

hindi: बिल्कुल वक़्त पर — न जल्दी न देर
definition: perfectly punctual, arriving exactly when expected, never early, never delayed
example: For once the train was bang on time, which left the whole family standing awkwardly early beside their luggage.

hindi: पूरे सबूत के साथ पकड़ा जाना — इनकार की कोई गुंजाइश नहीं
definition: caught committing wrongdoing with evidence leaving nothing deniable, British police phrasing
example: The Liverpool constable said they had him bang to rights, and the young shoplifter simply handed over the paint tins.

term: bang your head against a wall
hindi: सिर पटकना — बेनतीजा कोशिश में थकते रहना
definition: repeating effort against stubborn resistance, exhausting yourself while nothing whatever changes
example: Explaining the refund policy again felt like banging his head against a wall, politely, for hours.

hindi: आग की परीक्षा — पहला कठोर इम्तिहान
definition: first severe ordeal testing endurance, suffering harsh conditions without earlier preparation
example: Her baptism of fire was cooking dinner for nineteen relatives alone, and the daal was quietly declared perfect.

hindi: हड्डी भर ढाँचा — सिर्फ़ ज़रूरी बुनियादी हिस्सा
definition: only essential practical structure remaining, nothing decorative beyond minimum necessary parts
example: The first flat was bare bones, just mattress, kettle and a window that framed the whole restless street.

hindi: दिल खोलकर रख देना — अपने गहरे राज़ किसी अपने को बता देना
definition: confess your deepest secrets and private failings openly, offering a whole conscience to someone completely trusted
example: Two friends bared their souls on a cold station bench, missing the last train and minding it not at all.

hindi: सस्ते माल का — घटिया और सस्ता
definition: priced at remarkably little money, stocked with goods nobody expects will last very long
example: His bargain basement umbrella survived exactly one storm, and he still talks about it fondly.

hindi: ग़लत दरवाज़ा खटखटाना — ग़लत जगह तलाश करना
definition: pointless effort pursuing completely mistaken explanation, blaming wrong person entirely
example: The detective suspected the gardener, but the missing rings were under the sofa; he had been barking up the wrong tree.

hindi: मोर्चा सँभालना — आँधी आने से पहले सब कुछ बाँध लेना
definition: prepare thoroughly for approaching trouble, securing everything before hardship arrives
example: With the cyclone two days away, the whole fishing village battened down the hatches and hauled the boats inland.

hindi: दिल में मैल रखना — पुरानी कड़वाहट पाले रहना
definition: keep resentment alive across years, refusing forgiveness after remembered personal injury
example: She never bore a grudge, which is why the cousins still gathered at her house every winter without awkwardness.

hindi: फल देना — मेहनत का नतीजा मिलना
definition: produce successful results finally, patient effort flowering into visible reward after long waiting
example: Her three years of night classes began to bear fruit when the hospital letter arrived, and her father read it twice.

hindi: पीठ दिखाकर हटना — हारती हालत से जल्दी निकलना
definition: withdraw hurriedly from a losing position, abandoning your argument before further embarrassing damage arrives
example: He beat a retreat toward the kitchen the instant his mother-in-law began describing the correct thickness of chapatis.

hindi: बात घुमा-फिरा कर करना — सीधे मुद्दे पर न आना
definition: circle around an awkward truth instead of stating something plainly and directly
example: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what the doctor actually said.

hindi: तलवार से हल बनाना — लड़ाई की ताक़त बनाने में लगाना
definition: turn warlike energy toward peaceful building, converting weapons and quarrels into ordinary useful shared work
example: The two rival clubs beat their swords into ploughshares and spent the monsoon repairing the same flooded playground.

hindi: इल्ज़ाम से बरी होना — अदालत से बच निकलना
definition: escape punishment from serious charges, walking free after courtroom evidence proves insufficient
example: His uncle beat the rap over the missing shipment, celebrated with rasgullas, and never once explained where those crates went.

hindi: खुद को कोसते रहना — गलती पर बेवजह पछतावा
definition: punish yourself mentally over mistakes long finished, letting regret continue longer than anybody else expects
example: She beat herself up about the missed interview until her roommate hid the phone and poured two glasses of nimbu paani.

hindi: मरीज़ से बात करने का ढंग — डॉक्टर की सहानुभूति
definition: gentle reassuring manner shown while treating frightened patients, comforting beyond medical skill alone
example: The surgeon had terrible bedside manner but golden hands, so the ward forgave him everything except morning cheerfulness.

hindi: देखते ही देखते — पता चलने से पहले बीत जाना
definition: happening instantly, sooner than expected, finished within moments while attention wanders
example: Before you know it the mangoes will be gone, so eat one now while the afternoon is still warm.

hindi: नौसिखिए की किस्मत — पहली बार में ही जीत
definition: surprising early success achieved without skill, fortune rewarding somebody completely inexperienced instead
example: His first carrom board victory was pure beginner's luck, though he retold that evening confidently for another twenty years.

hindi: सलाखों के पीछे — जेल में बंद
definition: confined inside prison serving punishment, separated from family, freedom, ordinary daylight routines
example: Letters from behind bars arrived every Thursday, and his mother read each aloud twice before folding them away.

hindi: बंद कमरे में — सबकी नज़रों से छिपकर
definition: privately decided among selected people, hidden away from public watching attention
example: The wedding budget was settled behind closed doors, and the rest of the family learned about it from the caterer.

hindi: पिछड़ी हालत में — नुकसान की जगह पर खड़ा होना
definition: placed inside difficult disadvantaged position where serious trouble seems almost entirely unavoidable
example: Losing the deposit slip before Monday left them behind the eight ball, though the clerk remembered their faces kindly.

hindi: पुराने ज़माने का — समय से पिछड़ा हुआ
definition: hopelessly outdated, still using methods everybody else abandoned years earlier
example: Uncle insisted his ledger book beat any computer, which everyone gently called being behind the times while borrowing his flawless totals.

hindi: अजीब सी आदत — न अच्छी न बुरी निशानी
definition: harmlessly quirky behaviour revealing somebody's personality, entirely neutral regarding their romantic suitability
example: Alphabetising the spice rack became their favourite beige flag story at every dinner afterwards.

hindi: कमर के नीचे वार — नियम तोड़कर ओछा हमला
definition: unfair cruel remark attacking somebody where contest rules forbid striking
example: Mentioning his failed exam during the argument landed below the belt, and his brother stopped speaking until dinner was served.

hindi: जान लगा देना — दूसरे के लिए खुद तकलीफ उठाना
definition: make enormous effort beyond reasonable duty, willingly inconveniencing yourself while helping someone
example: Naani bent over backwards for the visiting cousins, giving away her own room and sleeping beside the kitchen without complaint.

hindi: कान खाना — देर तक बोलकर परेशान करना
definition: cornering a listener with endless troubles, talking long after interest quietly disappears
example: The neighbour bent my ear about his knee surgery until the kettle whistled and rescued us both.

hindi: दोनों हाथों में लड्डू — दोनों तरफ़ का फ़ायदा
definition: enjoying advantages belonging separate choices simultaneously, sacrificing neither comfort nor convenience
example: Their flat above the bakery gave them the best of both worlds: warm mornings and neighbours who shared bread.

hindi: सबसे बढ़िया चीज़ — जिसकी तारीफ़ लोग थकते नहीं
definition: wonderfully useful invention people praise endlessly, treating ordinary improvement as marvellous
example: Father calls the pressure cooker whistle timer the best thing since sliced bread and demonstrates it to every visitor.

hindi: घर-बार दांव पर लगाना — सारी जमा-पूंजी एक ही सौदे में झोंक देना
definition: stake everything owned upon single risky venture, keeping nothing aside should that gamble collapse
example: Uncle Dev bet the farm on the mango orchard, and for two anxious summers the whole family watched the sky.

hindi: आख़िरी पैसा दाँव पर — पूरा भरोसा होना
definition: feel completely certain about something, willing risk every last coin upon that belief
example: You could bet your bottom dollar that Amma would arrive with pickles, whatever the wedding invitation actually asked guests to bring.

hindi: सभ्यता की सीमा से भी परे — बिलकुल सुनसान जगह
definition: somewhere extremely remote in Australian usage, further inland than settled farming country reaches
example: They honeymooned beyond the black stump, cooking beside their vehicle while galahs argued overhead about nothing.

hindi: मौके की ताक में रहना — सही समय का धैर्य से इंतज़ार
definition: waiting patiently for the right moment, holding back quietly instead of rushing toward action prematurely
example: The old fisherman bided his time, letting three boats pass before slipping into the quiet channel.

hindi: बड़ी विरासत संभालनी — पूर्ववर्ती जैसा कर पाना मुश्किल
definition: daunting position left behind, whose previous holder performed those responsibilities remarkably well
example: Taking over her mother's tailoring shop meant big shoes to fill, since every customer remembered exactly how she measured.

hindi: बड़ा नज़ारा — पूरी तस्वीर, सिर्फ़ ब्योरा नहीं
definition: wider overall situation beyond immediate details, showing consequences narrower thinking easily misses
example: Standing beside the packed suitcases, she finally saw the bigger picture: nobody minded the city, they missed their grandmother.

term: bite off more than you can chew
hindi: जितनी चादर उतने पैर नहीं — क्षमता से बड़ा बोझ लेना
definition: accepting commitments larger than your actual ability, becoming overwhelmed managing everything already promised, full form 'bite off more than you can chew'
example: He promised catering, decoration and transport, then admitted over tea that he had bitten off more than he could chew.

hindi: कड़वा घूँट पीना — अप्रिय काम बिना टाले कर डालना
definition: endure an unpleasant necessary task, accepting the painful part without further delay
example: She had circled the dentist's number for three weeks before she finally bit the bullet and dialled it.

hindi: ख़ाक चाटना — मारा जाना, हार जाना या बेकार हो जाना
definition: battlefield euphemism covering death, defeat, also machines that finally quit working
example: The scooter that carried three generations finally bit the dust outside the workshop.

term: bite the hand that feeds you
hindi: जिस थाली में खाते हैं उसी में छेद करना — अपने ही मददगार के साथ विश्वासघात
definition: repay generous trusted support with betrayal, harming somebody whose steady kindness sustained difficult earlier years
example: His aunt paid every fee for four years, so mocking her accent at the party was biting the hand that feeds you.

hindi: होंठ काटकर रह जाना — कड़वी बात कहने से खुद को रोकना
definition: holding back sharp words, staying quiet rather than saying something wounding
example: She bit her tongue when her brother criticised the biryani he had not helped cook.

hindi: कड़वा घूंट पीना — मजबूरी में अपमान सहना
definition: unpleasant humiliating outcome accepted quietly, admitting nothing further remains worth arguing
example: Losing the tender to a younger firm was a bitter pill to swallow, though he still sent them sweets by evening.

hindi: सफ़ेद या स्याह — हर बात सही-गलत में बाँटना
definition: treating complicated matters simply, dividing everything between correct versus wrong while ignoring uncertain middle possibilities
example: At seventeen everything looked black and white; teaching thirty students slowly showed him the shading.

hindi: उदासी का साया — पीछा न छोड़ने वाला अवसाद
definition: persistent depression pictured as gloomy sadness following somebody around, chiefly British literary usage
example: He described the black dog honestly to his doctor, and walked home lighter for having finally named it.

hindi: आँखें तरेरना — गुस्से भरी घूरती नज़र
definition: silent furious glare showing intense anger, warning somebody that displeasure could become considerably worse
example: One black look from their mother across the wedding hall ended the argument faster than any lecture.

hindi: कालाबाज़ारी — छिपकर मनमाने दाम पर बेचना
definition: illegal trading network selling restricted goods secretly, dodging official regulation, rationing rules, price controls
example: Cinema tickets vanished into the black market by noon, so the friends settled happily for the matinee rerun.

hindi: कुल का कलंक — खानदान को बदनाम करने वाला
definition: family member whose shameful conduct disappoints and embarrasses relatives across generations
example: The black sheep arrived late to the anniversary lunch with flowers, and his mother cried before anyone could mention the missing years.

hindi: नई राह बनाना — पहला रास्ता खोलना
definition: open a fresh route others follow later, going where nobody ventured before
example: Her mother blazed a trail through that engineering college, and three cousins followed the path she cleared.

hindi: छिपा हुआ वरदान — जो पहले मुसीबत लगे, बाद में भला साबित हो
definition: misfortune becoming unexpected fortune once its later consequences finally arrive
example: Missing that train was a blessing in disguise; the delay gave her an hour with her grandmother.

hindi: चमगादड़ जैसी नज़र — बिना चश्मा कुछ न दिखे
definition: barely able to notice anything visible, hopeless eyesight without spectacles nearby
example: Without her glasses she is blind as a bat and once greeted the neighbour's tall son as her own brother.

hindi: पत्थर से खून निकालना — कंजूस या ज़िद्दी से कुछ पाने की नाकाम कोशिश
definition: hopeless effort to extract money, kindness, or information from somebody completely unwilling to give
example: Getting an apology from him was blood from a stone, so his sister settled happily for silence and biscuits.

hindi: नाम पर दाग लगाना — साफ़ रिकॉर्ड बिगाड़ना
definition: spoil your previously spotless reputation, British usage, through single embarrassing public blunder
example: She blotted her copybook at the village fete, and the story survived three changes of committee.

hindi: दिमाग की बत्ती गुल होना — गुस्से में फ्यूज उड़ जाना
definition: lose your temper suddenly, exploding with furious anger, shouting over trivial provocation
example: The printer jammed for the fourth time and Meera blew a fuse, which made the whole office laugh and then help her fix it.

hindi: कभी गरम कभी नरम — मन बदलता रहना
definition: alternate between affectionate warmth and distant coldness, confusing someone romantically
example: Blowing hot and cold for three months, he sent poetry on Sunday and vanished by Tuesday, until she stopped checking her phone.

hindi: हवा में बातें बनाना — झूठी तारीफ़ से बहलाना
definition: speak flattering nonsense meant merely to please somebody, praising things nobody honestly believes
example: When the coach promised they would reach nationals, everyone smiled politely, knowing perfectly well that he was blowing smoke.

hindi: भांडा फोड़ना — छिपा हुआ भेद सबके सामने खोल देना
definition: reveal hidden wrongdoing publicly, exposing secret misconduct that powerful people worked very hard to conceal
example: The small-town paper ran three pages of leaked invoices and blew the lid off the road contract everyone had shrugged about for years.

hindi: भंडाफोड़ करना — अंदर की गड़बड़ी सामने लाना
definition: reveal secret wrongdoing inside an organization to authorities, accepting personal risk
example: She blew the whistle on the contractor after months of quiet worrying.

hindi: उल्टा पड़ना — चाल का अपने ही ऊपर भारी पड़ जाना
definition: something backfires suddenly, so careless actions harm their author instead of helping
example: The surprise party blew up in his face when the guest of honour arrived home crying about work.

hindi: अपने मुँह मियाँ मिट्ठू बनना — खुद की तारीफ़ करना
definition: boasting loudly about your achievements, filling talk with praise nobody else offers
example: He blew his own trumpet about the marathon medal until his daughter mentioned her own.

hindi: ऊँचे खानदान का — पीढ़ियों की कुलीनता
definition: inherited aristocratic descent carrying privilege, wealth, and established social standing from birth
example: The portrait gallery announced their blue blood long before dinner did, though the old countess preferred talking about her tomatoes.

hindi: गप्प हाँककर काम निकालना — जानकारी का दिखावा
definition: succeed through pretending confidence and knowledge that you never actually possessed beforehand
example: She bluffed her way through the first cookery class, watched carefully, and taught the whole batch dumplings within three weeks.

hindi: और बात बन गई — बस, काम पूरा
definition: a British phrase concluding simple instructions, meaning everything finishes easily after that
example: Twist the valve, press the button, Bob's your uncle, said the plumber, already reaching for his tea.

hindi: वज्रपात होना — बिना चेतावनी अचानक झटका
definition: shocking sudden news arriving without warning, leaving everybody completely stunned
example: The transfer order came as a bolt from the blue, and neighbours arrived that evening carrying containers of food.

hindi: पासा पलट जाना — अब स्थिति उल्टी
definition: reversed position where whoever suffered earlier presently holds advantage over others
example: Now that his younger sister marks the homework, the boot is on the other foot and he grumbles quietly.

hindi: क़िस्मत लेकर पैदा होना — जन्म से ही भाग्य का साथ मिलना
definition: enjoying constant fortune from birth, where luck arrives without effort while trouble passes harmlessly
example: Every job found him, every train waited; his grandmother said the boy was born under a lucky star and left it at that.

hindi: सोने का चम्मच लेकर पैदा होना — जन्म से ही अमीर
definition: inheriting family wealth and comfort, rich from birth without ever earning money
example: She was born with a silver spoon, yet she cycles to college and packs her own lunch.

hindi: जिगरी दोस्त — दिल की बात बताने वाला साथी
definition: trusted close friends confiding constantly, sharing secrets, worries, private thoughts nobody else hears
example: She rehearsed the resignation speech three times on the phone with her bosom buddy before saying anything at home.

hindi: मन बाग़-बाग़ — तंदुरुस्त और खुशमिजाज़
definition: cheerful, healthy, feeling perfectly fine again after trouble, said across New Zealand
example: Three days after surgery Grandad declared himself a box of birds and began rearranging the garden pots nobody asked about.

hindi: दिमाग़ पर धुंध — सोच धीमी, ध्यान बिखरा
definition: thinking feels slow, cloudy, unable to concentrate properly after exhaustion, illness, endless screens
example: The brain fog lifted around Thursday, and she finally read a whole page without starting it again.

hindi: रोटी रोज़ी — जिससे घर का खर्च चलता है
definition: reliable ordinary work providing steady household money, funding everyday family living quietly
example: Wedding photography brought excitement, but passport pictures remained his bread and butter through every slow season.

hindi: टुकड़े फेंकते रहना — थोड़ा ध्यान देकर उम्मीद ज़िंदा रखना
definition: offer tiny scraps of attention deliberately, keeping romantic hope alive without genuine interest
example: He breadcrumbed her with midnight replies to old photographs, and she finally muted the notifications before her exams.

hindi: शुभकामनाएँ — मंच पर सफलता की दुआ
definition: theatrical wishing performers luck before stepping onstage, hoping their evening turns successful
example: The stage manager whispered break a leg, then pushed the nervous flautist gently toward the curtain.

hindi: दिल तोड़ना — प्रेम में गहरा आघात पहुँचाना
definition: leave your partner devastated by ending the romantic relationship they treasured deeply
example: She broke his heart gently, over tea, which somehow made the afternoon worse.

hindi: दिवाला निकल जाना — खर्च इतना कि सारी जमा-पूँजी खत्म
definition: exhaust the money available, expensive enough that paying empties an entire household reserve
example: A second-hand cello won't break the bank, and she has waited two years for one.

hindi: बातचीत की शुरुआत करना — शुरुआती झिझक तोड़ना
definition: begin friendly conversation among strangers, easing awkward silence when nobody feels comfortable speaking first
example: Meera broke the ice by asking whose scooter was blocking the gate, and within minutes the whole waiting room was arguing happily about parking.

hindi: कमर तोड़ देना — भारी मेहनत से शरीर थका देना
definition: working through heavy physical hours, spending exhausting effort until your strength fades
example: They broke their backs clearing the flooded field, then sat laughing in the mud when rain returned.

hindi: प्राण त्यागना — अंतिम साँस लेकर संसार छोड़ देना
definition: to stop breathing finally and pass away, the quiet moment when death arrives for a person
example: The old carpenter breathed his last at home, with the smell of sawdust still in the room and his daughter holding his hand.

hindi: होनहार बालक — तेज़ दिमाग़ वाला विद्यार्थी
definition: clever pupil learning quickly, British praise offered towards someone unusually sharp minded
example: Some bright spark in the back row solved the puzzle aloud before the teacher reached the second clue.

hindi: अपने हिस्से का खाना लाना — साझा दावत में योगदान
definition: instruction asking every guest carry shared homemade food, filling communal Australian gathering tables
example: The invitation simply said bring a plate, and somehow four families arrived carrying halwa, samosas, pavlova, and lamingtons.

hindi: रोज़ी कमाना — घर चलाने भर पैसा लाना
definition: earning steady household money through honest daily work, supporting everybody depending upon you
example: She brought home the bacon through twelve monsoons of tailoring, and her daughters still argue over who inherits the machine.

hindi: तालियों की गड़गड़ाहट करा देना — पूरा हॉल गूँज उठना
definition: provoke enormous audience applause during performance, delighting nearly everybody watching from their seats
example: Her final number brought the house down, and the school hall clapped so long the compere forgot his closing lines.

hindi: बाल्टियों से पानी गिरना — तेज़ बारिश (ब्रिटिश)
definition: raining extremely heavily, water pouring against windows and pavements, British phrasing
example: It was bucketing down outside the chip shop, so they waited inside sharing a single newspaper.

hindi: दिल जोड़ना — बिगड़े रिश्तों को धीरे-धीरे सुधारना
definition: settle a bruising quarrel slowly, restoring peaceful trust between former enemies through patient effort
example: She built bridges the slow way, sending soup to the neighbour who had once sued her over a wall.

hindi: मिट्टी ही अलग है — बनावट ही दूसरों से मज़बूत
definition: unusually resilient and talented, unlike everybody around, seemingly assembled from sturdier material
example: Everyone quit the trek beyond the third ridge except Fatima, who claimed cheerfully that mountain people arrive built different.

hindi: झटकों भरा सफ़र — उखड़ी-पखड़ी राह
definition: difficult stretch ahead, marked by repeated jolts and setbacks before things settle
example: The first monsoon term was a bumpy ride for the new teacher, though her students remember it fondly now.

term: burn a hole in your pocket
hindi: जेब में पैसा न टिकना — मिलते ही उड़ा देना
definition: money that tempts quick spending, spent freely and lavishly soon after payday arrives
example: The birthday cash burned a hole in his pocket, and by evening he owned a secondhand guitar.

term: burn the candle at both ends
hindi: नींद और आराम छोड़कर ख़ुद को थका डालना
definition: becoming exhausted through late nights and early rising, draining energy and eventually health
example: Burning the candle at both ends through exam season, he fell asleep during his own party.

hindi: रात का तेल जलाना — देर रात तक जागकर काम करना
definition: working late into the night hours, giving exhausting effort while everyone else sleeps
example: The kitchen light stayed on till three; Ammu was burning the midnight oil over her thesis chapter.

hindi: वापसी के रास्ते जला देना — लौटने की गुंजाइश खत्म करना
definition: destroy every possible retreat deliberately, committing beyond return with nothing behind worth keeping
example: He resigned politely instead of burning his bridges, because that little town had only three good employers.

hindi: हाथ जलाना — जल्दबाज़ी के सौदे में नुकसान उठाना
definition: suffer painful financial loss through reckless venture, learning caution only after gamble collapses
example: Having burnt his fingers once on a friend's scheme, Anil now reads every page twice before signing anything.

hindi: ठसाठस भरा — जगह कम पड़ना
definition: overcrowded beyond comfortable capacity, holding many more people than intended space allows
example: The little tuition room was bursting at the seams, with three boys sharing every bench and one perched happily outside.

hindi: सुलह कर लेना — पुरानी अदावत भुलाकर मेल कर लेना
definition: settle an ancient quarrel, restoring peaceful relations between former enemies who stopped speaking
example: The brothers buried the hatchet over a shared plate of jalebis, forty years after the shop was divided.

term: bury your head in the sand
hindi: आँख मूँदकर बैठना — सच्चाई से मुँह मोड़ लेना
definition: deliberately ignoring unpleasant reality, avoiding practical trouble instead of solving anything
example: They buried their heads in the sand about the cracked wall until monsoon water reached the almirah.

hindi: मधुमक्खी जैसा व्यस्त — छोटे-छोटे कामों में लगातार जुटा
definition: constantly occupied with small useful tasks, labouring cheerfully through crowded hours
example: Grandmother stayed busy as a bee before Diwali, sorting wicks and jars, refusing every offer of help except tea.

hindi: मक्खन लगाना — तारीफ़ करके काम निकालना
definition: praise somebody excessively hoping flattery will persuade them into granting something later
example: He buttered his grandmother up with three compliments about her cooking before mentioning the money he needed.

hindi: पेट में तितलियाँ उड़ना — घबराहट और उत्साह का मिला-जुला डर
definition: nervous fluttering felt before something important, mixing anxious dread with restless anticipation
example: She had butterflies in her stomach before the recital, and her teacher told her every good singer feels exactly that.

hindi: मुँह बंद रखना — चुप हो जाना
definition: stopping talk instantly, keeping the secret safe by telling nobody standing nearby
example: Dad buttoned his lip the second my sister walked in carrying the birthday cake we had hidden.

term: by the seat of your pants
hindi: जैसे-तैसे निभा लेना — बिना योजना अंदाज़ से
definition: managing something risky without preparation, improvising continuously through instinct rather than planning
example: They ran the whole school play by the seat of their pants, and the audience never guessed the curtain jammed twice.

term: by the skin of your teeth
hindi: मुश्किल से जान बचाकर — बहुत मामूली अंतर से बच निकलना
definition: escape failure narrowly, clearing serious danger with margin almost impossibly slender
example: He reached the platform by the skin of his teeth, one shoe untied, the guard's whistle already in the air.

hindi: खरी-खरी कहना — बात घुमाए बिना सच बोलना
definition: describe unpleasant truth plainly, naming obvious problems without softening careful language
example: Their father called a spade a spade about the leaking roof, and the landlord arrived within hours carrying actual tools.

hindi: बस अब इतना ही — काम रोककर छुट्टी कर देना
definition: to stop working and finish an activity, deciding that further effort brings nothing worthwhile
example: After the fourth burnt pancake my father called it a day, and we walked to the bakery in our pyjamas.

hindi: किनारा कर लेना — आपसी सहमति से सिलसिला यहीं ख़त्म करना
definition: to abandon an effort or relationship by mutual agreement, accepting defeat without further struggle
example: They called it quits on the band after the third drummer left, and stayed friends anyway.

hindi: हुक्म चलाना — सारे फ़ैसले अपने हाथ में रखना
definition: control every important decision that other people must finally follow
example: Nani sat quietly through the whole wedding meeting, but everyone knew she would call the shots about the menu.

hindi: जिसकी लाठी उसकी भैंस — पैसा देनेवाला ही हुक्म चलाता है
definition: control every decision because you supply the money, leaving others following your instructions quietly
example: The eldest cousin paid for the wedding tent, so nobody was surprised that he called the tune about seating.

hindi: पोल खोलना — दावे को चुनौती देना
definition: challenging somebody's pretence directly, forcing hidden reality forward when their confident claims collapse
example: Mother called his bluff about cooking dinner, sat down, and waited cheerfully while the kitchen filled with smoke.

hindi: शांत तालाब जैसा — बिल्कुल स्थिर
definition: utterly untroubled and calm, water or temper showing barely noticeable disturbance
example: After the storm the lake lay calm as a millpond, and the fishermen went out laughing about the previous night.

hindi: तूफ़ान से पहले की शांति — बड़ी मुसीबत से पहले का सन्नाटा
definition: quiet peaceful period arriving just before serious trouble finally breaks over everyone
example: The kitchen was silent at four o'clock, the calm before the storm of forty wedding guests arriving hungry.

term: can take it or leave it
hindi: न ठंडा न गरम — कोई ख़ास लगाव नहीं
definition: mildly indifferent about something, neither disliking strongly enough refusing nor really enjoying
example: He can take or leave chocolate cake, which is lucky, because his sister finishes both slices anyway.

hindi: सिर-पैर समझ न आना — कुछ पल्ले न पड़ना
definition: understand nothing whatever despite effort, finding explanation completely confusing throughout
example: She could not make head nor tail of the assembly diagram, so her brother turned the paper around.

hindi: ज़िंदगी का तय पड़ाव — यह दुख होना ही था
definition: unavoidable painful episode treated afterwards as necessary chapter shaping somebody's eventual character
example: Losing that first terrible job became a canon event nobody in the family could tell without laughing.

hindi: दिल में मशाल जलाए रखना — एकतरफ़ा प्यार निभाना
definition: keep longing quietly for somebody whose affection remains unreturned, sometimes continuing years afterwards
example: Uncle still carries a torch for a classmate from Nainital, which explains why he hums that particular song while gardening.

hindi: उल्टे बाँस बरेली को — जहाँ चीज़ पहले से भरी हो वहीं पहुँचाना
definition: wasting effort supplying something already abundant, where nothing useful comes from giving more
example: Taking mangoes to her uncle's orchard was carrying coals to Newcastle, though he hugged her anyway.

term: carry on like a pork chop
hindi: बात का बतंगड़ बनाना — नाटक करके शोर मचाना
definition: lose temper theatrically, complaining childishly about thoroughly minor trouble, said across Australia
example: She carried on like a pork chop about the missing charger, which turned out under the cushion she sat upon.

hindi: ठीकरा सिर पर लेना — दूसरों की गलती की सज़ा भुगतना
definition: accept blame alone, punished publicly for failings other people actually caused, British phrasing
example: Somebody had forgotten the wedding tents, and poor Chotu carried the can while three uncles quietly rewrote their version.

hindi: बाज़ी मार ले जाना — मुक़ाबले में जीत हासिल करना
definition: finish a contest as clear winner after hard struggle against strong rivals
example: Three speakers argued well, but the quiet girl with the hand-drawn charts carried the day.

hindi: कोरा कागज़ थमाना — जो चाहो करने का पूरा अधिकार
definition: complete freedom and authority to proceed however you choose, without restriction
example: They handed the cook carte blanche for the wedding menu, and she quietly replaced every fashionable dish with her grandmother's recipes.

hindi: चल बसना — जीवन का खेल समेट लेना
definition: to leave living behind and pass away, gambling slang treating death as a person collecting final winnings
example: Grandpa joked for years that he would cash in his chips only after seeing the new bridge finished, and somehow he did.

hindi: मझधार में छोड़ देना — बिना सहारे अकेला छोड़ना
definition: abandoned without guidance, support, direction after those responsible quietly stopped helping
example: When the senior teacher retired mid-term, the new arrivals felt cast adrift until the librarian began sitting with them at lunch.

hindi: भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना — नासमझों पर हुनर बरबाद
definition: offering valuable things toward people completely unable to appreciate their worth
example: Playing his grandfather's rare recordings during the noisy party felt like casting pearls before swine, so he saved them.

hindi: हवाई क़िले बनाना — असंभव योजनाएँ गढ़ना
definition: unrealistic hopeful plans imagined without money, permission, or practical foundation
example: They built castles in the air on the terrace every summer night, naming rooms in a house nobody could afford.

hindi: मुँह में दही जमना — अचानक बोल न पाना
definition: suddenly unable to speak, standing silent when words were clearly expected
example: Her aunt teased her at the doorway, asking whether the cat had got her tongue again.

term: cat on a hot tin roof
hindi: गरम तवे पर बिल्ली — घबराहट में एक जगह टिक न पाना
definition: extremely nervous, fidgeting restlessly because anxious waiting makes sitting still impossible
example: Waiting outside the interview hall he was a cat on a hot tin roof, until another candidate offered him half a biscuit.

hindi: मज़बूत कुर्सी — हर हाल में फ़ायदे की स्थिति
definition: commanding enviable position where circumstances favour whatever decision somebody chooses, advantage assured
example: With both landlords bidding for the shop, the tailor sat comfortably in the catbird seat, stitching quietly through their offers.

hindi: दिल लग जाना — बेइरादा प्यार हो जाना
definition: developing unexpected romantic attachment toward somebody despite intending everything remain casual
example: They promised nothing serious, then she caught feelings somewhere between the borrowed umbrella and the second breakfast.

hindi: झपकी मार लेना — थोड़ी नींद पूरी करना
definition: snatch brief sleep whenever possible, tired person resting between duties rather than proper bedtime
example: She caught some shut-eye on the train bench, waking exactly when the tea seller called down the platform.

hindi: नज़र मिल जाना — पहली झलक में ध्यान खींचना
definition: attract somebody's romantic attention briefly through glances exchanged across crowded rooms
example: She caught his eye between courses, both looked away immediately, and his brother pretended nothing whatsoever had happened.

hindi: ठंड लगाकर बीमार पड़ना — लापरवाही से रोग बुला लेना
definition: become dangerously unwell through careless exposure, usually cold weather warnings from worried elders
example: Standing on the wet balcony without slippers, he heard his aunt promise he would catch his death before dinner.

hindi: होश में आ — बहकी बात छोड़ने की नसीहत
definition: telling somebody deluded to stop believing obvious nonsense, Northern Irish corrective phrase
example: Catch yourself on, his sister said gently, when he announced that quitting college would obviously make him wealthy within months.

hindi: रंगे हाथों पकड़ा गया — सबूत सहित
definition: exposed with undeniable recorded evidence, screenshots preserving exactly what somebody kept denying
example: He swore he never watched the finale, then somebody posted the photograph: caught in 4K, popcorn included.

hindi: रंगे हाथों पकड़ा जाना — चोरी करते हुए धरा जाना
definition: discovered during wrongdoing itself, leaving somebody unable to deny dishonest behaviour convincingly
example: The puppy was caught red-handed beside the emptied plate, tail wagging through the entire interrogation.

hindi: बेखबरी में पकड़े जाना — बिना तैयारी शर्मिंदा होना
definition: caught unprepared during something embarrassing, discovered before excuses could cover obvious wrongdoing
example: The inspection arrived early and caught the whole kitchen with its pants down, three burners cold and nobody wearing gloves.

hindi: हलचल मचा देना — चर्चा छिड़ जाना
definition: provoke excited argument among watching audience, becoming topic everybody discusses immediately
example: Her arrival with the ex-boyfriend caused such a stir that nobody noticed the speeches beginning.

hindi: हाथ आज़माना — नुकसान की परवाह किए बिना हिम्मत करके कोशिश करना
definition: attempt something boldly risky despite likely failure, keeping nothing back should embarrassment follow
example: Nobody expected the trainee to answer, but she chanced her arm and the visiting professor stopped mid-sentence to listen.

hindi: पैंतरा बदलना — तरीका बदल देना
definition: abandon your present approach, trying completely different method after earlier attempts failed
example: After arguing for an hour he changed tack, brought out old photographs instead, and his brother finally started talking.

hindi: सुर बदल लेना — पहले जैसी बात नहीं
definition: abruptly reverse your stated opinion, singing completely different notes once circumstances turn against
example: He changed his tune about noisy neighbours the week his daughter brought home a drum kit.

hindi: पूरा हिसाब — हर बात सबूत सहित
definition: exact detailed evidence recited from memory, proving somebody's earlier promises beyond argument
example: Ask about the borrowed scooter and she gives chapter and verse, dates and messages, without pausing.

hindi: किस्मत का धनी होना — हर मुसीबत से बेदाग़ निकल आना
definition: existence blessed with constant fortune, where luck deflects trouble that ruins ordinary people
example: Three crashes, one flood, and not a scratch on him — the village decided the man led a charmed life.

hindi: शोहरत के पीछे भागना — लाइक बटोरने की होड़
definition: pursue online popularity shamelessly, courting attention from strangers instead of building genuine friendship
example: He stopped chasing clout after his cousin pointed out that nobody in their family watched those videos anyway.

hindi: अपनी ही पूँछ के पीछे भागना — भागदौड़ बहुत, नतीजा शून्य
definition: working frantically without progress, repeating effort that never finishes anything useful
example: She spent the whole morning chasing her tail between courier calls, and finally sat down with cold tea to make one proper list.

hindi: पानी के भाव — बेहद सस्ता
definition: priced cheaply, costing hardly anything and worth considerably more than the modest price paid
example: The bookshop near the station sells old paperbacks cheap as chips, three for the price of tea.

hindi: क्या बात है — बिलकुल लाजवाब, कोई कमी नहीं
definition: flawless, deeply satisfying quality deserving loud praise, nothing anybody could sensibly improve further
example: He tasted the rasam, closed both eyes, kissed his fingertips and pronounced it chef's kiss before serving everyone.

hindi: ऊपर से बोनस — बढ़िया चीज़ पर आख़िरी सजावट
definition: delightful small addition crowning something already excellent, pleasing beyond reasonable expectation
example: The train arrived early, and finding window seats together was the cherry on top of an already gentle journey.

hindi: गप्पें मारना — बेफ़िक्र लंबी बातचीत
definition: enjoy long relaxed conversation about unimportant subjects, chatting comfortably without hurrying anywhere
example: The two uncles chewed the fat outside the barber shop for an hour, neither of them remembering why they had come.

hindi: मंच चबा जाना — हद से ज़्यादा नाटकीय होना
definition: acting theatrically overblown throughout performance, exaggerating every emotion beyond believable measure
example: The villain chewed the scenery so thoroughly that children began cheering for him instead.

hindi: जैसा बोओगे वैसा काटोगे — पुराने कर्म लौट आना
definition: earlier wrongdoing returns eventually, bringing unpleasant consequences onto someone believing themselves safely forgotten
example: The shortcuts taken during construction stayed hidden until monsoon, when every chicken came home to roost across the ceiling.

hindi: बच्चों का खेल — बेहद सरल काम
definition: task simple enough that anyone finishes easily, without effort, training, trouble, special skill
example: After a winter of rebuilding tractor engines, fixing the kitchen tap was child's play for grandfather.

hindi: बकबक — खोखली बातें जो कुछ तय नहीं करतीं
definition: an American term for empty aimless chatter filling time, pleasant talking that settles absolutely nothing
example: The barbershop offered plenty of chin music alongside every haircut, and half the customers came mostly for that.

hindi: बाप पर पूत — पिता जैसा ही स्वभाव और आदतें
definition: child whose habits and manner closely resemble a parent, sharing personality and talents
example: He hummed while he worked, exactly the way his mother did over the same kitchen sink, and his aunt laughed that he was a chip off the old block.

hindi: मन में गाँठ — पुरानी नाइंसाफ़ी का बोझ
definition: lasting resentment about earlier unfairness, carried through years, quarrelsome with everybody
example: He arrived with a chip on his shoulder about being the scholarship boy, and lost it slowly over four good friendships.

hindi: इंटरनेट का कीड़ा — असली दुनिया से कटा हुआ
definition: describing somebody whose opinions come entirely from screens, having forgotten ordinary offline reality
example: Her nephew arrived chronically online, explaining internet feuds nobody recognised, until three days of cousins cured him.

hindi: आग-बबूला होना — छोटी बात पर तमाशा
definition: lose temper suddenly, shouting childishly about minor disappointment, said across Australia
example: He chucked a wobbly when the printer jammed before the wedding cards, so his sister quietly refilled the paper tray.

hindi: फूला नहीं समाना — भीतर तक ख़ुश
definition: thoroughly delighted in British usage, quietly pleased and glowing with proud happiness
example: Nan was chuffed to bits with her marrow rosette and propped it against the kettle for visitors.

hindi: ढलान पर होना — धीरे-धीरे अंत की ओर बढ़ना
definition: declining steadily close toward death, barely responding while illness worsens beyond likely recovery
example: The old mare had been circling the drain all autumn, so the family took turns sleeping in the barn beside her.

hindi: सब ठीक होने की मुहर — कोई खराबी नहीं मिली
definition: official confirmation that nothing dangerous remains, allowing normal activity without further worry
example: The engineer gave the old building a clean bill of health, and the residents celebrated by repainting the stairwell themselves.

hindi: घंटी जैसी साफ़ आवाज़ — एकदम स्पष्ट
definition: perfectly obvious and easily noticeable, every sound reaching listeners without confusion
example: The line crackled all evening, then suddenly his mother's voice came through clear as a bell asking whether he had eaten.

hindi: दिन के उजाले जैसा साफ़ — समझने में ज़रा भी उलझन नहीं
definition: immediately obvious and easily understood, needing nothing further explained afterwards
example: Once she drew the family tree on newspaper, the whole tangle of cousins became clear as day to everybody watching.

hindi: उल्टा उलझा देना — समझाने पर और गड़बड़ हो जाना
definition: supposedly helpful explanation that remains thoroughly incomprehensible, leaving the listener understanding rather less than before
example: The instructions for assembling the cupboard were clear as mud, so they worked from the picture instead and finished by midnight.

hindi: गिले-शिकवे दूर करना — खुलकर बात करके तनाव मिटाना
definition: settle simmering tension through honest conversation, removing quarrel and restoring peaceful understanding
example: One long walk around the lake cleared the air between the flatmates better than three weeks of silence.

hindi: मैदान साफ़ करना — काम शुरू करने से पहले सब हटा देना
definition: remove every distraction beforehand, leaving nothing except important work needing full attention
example: She cleared the decks the evening before results came out, cancelling visitors and leaving nothing on the table except tea.

hindi: कंधे से कंधा मिलाना — बाहरी हमले पर अंदरूनी झगड़ा भुलाना
definition: unite tightly to defend your group against outside criticism, hiding internal disagreement completely from strangers
example: The moment the inspector questioned their teacher, the noisiest class in the school closed ranks and answered nothing.

hindi: बाल-बाल बचना — ज़रा सी दूरी से खतरा टल जाना
definition: narrow escape where serious danger passed within barest margin, leaving everyone badly shaken
example: The scooter wobbled past the truck with inches to spare; Ravi parked, sat down on the kerb, and admitted it was a close shave.

hindi: पन्ना पलट देना — उस अध्याय को हमेशा के लिए पीछे छोड़ देना
definition: to permanently stop revisiting a finished activity, treating the matter closed against further involvement
example: He closed the book on his racing years the morning he sold the helmet to a delighted teenager down the street.

hindi: दरवाज़ा हमेशा के लिए बंद करना — सारा नाता तोड़ देना
definition: ending access permanently, refusing further contact, conversation, closeness with somebody difficult
example: She closed the door on the friend who borrowed money twice, gently, without speeches, simply never opening that conversation again.

hindi: चिड़िया चुग गई खेत — नुक़सान हो जाने के बाद सावधानी बरतना
definition: taking careful precautions only after harm already happened, once the chance which actually mattered passed unused
example: They bought three smoke alarms the week after the kitchen fire, closing the stable door with great enthusiasm.

hindi: बंद किताब — जो कुछ समझ में न आए
definition: subject remaining completely mysterious, understanding nothing about somebody despite considerable reading
example: Astronomy stayed a closed book until his neighbour dragged the telescope onto the terrace one winter night.

hindi: आसमान पर बादल मंडराना — आने वाली मुसीबत के संकेत
definition: early warning signals suggesting approaching trouble before matters actually worsen
example: The shop was busy, but Amma counted the unpaid ledgers and saw clouds on the horizon.

hindi: डूबते को तिनके का सहारा — निराशा में बेकार उपायों से चिपकना
definition: grasping desperately at hopeless remedies once every reasonable chance of success vanished
example: They were clutching at straws by then, phoning distant cousins who had never repaired anything electrical.

hindi: मशीन का पुरज़ा — बड़े तंत्र में मामूली इंसान
definition: insignificant person inside large organisation, replaceable worker whose absence changes almost nothing
example: He called himself only a cog in the machine, though half the neighbourhood asked him about their pension papers.

hindi: बर्फ़ जैसा ठंडा — व्यवहार में बिलकुल अपनापन नहीं
definition: showing chilling absence of warmth toward others, refusing friendly feeling during ordinary conversation
example: She stayed cold as ice through the whole dinner, and only softened when someone praised her mother's cooking.

hindi: हिम्मत छूट जाना — ऐन मौके पर घबरा जाना
definition: sudden nervousness arriving before commitment, losing courage exactly when the decision becomes real
example: He got cold feet outside the interview hall, so his sister walked him twice around the block and pushed him gently inside.

hindi: ठंडा आदमी — जिसमें भावनाओं की गर्माहट नहीं
definition: person showing little warmth toward anybody, seeming distant during even affectionate family occasions
example: Everyone called the uncle a cold fish until they found the drawer where he kept every childhood drawing.

hindi: मुँह फेर लेना — जान-बूझकर उपेक्षा करना
definition: deliberate coldness toward your partner, withdrawing warmth until the romantic relationship feels distant
example: After the forgotten anniversary he received the cold shoulder through breakfast, lunch and dinner.

hindi: मुँह की खाना — बुरी तरह असफल होना
definition: failing badly and suddenly, tumbling from confidence into a ruined position after an obvious mistake
example: He boasted about cycling the hill without stopping and came a cropper halfway, wheeling the bicycle home while his cousins laughed.

hindi: चूलें हिल जाना — ढाँचा भीतर से दरकना
definition: something once solid collapses steadily, as a plan or household loses every remaining support
example: By the third night without sleep the whole tour was coming apart at the seams, and the drummer just sat down on the stage.

hindi: सच उगल देना — छिपाया हुआ सच मान लेना
definition: confess the whole truth about hidden wrongdoing, admitting what deception concealed until conscience forced honesty
example: He came clean about the dented bumper over breakfast, and his mother laughed harder than she scolded.

hindi: अपने पैरों पर खिलना — असली रंग और आत्मविश्वास सामने आना
definition: finally reaching confident maturity where talent, appearance, judgement stop hiding behind earlier nervousness
example: Around thirty she came into her own, painting boldly, arguing calmly, dressing exactly however pleased herself.

hindi: खोल से बाहर आना — शर्म छोड़कर खुलकर मिलना
definition: gradually shedding painful shyness, becoming talkative, confident, willing among unfamiliar people
example: After joining the drama club Ishaan came out of his shell, arguing about costumes with people twice his height.

hindi: धूप हो या बारिश — हर हाल में
definition: continuing faithfully regardless whether conditions turn pleasant, never offering excuses
example: Come rain or shine, the old postman walked the lane, whistling under a black umbrella held against monsoon wind.

hindi: भेद खुलना — छिपी हुई बात सामने आ जाना
definition: previously hidden secret facts become publicly known, exposing truth that careful concealment kept buried many years
example: The letters came to light when the old desk was moved, and the whole village learned who had paid for the school.

hindi: गाड़ी पटरी से उतरना — बीच रास्ते योजना बिगड़ना
definition: fail badly midway, British usage, plans collapsing publicly through unnoticed mistakes
example: Their clever shortcut came unstuck near the river, where the bridge had been closed since April.

hindi: सब कुछ अच्छा निकलना — चिंता के बाद सफलता
definition: turn out wonderfully despite earlier worry, every difficulty flowering into unexpected success
example: The wedding lunch began with burnt rice and a power cut, yet somehow everything came up roses by evening.

hindi: अपनी सुविधा का दायरा — जाना-पहचाना घेरा
definition: familiar comfortable surroundings where nothing frightens, cosy limits nobody stretches without deliberate effort
example: Singing publicly sat far outside her comfort zone, so her sister simply booked the slot and told her afterwards.

hindi: खुद से चैन होना — जैसा हूँ वैसा ही ठीक लगना
definition: accepting yourself calmly without wanting approval from strangers, confidence quietly settled inside
example: She arrived without makeup, hair pinned anyhow, entirely comfortable in her own skin among people photographing everything.

hindi: साझा ज़मीन — दोनों की सहमति का बिंदु
definition: the shared beliefs where opposing sides already agree, giving a compromise somewhere solid to begin
example: Over three hours and much chai, the two committees found common ground on the festival dates.

hindi: चोरी और सीनाज़ोरी — गलती पर गलती
definition: worsen an existing offence through second blunder, multiplying blame instead of apologising
example: Having forgotten the anniversary, he compounded the felony by booking the restaurant she disliked most.

hindi: अपनी लुटिया डुबोना — बचे हुए मौक़े भी ख़त्म कर लेना
definition: someone ruins their remaining chances through actions that harm themselves permanently
example: Telling the examiner she had never opened the textbook cooked her goose before the second question.

hindi: बर्फ़ जैसा शांत — घबराहट में भी बिल्कुल स्थिर
definition: remaining calmly composed during frightening pressure, showing absolutely nothing troubling outside
example: While everybody shouted about the flooded kitchen, Nani stayed cool as a cucumber and started lifting the steel plates.

hindi: इंतज़ार में एड़ियाँ रगड़ना — बेबस होकर प्रतीक्षा करना
definition: waiting around impatiently while others delay, kept standing still instead of rushing
example: We cooled our heels outside the clinic for an hour, counting sparrows on the wire above the gate.

term: cost an arm and a leg
hindi: कमर तोड़ देना — इतना महँगा कि जेब खाली हो जाए
definition: extremely expensive, costing enough that paying leaves ordinary household finances visibly damaged
example: The plumber fixed it in an hour and it still cost an arm and a leg.

hindi: दाम आसमान छूना — बेहद महँगा पड़ना
definition: requires an enormously large amount of money, proving much more expensive than anyone expected
example: The little balcony flat looked perfect until the agent named the rent, which would cost the earth.

hindi: हर पहलू सँभाल लेना — किसी भी स्थिति के लिए तैयार रहना
definition: prepare against every likely outcome, protecting your position whichever choice finally proves correct
example: For the wedding lunch they covered all the bases, ordering extra rice, spare chairs and an emergency umbrella.

hindi: मुँह अँधेरे — सूरज निकलने से पहले
definition: earliest morning hours, rising before sunrise while everybody else remains sleeping
example: Grandfather walked to the river at the crack of dawn, returning with wet feet before anyone else found their slippers.

hindi: चाबुक चलाना — सख़्ती से काम कराना
definition: an American phrase meaning supervising sternly, pushing people harder through strict impatient watching authority
example: Aunt cracked the whip through the kitchen until every dish arrived, then poured herself the largest lemonade.

hindi: महफ़िल जम गई — ज़बरदस्त रंगीन शाम
definition: wonderfully lively enjoyment in Irish usage, hours vanishing amid music, jokes, dancing
example: The craic was ninety in that little kitchen until somebody noticed the milkman outside and everybody realised morning had arrived.

hindi: औंधे मुँह गिरना — शानदार शुरुआत के बाद बुरी तरह असफल होना
definition: fail suddenly and completely after confident beginning, leaving plans wrecked beyond repair
example: His audition crashed and burned halfway through the second song, and the judges still clapped because he bowed anyway.

hindi: नवरत्न — सबसे चुनिंदा और बेहतरीन लोग
definition: the finest people chosen from a larger group, better than everyone else considered
example: Forty players trialled in the heat; these eleven were the cream of the crop.

hindi: आराम की छोटी-छोटी चीज़ें — रोज़ का सुख
definition: small physical comforts making daily living cosy, familiar soothing things nobody willingly surrenders
example: He packed light for the trek but smuggled his creature comforts along: proper tea, thick socks, one absurd pillow.

hindi: भिड़ जाना — किसी से खुलकर बहस में उतरना
definition: enter bitter dispute with opposing person, arguing fiercely over sharply conflicting positions
example: Grandmother crossed swords with the doctor about salt, and neither side surrendered before dessert.

hindi: समय आने पर देखेंगे — फैसला बाद के लिए टालना
definition: postpone difficult decisions deliberately until circumstances actually require choosing something
example: Asked about hostel fees three years ahead, his father laughed and said they would cross that bridge together.

hindi: निर्णायक कदम उठाना — जहाँ से वापसी नहीं
definition: commit irreversibly beyond retreat, taking decisive action which cannot afterwards be undone
example: Signing the shop lease felt like crossing the Rubicon, and that evening they celebrated with jalebi from the corner stall.

hindi: अपना बोझ अपने कंधों पर — जीवन भर सहने वाला दुख
definition: prolonged private suffering carried patiently, burden nobody else fully understands
example: His father's failing memory became his own cross to bear, and he learned every story twice over gladly.

hindi: अब पछताए क्या होत — बीती बात पर रोना बेकार
definition: wasting sorrow over past mistakes nobody could reverse, since regret cannot change finished damage
example: Grandmother refused to cry over spilt milk about the broken dish and simply moved the flowers into the surviving brass bowl.

hindi: झूठी दुहाई देना — बार-बार झूठा शोर, फिर कोई नहीं सुनता
definition: raising false alarms repeatedly until genuine truthful warning story stops being believed
example: She reported burglars every second night, so when smoke actually filled her kitchen the neighbours assumed she was crying wolf again.

hindi: पराया जाया — घर में पला बेगाना
definition: unwelcome outsider living inside a family, quietly resented by the other relatives
example: For years the stepson felt like a cuckoo in the nest, until his stepfather taught him to sharpen chisels on winter evenings.

hindi: आधा अच्छा आधा ख़राब — तारीफ़ मजबूरी में
definition: a British term for something partly decent, praised politely although mostly disappointing throughout
example: The school play was a curate's egg, wonderful scenery around actors who forgot every single line.

hindi: परदा गिरने पर सलामी — तालियों के बीच आख़िरी हाज़िरी
definition: final appearance accepting audience applause after performance finishes, bowing before house lights return
example: During the curtain call she pulled the nervous prompter forward, insisting the audience clap for him too.

hindi: दुम दबाकर भागना — मुसीबत देखकर साथ छोड़ देना
definition: abandon a commitment suddenly and leave others behind rather than facing approaching trouble
example: The other two partners cut and run when the roof caved in, leaving Marta alone with the builders and the bills.

hindi: काम में कोताही करना — जल्दबाज़ी में ज़रूरी क़दम छोड़ देना
definition: skip necessary steps carelessly, saving effort while producing shoddier result than promised
example: The contractor cut corners on the terrace waterproofing, and the first proper monsoon quietly announced his shortcut across the ceiling.

hindi: एक ही थैली के चट्टे-बट्टे — स्वभाव में एक जैसे
definition: people who closely resemble each other in character, values, habits, and manner
example: Both brothers gave away their umbrellas in the rain and walked home soaked, cut from the same cloth as their stubbornly generous father.

hindi: आँचल छोड़ना — माता-पिता का सहारा छोड़कर अलग होना
definition: stop depending upon parents and begin living independently, without their constant help
example: He cut the apron strings the summer he moved two cities away, though he still called every Sunday to ask how to cook rice.

hindi: नाता तोड़ना — संबंध खत्म कर देना
definition: ending connection with somebody permanently, refusing further involvement or shared responsibility
example: She cut ties with the business partner politely, returned his ledgers, and slept properly for the first time in months.

hindi: सीधे मुद्दे पर आना — भूमिका छोड़कर असली बात
definition: abandon lengthy preamble immediately, reaching important matters without wasting further words
example: After twenty minutes about the weather, Auntie cut to the chase and asked whether anyone liked the boy's photograph.

hindi: जितना डूबा सो डूबा — और नुक़सान से पहले पीछे हट जाना
definition: to abandon a failing venture early, accepting a small defeat instead of a larger ruin
example: She cut her losses on the leaking scooter and took the bus home smiling.

hindi: तारीफ़ में छिपा ताना — हल्की प्रशंसा से निंदा
definition: criticise somebody indirectly, offering praise mild enough that listeners understand insult intended
example: The review damned the little restaurant with faint praise, calling the bread reliable and stopping there.

hindi: फुस्स पटाखा — बड़े वादे के बाद बेअसर नतीजा
definition: disappointing event promising enormous excitement, ending flatly without anything memorable happening (British)
example: The grand light show turned out a damp squib, though the children enjoyed the generator failing more than the lights.

hindi: किसी की धुन पर नाचना — मर्ज़ी के मुताबिक चलना
definition: following another person's wishes obediently, moving exactly where their chosen tune directs
example: She refused to dance to her landlord's tune, and repainted the shutters the colour she wanted.

hindi: गाजर दिखाकर दौड़ाना — लालच देकर लटकाना
definition: manipulating hope deliberately, offering tempting promises repeatedly while keeping somebody chasing what never arrives
example: He dangled the carrot of moving cities together whenever she mentioned leaving, then changed the subject again.

hindi: छिपा रुस्तम — जिससे किसी को उम्मीद न थी
definition: an overlooked competitor succeeding unexpectedly, when almost nobody expected such narrow victory
example: The dark horse of the quiz turned out to be the librarian's quiet nephew.

hindi: दहलीज़ पर पैर रखना — अनचाहे घर आना
definition: visit an unwelcome household, arriving where nobody wants your presence again
example: After the quarrel over the boundary wall he never darkened their door again, though both families still exchanged sweets silently.

hindi: बासी कढ़ी में उबाल — देर से और अधूरी मदद
definition: arriving with help or effort after the chance already passed, offering rather less than the moment needed
example: His apology arrived day late and dollar short, taped to a wilting bunch of flowers outside her door.

hindi: हिसाब का दिन — किए कर्मों का फल भुगतने की घड़ी
definition: future moment when consequences arrive, forcing final accounting regarding earlier behaviour
example: The day of reckoning came with the examination results, and his mother simply made poha and sat beside him.

hindi: दिनदहाड़े लूट — मनमाने दाम वसूलना
definition: an outrageously expensive price that takes much more money than goods honestly deserve
example: Four hundred rupees for two cold samosas at the airport gate felt like daylight robbery.
