hindi: ठंडा पड़ जाना — बिलकुल बेजान हो जाना
definition: completely lifeless and beyond reviving, never useful again and never worth keeping
example: The torch was dead as a doornail halfway through the cave, so we finished the walk by the light of a phone.

hindi: पक्का दाँव — जीत पहले से तय मानी जाती है
definition: in British betting talk, an outcome treated as absolutely certain, especially horse expected finishing first
example: The taxi driver called the grey mare a dead cert, then spent the journey home explaining exactly what went wrong.

hindi: डूबी नैया — जिसका बचना नामुमकिन
definition: hopelessly doomed person or plan, defenceless against failure nobody believes still avoidable
example: Once the rains failed twice, the rooftop garden scheme became a dead duck, though nobody had courage telling Father directly.

hindi: ठप पड़ जाना — आगे बढ़ने की गुंजाइश न बचना
definition: something stalled completely, with hopeless prospects of moving toward success again
example: Without the second signature the adoption paperwork sat dead in the water, and they waited another winter.

hindi: खड़े-खड़े नींद आना — थकान से चूर होना
definition: utterly exhausted and barely able to stand, energy completely drained after prolonged effort
example: Dead on her feet after the night shift, she still stopped to water the tulsi.

hindi: सबूत के साथ धरा जाना — बचने का कोई रास्ता नहीं
definition: trapped completely by evidence proving guilty wrongdoing, leaving denial pointless before investigators
example: Security footage had the delivery driver dead to rights, so he apologised, refunded the missing parcels, and asked for another chance.

hindi: सूखी लकड़ी — बेकार पड़ा बोझ
definition: useless portion kept without purpose, weighing everything down until finally cleared away
example: Clearing the dead wood from the storeroom took a whole Sunday, and revealed a cricket bat nobody remembered.

hindi: किस्मत का खराब पत्ता — हालात शुरू से उलटे
definition: given unfair disadvantage from circumstances nobody chose, starting considerably behind everybody else
example: Dealt a bad hand after the floods, they rebuilt the workshop anyway, and half the lane arrived carrying borrowed tools.

hindi: अंत की आहट — विनाश निकट होने का संकेत
definition: a signal announcing certain ending, warning that final collapse arrives very soon
example: The new highway rang the death knell for the roadside diner, whose cook now feeds truckers two towns away.

hindi: घाटे में डूबा — खर्च आमदनी से ज़्यादा
definition: owing more money than earned, with accounts showing steady debt month after month
example: The bakery ran deep in the red all winter, then broke even the week the tourists returned.

term: devil and the deep blue sea
hindi: आगे कुआँ पीछे खाई — दोनों रास्ते खतरनाक
definition: forced to choose between dangers equally frightening, with nowhere safer remaining between them
example: Between the devil and the deep blue sea, the captain picked the storm over the reef and reached harbour by dawn.

hindi: गड्ढा और गहरा करना — बहानों से हालत बदतर
definition: worsen your trouble through clumsy excuses, deepening damage every further attempt
example: Each explanation dug the hole deeper until his sister mercifully changed the subject to cricket.

hindi: एड़ी जमा लेना — जिद पर अड़ जाना
definition: refuse stubbornly to change your position, resisting every pressure toward some compromise
example: Grandfather dug his heels in about the walnut tree, and the extension was redrawn around it, branch by branch.

hindi: अपनी क़ब्र ख़ुद खोदना — अपने विनाश का इंतज़ाम स्वयं करना
definition: someone steadily prepares their downfall through actions that harm themselves beyond repair
example: Every unopened letter from the landlord was another spadeful; she knew she was digging her own grave.

hindi: स्क्रीन से छुट्टी — कुछ दिन बिना फोन
definition: deliberate period without phones, screens, accounts, recovering attention, patience and proper sleep
example: Their weekend digital detox lasted until somebody needed directions, though everybody slept beautifully both nights anyway.

hindi: कौड़ियों के मोल — हर जगह मिलने वाला
definition: extremely common, available everywhere cheaply, therefore hardly valued despite constant abundance
example: Plastic combs were a dime a dozen in that market, yet she still hunted for the wooden ones.

term: dip a toe in the water
hindi: पैर की उँगली डुबोना — छोटे पैमाने पर आज़माकर देखना
definition: attempt something cautiously on a small scale before committing yourself completely
example: She dipped a toe in the water with a weekend stall before renting the little bakery on Church Street.

hindi: बुरे हाल — पैसे और सहारे बिना गंभीर संकट
definition: trapped inside serious trouble, lacking money and support, facing harsh consequences without visible remedy
example: The bakery was in dire straits after the flood until regulars started paying months ahead for their morning bread.

hindi: मिट्टी के मोल — बहुत सस्ता
definition: costing very little money, priced well below what the thing is really worth
example: Mangoes are dirt cheap in June, so the whole street smells sweet by afternoon.

hindi: चुगली करना — किसी की बदनामी वाली बातें फैलाना
definition: spread damaging private gossip about acquaintances, enjoying every unflattering detail thoroughly
example: Two neighbours dished the dirt over the shared wall until the milkman arrived and the conversation turned innocent.

hindi: हवा हो जाना — अचानक नदारद हो जाना
definition: vanish suddenly from somebody's life, avoiding contact rather than explaining departure honestly
example: He did a disappearing act before Diwali, and her mother kept setting an extra plate for two whole evenings.

hindi: चंपत हो जाना — बिना चुकाए भाग निकलना
definition: escape suddenly before payment, punishment, questioning, abandoning obligations behind, British phrasing
example: Their tenant did a runner overnight, leaving three months' rent, half a suitcase, and a kettle still faintly warm.

hindi: जेल की सज़ा काटना — कैद में वक़्त गुज़ारना
definition: serve prison punishment across months, living confined until sentenced period finishes completely
example: He never hid having done time; instead he taught carpentry behind the school, patient with every clumsy beginner.

hindi: बला टलना — बड़ी मुसीबत ऐन वक़्त पर सिर से टल जाना
definition: escape serious danger narrowly through timing rather than planning, leaving harm barely avoided
example: Their flight was cancelled an hour before the storm shut the airport, and Meera realised they had dodged a bullet.

hindi: भद्दी हालत — ऊपर से भड़कीला, अंदर बेतरतीब
definition: a British term for something botched, either messy shambles or gaudily overdressed appearance
example: The banner spelled the town wrong, so the mayor called the whole parade a proper dog's dinner.

hindi: कहानी बनाने के लिए करना — मज़े से ज़्यादा किस्सा ज़रूरी
definition: choosing chaotic decisions because they improve your life story rather than your comfort
example: He booked the overnight bus doing it for the plot, and told that miserable journey happily for years.

hindi: अरसा हो गया — बहुत लंबा समय
definition: extremely long period, British phrase covering many years without contact
example: They had not shared a meal in donkey's years, yet within minutes both were arguing about their grandmother's recipe again.

hindi: बुरी ख़बरों का चक्रव्यूह — जितना पढ़ो उतना डर
definition: endless scrolling through frightening online news, feeling worse after every miserable refresh
example: He climbed out of the doom loop at midnight, put the phone in another room, and slept better than he had all week.

hindi: जैसा किया वैसा भुगता — अपनी ही दवा का स्वाद
definition: unpleasant treatment returned upon somebody exactly as they inflicted earlier, teaching painful lesson
example: Her brother teased everyone about singing until cousins handed him a dose of his own medicine with a microphone.

hindi: सड़क पर आ जाना — सब कुछ गँवा बैठना
definition: left without money, work or shelter, unable to afford basic living expenses
example: The tailor was down and out for a season, until an old customer lent him a sewing machine.

hindi: फटेहाल — घिसी एड़ियों वाली तंगहाली
definition: shabby through poverty, wearing worn clothing that quietly reveals shrinking money
example: The bookshop looked rather down at heel, yet the owner still wrapped every purchase in brown paper and string.

hindi: हारा नहीं, थका है — गिरकर भी लड़ने लायक बचा होना
definition: beaten badly though still able to endure painful defeat and recover without surrendering
example: The little theatre lost its grant and half its actors, but the posters still went up: down but not out.

hindi: मन उतर जाना — दिल बुझा-बुझा रहना
definition: sunk into gloomy unhappy mood that lingers quietly, with spirits flat and nothing cheerful reaching through
example: She had been down in the dumps since the move, so her neighbour arrived with soup and stayed until the kitchen felt loud again.

hindi: नाली में बहा देना — पैसा और मेहनत बर्बाद
definition: effort and money wasted entirely, usually 'going down the drain', producing nothing except regret
example: Every rupee of the deposit went down the drain when the builder disappeared, and his father still keeps the receipt inside a plastic folder.

hindi: एक कड़ी से दूसरी कड़ी में खो जाना — घंटे कहाँ गए पता नहीं
definition: following link after link online until several hours vanish inside some obscure subject
example: She went down the rabbit hole looking for a recipe and surfaced knowing everything about nineteenth-century canal boats.

hindi: ज़मीन से जुड़ा — सादा और व्यवहारिक स्वभाव
definition: practical, modest, sensible about ordinary matters, never pretending greater importance than deserved
example: For somebody with three factories he stayed remarkably down to earth, queuing with everyone else at the vegetable stall.

hindi: आख़िरी दम तक — अंतिम क्षण तक अनिश्चित रहना
definition: continuing until the final moments before a deadline, undecided until time nearly expires
example: The village chess final went down to the wire, with both players hunched over the board past midnight.

hindi: कीचड़ में घसीटना — इज़्ज़त उतार देना
definition: damage somebody's reputation publicly, repeating accusations until respect disappears among listeners
example: The campaign dragged his family through the mud, and his mother stopped answering the telephone.

hindi: टालमटोल करना — जान-बूझकर धीमे चलकर काम लटकाना
definition: deliberately delaying, working slowly because someone dislikes what they must finish
example: Ravi dragged his feet over packing the flat, folding each shirt twice, because folding meant leaving and leaving meant goodbye.

hindi: दिमाग़ सुन्न हो जाना — कुछ याद न आना
definition: remember nothing whatever when questioned, memory emptying completely during important examinations
example: Standing before the history paper, Ravi drew a blank until the invigilator quietly offered him water.

hindi: बात यहीं ख़त्म — किसी प्रकरण पर पूर्ण विराम लगाना
definition: to deliberately stop an unpleasant activity, ending further involvement and treating the matter closed
example: She drew a line under the whole quarrel by inviting both brothers to lunch and refusing to mention the land.

hindi: गोलियाँ अपने ऊपर लेना — दूसरे को बचाने के लिए निशाना बनना
definition: attract concentrated criticism onto yourself, pulling hostile attention away from somebody weaker beside you
example: She drew fire deliberately at the meeting, asking the rudest question herself so the junior architect could breathe.

hindi: हद तय कर देना — यहाँ से आगे नहीं
definition: refuse firmly beyond certain point, setting limits which others must respect afterwards
example: She helped with the accounts happily, though she drew the line at answering the phone during dinner.

hindi: क़यामत ढाने वाला बनाव — कपड़ों से क़हर बरपाना
definition: wearing deliberately spectacular clothing, appearance calculated until strangers stare admiringly while passing
example: They arrived dressed to kill for a birthday that turned out involving cricket, mud, and paper plates.

hindi: सोलह सिंगार करके तैयार — पूरी सज-धज में
definition: wearing your finest clothes elaborately, groomed carefully for some important social occasion
example: Grandmother came downstairs dressed to the nines for a lunch that turned out to be four cousins and a plate of pakoras.

hindi: गच्चा खा जाना — भारी भूल भरी बात
definition: commit an embarrassing verbal blunder, British usage, saying something tactless everybody notices instantly
example: He dropped a clanger by congratulating them on retirement, then spent the evening apologising over the biscuits.

hindi: ऊँट के मुँह में जीरा — बड़ी ज़रूरत के आगे मामूली मदद
definition: tiny insufficient amount compared against enormous surrounding need, chiefly British, achieving little visible improvement
example: Their collection felt like a drop in the ocean until fourteen neighbours added theirs, which repaired the whole school roof.

hindi: गायब हो जाना — बिना बताए संपर्क तोड़ देना
definition: vanishing from somebody's attention completely, withdrawing every message without offering explanation
example: She dropped off the radar after their third date, resurfacing eight months later asking about his sister's wedding.

hindi: चूक जाना — जिम्मेदारी संभाल नहीं पाना
definition: fail through careless mistake, mishandling responsibility everybody trusted you would manage
example: He dropped the ball on the tickets, and the whole family watched the concert from a pavement screen.

hindi: रस्सी छोड़ देना — खींचातानी में हिस्सा न लेना
definition: stopping engagement completely in a pointless argument, refusing further pulling against somebody
example: Halfway through the same old argument about the thermostat she dropped the rope, made cocoa, and the evening recovered.

hindi: पीकर लुढ़क जाना — पूरी तरह नशे में धुत
definition: thoroughly intoxicated after heavy drinking, unsteady and cheerfully incapable of sense
example: The groom's friend arrived drunk as a skunk, sang three film songs badly, and slept peacefully through the ceremony.

hindi: बीच मंच पर शब्द भूल जाना — ज़बान चुप हो जाना
definition: forgetting your words completely during performance, standing silent while waiting audience watches
example: He dried up on stage during the second verse, and the whole choir carried him gently through.

hindi: सबके सामने खिल्ली उड़ाना — तालियों के लिए बेइज़्ज़ती
definition: publicly humiliate somebody online with mocking replies, harvesting applause from watching strangers
example: Rather than dunking on the beginner, he answered the question properly, and half the thread quietly calmed down.

hindi: बाज़ जैसी नज़र — बारीक़ बात पकड़ लेना
definition: noticing every small detail while watching closely, missing almost nothing
example: Under the tailor's eagle eye, nobody dared claim the two sleeves were exactly equal.

hindi: पानी पीने जितना आसान — बिलकुल सरल
definition: something achieved easily, without effort, trouble, struggle, because nothing about task feels difficult
example: Grandmother folded the paper twice, snipped once, and the paper lantern appeared, easy as pie.

hindi: आँखों को भाने वाला — देखने में सुकून देने वाली सूरत
definition: pleasantly attractive, appearance restful rather than dazzling, comfortable admiring somebody quietly
example: Their neighbour was easy on the eyes, though Amma insisted his kindness toward stray puppies mattered considerably more.

hindi: अपनी कही बात निगलना — भविष्यवाणी गलत निकलने पर पलटना
definition: retract confident statements publicly, admitting your earlier boastful prediction proved completely wrong
example: She had to eat her words when the little shop she called doomed opened a second branch across the road.

hindi: आधा सच बोलना — सच का ज़रूरी हिस्सा छिपा जाना
definition: telling technically accurate story while deliberately hiding important truthful details from listeners
example: He mentioned passing the driving test but stayed economical with the truth about the three earlier attempts.

hindi: मुँह पर कालिख — सबके सामने बेइज़्ज़ती
definition: obvious public embarrassment following confident claims that collapsed humiliatingly before witnesses
example: He had egg on his face after promising rain would hold off, standing there completely soaked.

hindi: हाथ-पैर की मेहनत — रगड़-रगड़ कर किया गया श्रम
definition: vigorous physical labour applied through tiring hours, scrubbing harder rather than buying gadgets
example: Papa insisted the brass lamps needed only tamarind paste and honest elbow grease, and by evening they threw light everywhere.

hindi: सामने का सच जिसे कोई नहीं छेड़ता — सबको पता, कोई नहीं बोलता
definition: obvious troubling problem everybody notices although nobody willingly mentions aloud
example: The empty chair beside the sweets was the elephant in the room, so relatives talked cheerfully about traffic instead.

hindi: ग्यारहवीं घड़ी — समय-सीमा से ठीक पहले का क्षण
definition: the final moments before a deadline, when remaining time nearly expires entirely
example: At the eleventh hour his brother arrived with the missing photographs, and the album was finished before the guests woke.

hindi: राजा नंगा है — सब जानते हैं, कोई कहता नहीं
definition: collective pretence about something worthless that nobody admits seeing through, until reality gets spoken aloud
example: The whole committee praised the sculpture until a child asked what part was supposed to be the horse.

hindi: सूना घोंसला — बच्चों के जाने के बाद खाली घर
definition: quiet parental household remaining after grown children leave permanently for independent living
example: They filled the empty nest with a badminton net and two rescued kittens, and pretended the noise was entirely accidental.

hindi: प्रतिक्रिया की खेती — बस टिप्पणियाँ बटोरने के लिए तमाशा
definition: posting provocative material purely to harvest replies, attention and larger audience numbers
example: Once she spotted the engagement farming behind those daily arguments, the whole account stopped being interesting.

hindi: सुलह का हाथ बढ़ाना — पहल करके शांति का प्रस्ताव देना
definition: offer a peaceful gesture toward former enemies, inviting them to settle their lingering quarrel
example: He extended an olive branch by saving the corner seat, the one they had argued about every winter.

hindi: आंखों की भूख — पेट से ज़्यादा थाली भर लेना
definition: wanting considerably more helping than appetite manages, taking beyond reasonable comfortable capacity
example: His eyes were bigger than his stomach at the buffet, and half the sweets travelled home wrapped in a napkin.

hindi: अपनी कॉपी देखो — दूसरों की रफ़्तार से मतलब नहीं
definition: chiefly American; giving attention only to personal business, progress, choices, ignoring other people
example: Every friend's wedding announcement rattled him until his sister said, kindly, eyes on your own paper.

hindi: बुझा-बुझा चेहरा — निराशा टपकती सूरत
definition: looking gloomily miserable in Irish and British usage, spoiling everybody's cheerfulness
example: Our driver had a face like a wet weekend until the road opened onto the coast, and even he admitted it looked lovely.

hindi: अंजाम भुगतना — किए का सामना करना
definition: accept unpleasant consequences openly, standing before deserved criticism about your careless earlier actions
example: He finally switched off his phone, walked into the staff room and faced the music while his cousin waited outside with the scooter.

hindi: बराबरी का मौक़ा दो — इंसाफ़ करो
definition: appeal demanding reasonable equal treatment, honest chance without hidden advantage, distinctly Australian, stretched into fair crack of the whip
example: The youngest bowler asked politely for a fair go, and the captain handed over the ball without further argument.

hindi: सुख का साथी — मुसीबत में साथ छोड़ने वाला दोस्त
definition: companion enjoying pleasant times, disappearing quietly once genuine trouble finally arrives
example: The fair-weather friends stopped visiting after the business closed, while the quiet neighbour brought vegetables every Thursday.

hindi: फुस्स हो जाना — कोई असर छोड़े बिना बेकार जाना
definition: failing badly before an audience, when a rehearsed attempt collapses into a ruined, awkward mistake
example: His carefully rehearsed toast fell flat, though his aunt kindly clapped anyway and refilled everybody's glasses to cover the silence.

hindi: नज़रों से गिरना — इज़्ज़त और रुतबा दोनों गँवा देना
definition: losing power and high standing after once being widely trusted
example: The champion's fall from grace took one careless season, and the trophy shelf gathered dust after that.

hindi: बलि का बकरा — दूसरों के गुनाह का इल्ज़ाम ढोने वाला
definition: person chosen deliberately, accepting blame plus punishment while genuine wrongdoers stay comfortably hidden
example: They needed a fall guy before the audit landed, and the newest clerk simply happened to sign that register last.

hindi: सिर के बल गिरना — किसी पर पूरी तरह मोहित हो जाना
definition: become suddenly and completely enamoured with someone, losing every ordinary defence against romantic feeling
example: He swore he would stay single until spring, then fell head over heels beside the bookshop counter.

hindi: बैठे बिठाए मिल जाना — बिना मेहनत सौभाग्य आना
definition: fortunate opportunity arriving effortlessly without planning, requiring almost nothing from yourself
example: The corner shop fell into her lap when the owner retired and remembered her kindness during monsoon.

hindi: मुँह के बल गिरना — भरोसे के साथ जाकर पिटना
definition: attempt something confidently, fail publicly, suffering embarrassing collapse before people watching closely
example: She fell flat on her face during the debate, then won the next round because everybody remembered how gracefully she recovered.

hindi: अपनी गर्दन खुद पेश करना — इस्तीफ़ा देकर दोष लेना
definition: resign honourably, accepting blame publicly so colleagues escape further punishment
example: The old editor fell on his sword after the misprint, insisting the young reporters keep their positions.

hindi: आग भड़काना — पहले से जल रहे झगड़े को और हवा देना
definition: deliberately worsen existing quarrel with provoking words that inflame conflict already burning fiercely
example: The neighbours were arguing about parking, and the chai stall regulars fanned the flames with cheerful commentary.

hindi: अपने घर जैसा लगना — पूरी तरह सहज महसूस करना
definition: completely relaxed, comfortable, unhurried within surroundings, treating unfamiliar place like personal space
example: Within an hour of arriving she was feeding their cat and making tea, feeling at home already.

hindi: टटोल कर आगे बढ़ना — हर कदम जाँच कर चलना
definition: advance slowly and cautiously, checking each step before committing yourself further
example: New to the language and the city, he felt his way through the first month one polite sentence at a time.

hindi: मन उदास होना — बिना कारण मन भारी लगना
definition: quietly sinking into mild sadness without obvious reason, feeling gloomy rather than seriously unwell
example: She was feeling blue all Sunday, so her brother put on the old film songs and made a pot of chai.

hindi: मिट्टी के पैर — पूजनीय व्यक्ति की छिपी कमज़ोरी
definition: hidden weakness spoiling someone widely admired, revealing disappointing character beneath reputation
example: Her favourite poet turned out to have feet of clay, and she loved the poems slightly more carefully afterwards.

hindi: पैर ज़मीन पर रखना — कामयाबी में भी व्यवहारिक रहना
definition: staying practical amid excitement, judging ordinary matters sensibly instead of drifting into pleasant fantasy
example: Her first film succeeded enormously, yet she kept both feet on the ground and finished her college examinations.

hindi: गिनती के, कहीं-कहीं — बहुत कम और छितरे हुए
definition: occurring rarely and scattered widely apart, leaving long empty stretches between appearances
example: Buses along that hill road are few and far between, so the shopkeeper keeps a bench outside for whoever ends up waiting.

term: few bricks shy of a load
hindi: दिमाग़ में कुछ ईंटें कम — नासमझ सा इंसान
definition: foolish person lacking sensible intelligence, thinking that seems incomplete beside ordinary judgement
example: Anyone painting a roof during monsoon seemed a few bricks shy of a load, though his terrace never leaked again.

hindi: हटते-हटते लड़ना — हार को टालने की देर तक कोशिश
definition: resist stubbornly while steadily retreating, delaying inevitable defeat rather than stopping opponents altogether
example: The old cinema fought a rearguard action for three years, selling cheaper tickets each season until the shutters stayed down.

hindi: किसी की जगह संभालना — उतनी ही ज़िम्मेदारी निभाना
definition: take over another person's position successfully, carrying responsibilities they handled before leaving
example: When the old headmaster retired, nobody quite believed the quiet science teacher could fill his shoes so calmly.

hindi: मालामाल — बेतहाशा दौलत वाला
definition: possessing enormous wealth, rich enough that money stops being something worth counting
example: The quiet uncle who repaired radios turned out to be filthy rich, with land across three districts.

hindi: खेल ख़त्म होना — अंतिम पल जब सब कुछ समाप्त हो जाता है
definition: the concluding moment marking a final ending, after which something stops continuing altogether
example: The theatre's final curtain came on a rainy Tuesday, and the ushers kept their torches as souvenirs.

hindi: आख़िरी चरण — अंतिम कुछ क़दम
definition: closing final stage where remaining strength decides outcome, British racing phrasing
example: Their fundraising reached the final furlong with barely enough donations, until the neighbourhood bakery quietly covered the shortfall.

hindi: पूरे दम से चलना — पूरी ताक़त पर प्रदर्शन
definition: performing energetically at full capacity, every part working smoothly toward strong results
example: After lunch the debate team was firing on all cylinders, and their teacher stopped taking notes just watching.

hindi: पानी से बाहर मछली — बेगानी जगह में असहज
definition: uncomfortable awkward person among unfamiliar surroundings, clearly belonging somewhere completely different
example: At the formal dinner he looked a fish out of water until another guest quietly asked him about pigeons.

hindi: तारीफ़ की भीख माँगना — बहाने से वाहवाही बटोरना
definition: inviting admiration indirectly, mentioning modest worries hoping listeners supply flattering reassurance
example: Grumbling about his cooking while everyone reached for seconds was plainly fishing for compliments, and nobody minded giving them.

hindi: चंगा-भला होना — पूरी तरह स्वस्थ
definition: enjoying excellent health, strong and energetic with nothing physically wrong anywhere
example: Fit as a fiddle at seventy, she walks the whole lake before the shops open.

hindi: हाथ-पैर जवाब दे गए — किसी काम लायक नहीं बचना
definition: weakened completely in Irish and Scottish usage, unable to manage the simplest household chores
example: The heat left him fit for nothing, so he lay under the mango tree while his daughters finished the sweeping.

hindi: प्यार की आग बुझ जाना — जोश ठंडा पड़ जाना
definition: romantic passion dying completely, leaving affection cold where excitement once burned brightly
example: Their letters thinned through autumn, and by spring the flame had gone out without either of them announcing it.

hindi: जबान चलाना — बोलते जाना, करना कुछ नहीं
definition: an American phrase meaning talking endlessly, aimless chatter accomplishing nothing anybody actually needed
example: Uncle flapped his gums about the fence repair every Sunday, while Aunt quietly bought nails and finished it herself.

hindi: जेब खाली होना — एक पैसा भी पास न होना
definition: completely without money, unable to afford even ordinary everyday expenses
example: Flat broke and cheerful, she walked eleven kilometres home and called it excellent exercise.

hindi: जुटे रहना बिना दम लिए — बेतहाशा व्यस्त
definition: working nonstop with frantic hurry, pausing never through relentless busy speed, Australian simile
example: The chai stall owner worked flat out like a lizard until the cricket crowd thinned and someone finally brought him food.

hindi: मरे घोड़े को कोड़े मारना — खत्म हो चुकी बात पर ज़ोर लगाना
definition: wasting effort upon something already finished, where continued persuasion produces nothing whatever
example: Arguing about last year's holiday photographs was flogging a dead horse, so they made tea instead.

hindi: दूध में मक्खी — छोटी खराबी जो सब बिगाड़ दे
definition: minor irritating flaw spoiling arrangement that otherwise seemed thoroughly pleasant
example: The wedding hall was perfect except for one fly in the ointment, a leaking cooler beside the sweets table.

hindi: आपे से बाहर होना — गुस्से में अचानक बिफर पड़ना
definition: suddenly lose your temper, shouting fierce anger before calmer thinking arrives
example: Dad flew off the handle when he saw the dented car, then apologised over dinner and asked how my day had gone.

hindi: दुकान से गायब — बिक्री बहुत तेज़
definition: an American phrase meaning merchandise selling remarkably quickly, shoppers emptying stock within surprisingly short hours
example: The umbrellas flew off the shelves during that grey week, and everybody suddenly remembered where the corner shop stood.

hindi: नौ दो ग्यारह होना — पिंजरा छोड़कर चुपचाप भाग निकलना
definition: sudden escape from confinement, leaving quietly without telling anyone where
example: The hostel warden checked the beds at midnight and found that three boys had flown the coop, leaving their pillows stuffed under the blankets.

hindi: घोंसला छोड़ना — बच्चों का घर छोड़कर अलग बसना
definition: leave the parental household permanently, beginning independent adult living somewhere else
example: The younger sister flew the nest in August, and her mother still cooked enough rice for four people until December.

hindi: मुँह से झाग निकलना — गुस्से में बेकाबू होना
definition: wildly furious in appearance, ranting with visible anger that alarms bystanders
example: The commentator was practically foaming at the mouth about the referee, while his co-host calmly poured himself water.

hindi: ताश के पत्तों की तरह ढह जाना — दबाव में तुरंत हार मान लेना
definition: surrender immediately under pressure, abandoning your stated position without offering serious resistance
example: The captain promised to argue about the fielding order, then folded like a cheap suit when his mother mentioned dinner.

hindi: भेड़चाल में चलना — बिना सोचे भीड़ के पीछे
definition: copy popular opinion without thinking, joining crowds merely because everybody else already went
example: Instead of following the herd towards the famous stall, they tried the quiet corner shop and ate wonderfully.

hindi: बेकार का काम — जिसमें कुछ हासिल नहीं होता
definition: pointless effort pursuing something impossible to finish, wasting time from beginning
example: Sending a child to borrow left-handed scissors from the neighbours was, everyone knew, a gentle fool's errand.

hindi: पीतल को सोना समझना — जो क़ीमती लगे पर निकले बेकार
definition: something looking impressive valuable that actually proves worthless hollow disappointment afterwards
example: He hunted rare coins all winter, and the jeweller gently explained that his prize find was fool's gold.

hindi: पैर जमाने की जगह — शुरुआती छोटा मौका
definition: small initial opening into an opportunity, allowing gradual deeper entry afterwards
example: Teaching two neighbourhood children gave her a foot in the door, and three years later the whole lane sent theirs.

hindi: बेफ़िक्र और आज़ाद — किसी बंधन या ज़िम्मेदारी से मुक्त
definition: free from commitments and responsibilities, able to wander and choose without restriction
example: At twenty he was footloose and fancy free, sleeping on trains and deciding each destination by whichever platform announcement sounded prettiest.

hindi: कौड़ियों के मोल — बेहद सस्ते में मिलना
definition: sold at a surprisingly cheap price, costing much less money than the thing is worth
example: She bought the rosewood desk for a song at a closing-down sale and polished it every Sunday.

hindi: बस तस्वीर के लिए — स्वाद बाद में, फोटो पहले
definition: arranged purely to photograph beautifully online rather than genuinely enjoyed while happening
example: They stacked the pancakes for the gram, photographed them twice, then ate everything cold and perfectly happy.

hindi: वर्जित फल — मना किया गया, इसलिए और लुभावना
definition: tempting pleasure that becomes desirable precisely because rules forbid enjoying anything
example: Late night television became forbidden fruit after the rule arrived, and the volume knob learned marvellous subtlety.

hindi: माफ़ करके भूल जाना — मन में मैल न रखना
definition: pardon a past wrong until the grievance fades, keeping resentment and blame from lingering afterwards
example: Her grandmother could forgive and forget faster than anyone, which is why the house stayed full of visitors.

hindi: राह का दोराहा — चुनाव का मोड़
definition: moment demanding choice between separate directions, each leading somewhere entirely different
example: The scholarship letter arrived like a fork in the road, and the family discussed it over dinner until midnight.

hindi: खुली छूट — मनमानी करने की पूरी आज़ादी
definition: complete freedom to decide and choose without restriction, supervision, or interference
example: The old painter gave his student free rein with the back wall, and by evening it had turned into a garden of impossible birds.

hindi: मुँह फेर लेना — बिना कहे दूरी बना लेना
definition: deliberately withdraw warmth entirely, ignoring someone until they understand rejection
example: After the argument beside the tea stall she froze him out completely, greeting everyone else and looking straight through him.

hindi: अपनों की मार — मदद करनेवालों से पहुँचा नुक़सान
definition: damage inflicted accidentally by your own allies, criticism arriving from people supposedly supporting you
example: His cousin's proud speech about the failed bakery attempt was pure friendly fire, and the whole table winced together.

term: from the bottom of your heart
hindi: दिल की गहराई से — पूरी सच्चाई के साथ
definition: speaking with completely genuine private feeling, thanking someone sincerely without polite exaggeration
example: She thanked the neighbours from the bottom of her heart, remembering every night they had watched the children.

hindi: पूरा टून — बहुत ज़्यादा पिया हुआ
definition: extremely drunk in Irish usage, staggering happily homeward after hours spent drinking
example: He arrived at the door full as a bingo bus, singing softly, and his mother handed him bread and left the lecture until morning.

hindi: जोश से भरा — चंचल और चुस्त
definition: bursting with cheerful restless energy, chattering happily without settling quietly anywhere
example: The children came back from the mango orchard full of beans, and nobody slept until well past midnight.

hindi: गप्पी — खोखली डींगें हाँकने वाला
definition: loudly boastful, producing empty talk that carries almost nothing of real substance
example: The new landlord was full of hot air about repairs, but the tap kept dripping all winter.

hindi: हाथ आया मौका गँवा देना — लापरवाही से नुकसान
definition: waste a golden opportunity through careless mistake, losing rewards already within reach
example: She had the scholarship almost signed and fumbled the bag by missing the final interview email.

hindi: बढ़त बनाना — फ़ासला घटाना
definition: advance steadily, closing the distance between yourself and whoever leads ahead
example: The younger runner gained ground on every bend, and the crowd along the canal started shouting her name.

hindi: धूल खाना — पड़े-पड़े बेकार होते रहना
definition: postponed and neglected, sitting untouched while everyone keeps promising attention later
example: His father's harmonium gathered dust behind the almirah until a neighbour's daughter asked, shyly, whether anyone still played it.

hindi: बच निकलना — बड़ी गलती पर भी सज़ा न मिलना
definition: escape punishment entirely despite serious wrongdoing, because nobody bothers holding wrongdoers accountable
example: The youngest grandchild gets away with murder because Nani laughs before she remembers she meant to scold him.

hindi: असली बात पर आना — काम की ठोस बातें करना
definition: abandon vague pleasantries, discussing practical essential details before deciding anything further
example: Once the samosas were finished they finally got down to brass tacks about repairing the leaking terrace.

hindi: गाँठ बँधना — बिना तामझाम शादी कर लेना
definition: marry your partner casually, accepting lifelong commitment without elaborate expensive ceremony
example: They got hitched at the registry office on a Tuesday and celebrated with dosas afterwards.

hindi: मन की भड़ास निकालना — दबी बात कहकर हल्का हो जाना
definition: confess troubling secrets aloud, releasing feelings that long silence pressed steadily harder upon a tired conscience
example: She had rehearsed the apology on the whole bus ride, and getting it off her chest took only nine seconds.

hindi: बाल भी बाँका न होना — बिना किसी सज़ा छूट जाना
definition: escape punishment completely after wrongdoing, walking away without penalty, payment, blemish, blame
example: Both drivers argued for twenty minutes, then the tempo owner got off scot-free because nobody could find the broken mirror.

term: get off to a flying start
hindi: शानदार शुरुआत करना — पहले ही कदम पर आगे निकल जाना
definition: begin brilliantly quickly, gaining early momentum that leaves rivals trailing behind
example: Their little bakery got off to a flying start, because three neighbours smelled the cardamom buns and told everybody else.

term: get on like a house on fire
hindi: खूब पटरी बैठना — तुरंत गहरी दोस्ती
definition: become extremely friendly with somebody quickly, British usage, sharing constant warm agreement and endless conversation
example: The grandmothers got on like a house on fire, and their grandchildren waited an hour beside the parked cars.

hindi: हाथ से निकल जाना — काबू से बाहर होना
definition: situation escalating beyond anyone's control, spreading trouble faster than sensible people manage handling
example: The cricket match between cousins got out of hand around the third broken window, so lunch was declared immediately.

hindi: गाड़ी चला देना — काम की शुरुआत कर देना
definition: begin proceedings promptly, creating momentum others follow once initial hesitation disappears
example: Somebody had to get the ball rolling, so Chinni stood first and sang badly, after which everyone happily volunteered.

hindi: हूटिंग झेलना — दर्शकों की फटकार
definition: receive loud audience jeering during performance, British theatre slang describing hostile reception
example: The magician got the bird when the rabbit strolled out early, then won everybody back completely.

hindi: अचानक अरुचि होना — पसंद का घिन में बदल जाना
definition: suddenly feel physical revulsion toward someone previously attractive, losing romantic desire completely
example: She got the ick watching him argue with the auto driver over five rupees, and somehow the evening never recovered.

term: get the wrong end of the stick
hindi: उल्टा समझना — बात का ठीक विपरीत अर्थ निकालना
definition: understanding a situation completely backwards, holding a mistaken version of what somebody actually meant
example: He heard "we should talk" and packed his desk; his manager had the wrong end of the stick pointed out to her only later, over apologies.

hindi: पकड़ में आना — मुश्किल काम समझने लगना
definition: begin understanding difficult material properly, chiefly British, handling complicated demands after confused early attempts
example: By March he had got to grips with the new syllabus, and his mother stopped hiding the report cards.

hindi: अपनी हालत सुधारना — बिखरा काम व्यवस्थित करना
definition: become organised competent again, ending careless muddle before serious trouble arrives
example: After losing two library books he finally got his act together, buying a proper shelf and labelling everything hopefully.

hindi: किए की सज़ा मिलना — हिसाब आख़िर बराबर होता है
definition: finally suffer deserved punishment, consequences arriving after long unpunished misbehaviour
example: The neighbour who parked across everybody's gate finally got his comeuppance when the council arrived with a clipboard.

hindi: बात का उल्टा मतलब निकलना — ग़लतफ़हमी हो जाना
definition: small misunderstanding between people who each expected something different from arrangement
example: Both brothers waited an hour, one outside the station, one inside; they had got their wires crossed again.

hindi: बिना बताए गायब हो जाना — संपर्क अचानक तोड़ देना
definition: vanish from someone's messages permanently, ending romantic contact without explanation
example: He ghosted her after four lovely weeks, and her sister quietly deleted the restaurant booking without mentioning it again.

hindi: वाक्पटुता — बोलने की सहज कला
definition: natural talent for endless charming talk that holds every listener with easy words
example: Grandpa had the gift of the gab; strangers at the bus stand would miss two buses listening to him.

hindi: कमर कस लेना — मुश्किल का सामना करने को तैयार होना
definition: prepare yourself for approaching trouble, gathering courage before difficulty arrives
example: She girded her loins outside the ward, took one long breath, and pushed the door open smiling.

hindi: पूरी जान लगा देना — कुछ बाक़ी न रखना
definition: commit complete effort without holding anything back, working with total dedication
example: He gave a hundred percent during the school relay and collapsed grinning onto the grass while his mother clapped.

hindi: दूर से सलाम — झगड़ालू व्यक्ति से दूरी बनाए रखना
definition: keep deliberate distance from someone troublesome, avoiding every chance of angry confrontation
example: Vendors gave the parking inspector a wide berth, suddenly very busy whenever his scooter turned the corner.

hindi: लेन-देन का रिश्ता — आपसी समझौते से निभाना
definition: the mutual concessions that allow both sides to reach a workable compromise instead of demanding everything
example: Thirty years of marriage taught them that give and take beats winning any single argument.

hindi: एक हाथ आज़मा लो — कोशिश करके देखो
definition: attempt something cheerfully, trying willingly without expecting brilliant immediate success, distinctly Australian phrasing
example: She had never thrown a boomerang, but gave it a burl anyway while the children shouted advice from behind.

hindi: मेरा सिर मत खा — लगातार परेशान करने पर झुंझलाना
definition: begging somebody pestering constantly to stop, Northern Irish plea against relentless complaining
example: Give my head peace, said their father from behind the newspaper, though he was already reaching for the car keys.

hindi: चकमा देकर निकल जाना — पीछा करने वाले को गच्चा देना
definition: sudden quiet escape from somebody following you, leaving them behind without warning
example: She gave the photographers the slip by walking calmly through the hotel kitchen and out into a lane that smelled of frying onions.

hindi: पोल खुल जाना — मुँह से भेद निकल जाना
definition: reveal a secret plan carelessly, letting hidden intentions escape before the chosen moment arrives
example: Dad had guarded the puppy secret for a week, then asked at dinner whether anyone had bought a leash yet, and gave the game away.

hindi: अंदर की बात बताना — असली किस्सा खोलकर सुनाना
definition: share confidential background details about someone, telling gossip that explains their hidden situation
example: Over samosas, the office peon gave her the lowdown on why the transfer list kept changing, and suddenly the rumours made sense.

hindi: बात करना बंद कर देना — नाराज़गी में चुप्पी साधना
definition: punish someone through deliberate silence, refusing conversation instead of explaining your actual grievance
example: Grandmother gave her son the silent treatment across four whole meals, passing him rotis without once meeting his eyes.

hindi: दम तोड़ देना — शरीर छोड़कर चल बसना
definition: to release a final breath and pass away, when the slow dying of a person quietly finishes
example: He gave up the ghost on a Sunday morning, an hour after the family had finished singing the hymn he asked for.

hindi: रेंगती हुई रफ़्तार — इतनी धीमी प्रगति कि दिखाई ही न दे
definition: progress unfolding painfully slowly, with barely visible movement across long stretches
example: The garden wall rose at a glacial pace, one row of bricks each Sunday, and somehow that made him love it more.

hindi: जश्न वाले कपड़े — खास मौके की पोशाक
definition: finest festive clothes saved carefully, worn only while celebrating some special evening
example: Father dug his glad rags out of the trunk, smelling faintly of naphthalene, and declared himself ready for the wedding.

hindi: निखर जाना — रूप और आत्मविश्वास दोनों बदल जाना
definition: striking transformation improving appearance and confidence, dressing better after quietly rebuilding yourself
example: Nobody recognised him at the reunion, and he enjoyed explaining that the glow up cost mostly sleep and swimming.

hindi: स्क्रीन से चिपका हुआ — नज़र हटती ही नहीं
definition: unable to look away from a glowing screen, ignoring everybody sitting nearby for hours
example: The whole family stayed glued to the screen until Grandmother carried the tea tray in and drew the curtains open.

hindi: सारा दाँव लगा देना — कुछ भी बचाकर नहीं रखना
definition: commit every resource toward single risky attempt, keeping nothing whatever back afterwards
example: She went all in on the little bakery, selling even her scooter, and the first week's queue reached the tailor's shop.

hindi: पूरी ताक़त झोंक देना — कुछ बचाकर नहीं रखना
definition: commit maximum effort beyond ordinary limits, holding nothing back while attempting something difficult
example: They went all out for the school function, painting backdrops until midnight while somebody's father kept supplying lemon tea.

hindi: भड़क जाना — गुस्से में फट पड़ना
definition: lose your temper suddenly, shouting violent anger that frightens everyone standing nearby
example: Uncle went ballistic during the cricket match, waving both arms at the television while the dog watched him with mild concern.

hindi: दिवाला निकलना — कारोबार पूरी तरह ठप हो जाना
definition: a business collapses completely, unable to repay money owed, leaving nobody with anything
example: The corner bakery went belly up in January, and the neighbours still glance at the papered windows every morning.

hindi: दिल ठंडा पड़ जाना — पहले जैसी गर्मजोशी न रहना
definition: lose romantic warmth toward someone gradually, becoming distant instead of affectionate
example: He had gone cold on her without announcing it, and his cousin noticed the empty chair beside him at every wedding function.

hindi: गायब हो जाना — संपर्क बंद कर देना
definition: vanish from messages and screens deliberately, staying offline while nobody reaches you
example: Ritu went dark for a fortnight before the exams, leaving only her mother with the hostel landline number.

hindi: धूम‑धड़ाके से मुँह की खाना — सबके सामने बुरी तरह नाकाम
definition: collapse spectacularly before witnesses, suffering public failure instead of failing quietly behind closed doors
example: His confident magic act went down in flames when the pigeon refused to leave the hat, though the children clapped anyway.

term: go down like a lead balloon
hindi: बात बिल्कुल नहीं चली — ढेला पानी में
definition: fail embarrassingly before an audience, British usage, greeted with silence rather than approving laughter
example: His opening joke went down like a lead balloon, so he abandoned the speech and simply thanked everybody.

hindi: सब कुछ दांव पर लगा देना — बचाव के लिए कुछ भी न बचाना
definition: commit every remaining resource toward single risky attempt, keeping nothing safe should everything collapse
example: With four minutes left and nothing to defend, the coach pulled his keeper forward and told the bench they were going for broke.

hindi: अकेले दम पर चलना — बिना साथी के काम संभालना
definition: attempt something independently, without partners, help, or support from other people
example: Everyone advised her to find a partner for the bakery, but she decided to go it alone and opened at five every morning.

hindi: धुआँधार चलना — ज़ोरदार कामयाबी
definition: an American phrase meaning business booming rapidly, sudden success arriving beyond every careful expectation
example: Their little taco window went like gangbusters once the delivery drivers started recommending it to each other.

hindi: अधकचरी तैयारी से कूद पड़ना — बिना सोचे शुरू कर देना
definition: acting hastily before preparations finish, starting without thinking the whole plan through
example: They went off half-cocked with the picnic, arriving at the lake with blankets, guitars, and absolutely nothing edible.

hindi: पटरी से उतरना — योजना बेकाबू होकर बिगड़ना
definition: plans losing control completely, spreading trouble everywhere while heading toward obvious approaching disaster
example: The wedding schedule went off the rails before breakfast, and somehow everybody remembers that morning most fondly.

hindi: गुड़ गोबर हो जाना — बनी बनाई बात बिगड़ जाना
definition: turning badly wrong partway through, when careful arrangements collapse into a ruined, confusing mistake
example: The picnic went pear-shaped around noon: rain, a punctured tyre, and a cake nobody had remembered to bring.

hindi: अंत तक डटे रहना — आख़िरी पड़ाव तक पहुँचना
definition: persevering through hardship until the finish, continuing despite exhaustion and repeated painful setbacks
example: He had trained for eleven months, and at the thirty-eighth kilometre he decided he would go the distance, walking if needed.

hindi: एक कदम और बढ़कर करना — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा मेहनत
definition: make additional effort beyond whatever duty requires, helping further than anyone expected
example: The rickshaw driver went the extra mile and carried her suitcase upstairs, then waved away the extra twenty rupees.

term: go the way of the dodo
hindi: इतिहास बन जाना — चलन से पूरी तरह लुप्त हो जाना
definition: to vanish into extinction, becoming completely outdated until nothing remains useful worth keeping
example: Handwritten telegrams went the way of the dodo, though my uncle keeps one framed above his desk.

hindi: पूरा ही कर डालना — आधा-अधूरा नहीं, सब कुछ
definition: commit completely rather than partially, accepting entire expense instead of cautious halfway measure
example: They meant to repaint only the hallway, then went the whole hog and gave every room a different quiet colour.

hindi: रस्म निभाना — दिल लगाए बिना ऊपरी तौर पर करना
definition: perform required actions listlessly without genuine involvement, skipping proper commitment entirely
example: He went through the motions at morning yoga, stretching whenever the instructor looked, dreaming steadily about breakfast parathas.

hindi: ज़मीन में समा जाना — नज़रों से बिलकुल गायब हो जाना
definition: disappear completely into hiding, avoiding attention until searching people finally lose interest in finding you
example: After borrowing the scooter without asking, our cousin went to ground at his friend's farm for a whole fortnight.

hindi: टूट जाना — भीतर से बिखरकर सँभल न पाना
definition: someone collapses emotionally, unable to cope, sinking toward the lowest reaches of despair
example: She went to pieces during the speech, and her brother finished reading the letter aloud for her.

hindi: धुएँ में उड़ जाना — मेहनत बेकार हो जाना
definition: collapse completely after careful effort, leaving plans destroyed with nothing useful remaining anywhere
example: Two years of savings for the wedding hall went up in smoke when the builder vanished, so the family married under a borrowed tent instead.

hindi: आग की तरह फैल जाना — रातोंरात हर जगह पहुँच जाना
definition: spread suddenly across countless screens, gathering enormous attention within remarkably brief hours
example: The clip of her grandfather dancing went viral overnight, and he began receiving telephone calls from forgotten schoolfriends.

hindi: घुटने काँप जाना — किसी के आकर्षण से सुध-बुध खोना
definition: become suddenly overwhelmed by romantic feeling for someone, losing ordinary composure completely
example: He had rehearsed a calm hello, but went weak at the knees the moment she waved.

hindi: बहाव के साथ बहना — जैसा चले वैसा मान लेना
definition: accept whatever popular crowd decides calmly, joining arrangements rather than arguing about plans
example: The itinerary collapsed by noon, so they went with the flow and spent the afternoon feeding temple monkeys.

hindi: सरपट भागना — बेकाबू रफ़्तार से दौड़ना
definition: racing along wildly with frantic reckless speed, hurrying nonstop without caution, Australian simile
example: The puppy went like a cut snake around the yard until it collapsed against the water bowl, thoroughly satisfied.

hindi: सुनहरा दौर — बीता हुआ खुशहाल ज़माना
definition: earlier period remembered as unusually prosperous flourishing happy, seemingly better than everything since
example: They call those radio evenings the golden age, mostly because everyone gathered around the same small table.

hindi: ख़त्म हो गया — नष्ट, या दुनिया से गया
definition: destroyed beyond repair in British wartime slang, sometimes describing somebody's death
example: The kettle finally went for a burton, and the whole office observed a respectful minute beside the sink.

hindi: सब चौपट — योजना पूरी तरह गड़बड़
definition: describing plans thoroughly wrong in Cockney rhyming slang, ruining whatever everybody arranged
example: Halfway through the bake the oven quit, and Mum announced cheerfully that pudding had gone Pete Tong.

hindi: बर्बाद हो गया — अच्छी चीज़ धीरे-धीरे चौपट
definition: once decent, slowly deteriorated through neglect until British speakers consider something hopeless
example: The tennis club had gone to pot, though nobody minded because the kettle still worked beautifully.

hindi: बरबाद हो जाना — देखभाल बिना बिगड़ जाना
definition: declined slowly through neglect, losing earlier good condition after years without proper care
example: The rest house had gone to seed, though the caretaker still swept the veranda every single morning.

hindi: ज़ुबान का पक्का — कहा हुआ हमेशा निभाने वाला
definition: completely reliable, honest, always keeping promises exactly, without excuses, delays, reminders
example: He said the bicycle would be repaired before Sunday, and was good as his word, chain oiled and bell polished.

hindi: भला आदमी — नेक और भरोसेमंद
definition: chiefly British: thoroughly decent dependable person, kindly reliable company whom everybody trusts instinctively
example: The landlord turned out a good egg, fixing the boiler himself and leaving marmalade beside the note.

hindi: नेकदिल अजनबी — बिना स्वार्थ मदद करने वाला
definition: generous stranger helping injured people without expecting reward, thanks, later recognition
example: Some good Samaritan pushed their stalled scooter half a kilometre uphill and waved away every offer of money.

hindi: तमाशा देखने बैठ जाना — मज़ा लेना
definition: settle happily watching somebody else's argument unfold, treating drama purely entertainment
example: When the two committees started emailing each other, everybody else grabbed the popcorn and stopped replying.

hindi: ज़मीनी स्तर — आम लोगों का आधार
definition: ordinary people forming firmly rooted base of movement, deciding matters locally rather than centrally
example: The library reopened because grass roots neighbours collected signatures outside the temple every Sunday morning for months.

hindi: मुफ़्त की मलाई — बिना मेहनत लगातार कमाई
definition: comfortable arrangement producing generous money effortlessly, continuing longer than anybody honestly deserves
example: The rental sheds beside the highway were a gravy train until the bypass opened and the lorries stopped coming.

hindi: हाथ गरम करना — घूस देकर काम निकलवाना
definition: offer secret payment persuading somebody official toward ignoring rules, granting improper favours
example: Uncle insisted greasing that peon's palm would speed matters, though Amma got the certificate anyway simply arriving early.

hindi: पहिये में तेल देना — काम पहले से आसान बनाना
definition: smooth difficult arrangements beforehand, quietly making later cooperation easier through helpful preparation
example: A tray of samosas greased the wheels considerably, and the committee approved their courtyard repairs before evening.

hindi: चेहरा पीला पड़ जाना — मिचली से बदहाल दिखना
definition: visibly unwell and queasy, pale with nausea and passing sickness before actual vomiting
example: Ten minutes into the ferry ride my brother went green around the gills and hugged the railing.

hindi: हरी झंडी — भरोसे लायक होने का लक्षण
definition: reassuring behaviour revealing somebody trustworthy, signalling healthy promise inside future relationship
example: He remembered her mother's medicine timings without being asked, which her sister declared an enormous green flag.

hindi: हरी कोंपलें — सुधार के शुरुआती संकेत
definition: early visible signs showing recovery beginning, growth returning quietly after difficult decline
example: Two customers on Tuesday, four on Wednesday, and the shopkeeper allowed himself to call them green shoots.

hindi: जलन से जलना — दूसरे की तरक्की चुभना
definition: openly resentful about another person's fortune, wanting their advantages painfully instead of celebrating
example: The whole colony went green with envy over their new balcony garden, then asked politely for cuttings.

hindi: ईर्ष्या का कीड़ा — मन कुतरती जलन
definition: jealousy imagined as creature devouring somebody quietly, breeding resentment about another person's happiness
example: The green-eyed monster stirred when his friend's promotion arrived, though he clapped loudest at the celebration.

hindi: धुँधला मामला — जहाँ नियम साफ़ नहीं
definition: uncertain territory where rules remain unclear, making decisions difficult because guidance never settles matters, spelled gray area American
example: Whether cricket counted as homework became a grey area, negotiated nightly between father, mother and bowler.

hindi: हँसकर सह लेना — जो टल नहीं सकता उसे बिना शिकायत झेलना
definition: endure unpleasant difficulty without complaint, continuing calmly while the pressure remains
example: Our seats were right beside the engine, so we grinned and bore it for nine hours and slept in Kanpur.

hindi: मुँह फाड़कर मुस्कुराना — रहस्यमय चौड़ी हँसी
definition: smiling broadly, delighted about something private, showing happiness that slightly unsettles watching people
example: She grinned like a Cheshire cat throughout dinner, and only while serving kheer admitted she had bought the scooter.

hindi: कान तक मुस्कान — चेहरा खिल उठना
definition: beaming with delighted happiness, cheerful expression spreading across your whole face without any restraint
example: He came off the stage grinning from ear to ear, still clutching the borrowed guitar like something rescued.

hindi: कान तक मुस्कान — चौड़ी संतुष्ट हँसी
definition: smiling broadly with obvious satisfaction, delighted and cheerful because something secretly pleases you
example: She came back from the interview grinning like a Cheshire cat and refused to explain anything until everyone had eaten.

hindi: दाँत भींचकर सहना — तकलीफ चुपचाप झेल लेना
definition: endure something painful with silent determination rather than showing distress to everyone watching
example: The physiotherapist bent his knee another degree and Rafiq gritted his teeth, counting the ceiling tiles until it passed.

hindi: गाड़ी अटका देना — चलती व्यवस्था जाम कर देना
definition: obstruct smoothly running arrangements, clogging steady progress until nothing continues properly
example: One missing signature gummed up the works for weeks, though the clerk kept offering tea and honest sympathy.

hindi: मन की आवाज़ — भीतर से उठा अनकहा फ़ैसला
definition: senses hidden truth through instinct alone, trusting judgement that careful reasoning cannot explain
example: Every paper checked out, yet a gut feeling kept him from signing that afternoon.

hindi: हल्की चढ़ी हुई — थोड़ा नशे में
definition: mildly drunk in Irish and British usage, cheerful and unsteady without collapsing completely
example: Half cut and delighted with himself, uncle insisted on carrying the cake, so somebody quietly walked beside him the whole way.

hindi: अधूरी बात — असली पूरा सच छिपा हुआ
definition: incomplete partial account hiding important details listeners genuinely deserve knowing
example: The broken window was half the story, and the cricket bat behind the sofa quietly supplied the remainder.

hindi: ओवर एक्टिंग करना — जान-बूझकर बढ़ाकर निभाना
definition: acting with deliberately exaggerated gestures, overplaying performance until audience notices somebody pretending
example: Grandfather hammed it up during the storytelling, clutching his chest until every child shrieked happily.

hindi: मिले हुए होना — गहरी साँठगाँठ
definition: working together closely, cooperating almost secretly toward shared purposes others cannot separate
example: The baker and the milkman worked hand in glove, so nobody in the lane ever ran short before breakfast.

hindi: चोरी करते हुए ऐन मौके पर पकड़ा जाना
definition: situation where somebody stealing quietly gets discovered mid-theft, evidence gripped between guilty fingers
example: The treasurer was found with his hand in the cookie jar during the temple audit, and nobody spoke through the entire evening.

hindi: रोज़ कमाना रोज़ खाना — बचत के बिना गुज़ारा
definition: spending whatever money arrives immediately, keeping nothing saved against later shortage
example: He grew up hand to mouth, which is why he still tucks half of every paycheck away.

hindi: उतरन — बड़े भाई-बहन के पुराने कपड़े
definition: worn secondhand clothing inherited from older siblings, passed downward through family instead of buying
example: Her winter coat was a hand-me-down from three cousins, and each of them had sewn a different button on.

hindi: फूँक-फूँक कर पेश आना — बहुत नरमी से संभालना
definition: treat someone gently, keeping them sheltered from hardship, difficulty, and blunt truth
example: After the funeral everyone decided to handle their youngest sister with kid gloves, hiding the unpaid bills until spring.

hindi: हाथ बँधे होना — मजबूरी में कुछ न कर पाना
definition: lacking authority completely, unable to control matters although willing, prevented by rules
example: The clerk's hands were tied by paperwork, though he quietly explained which office might listen sooner.

hindi: खेल-खेल में — बिना ज़ोर लगाए जीत जाना
definition: winning easily without effort or struggle, because nobody else came anywhere close
example: Her mother's mango pickle won the neighbourhood tasting hands down, again.

hindi: हिम्मत बाँधे रखना — मुश्किल में डटे रहना
definition: continuing bravely through hardship, persevering with effort despite discouraging setbacks and lengthening delay
example: His sister taped a note to the mirror before the results week, just two words telling him to hang in there.

hindi: बीच मझधार छोड़ देना — अकेला फँसा देना
definition: abandon somebody publicly, letting shame reach them while withholding defence, support or explanation
example: His co-host went quiet during the interview, hanging him out to dry while the questions kept coming.

hindi: जूते टाँग देना — लंबे करियर से हमेशा के लिए विदा लेना
definition: abandon a long career permanently, leaving that familiar work behind after many years
example: After thirty seasons of coaching muddy under-elevens, Uncle Sanjay hung up his boots and took the whistle home as a keepsake.

hindi: जान पर बनी होना — बाल बराबर आसरे पर टिका होना
definition: surviving precariously close to death, where slight worsening would finish a barely holding life
example: For two nights his recovery was hanging by a thread, and the whole ward learned to read the nurse's face.

hindi: हाल बेहाल — थका और उतरा हुआ दिखना
definition: looking wretchedly exhausted in Irish usage, hungover after night without sleep
example: The lads arrived hanging out of themselves after the overnight bus, and their host wisely offered breakfast before conversation.

hindi: मस्त और बेफ़िक्र — अपनी दुनिया में पूरी तरह खुश
definition: quietly delighted with comfortable surroundings, showing contented happiness without wanting anything further, chiefly American
example: Give him a shaded verandah chair and yesterday's newspaper and he stays happy as a clam until somebody mentions lunch.

hindi: मस्त-मौला — बेफ़िक्र और पूरी तरह ख़ुश
definition: a British simile describing somebody delighted, thoroughly pleased with modest surroundings
example: Give Grandad a deckchair, thermos and crossword and he sits there happy as Larry until sunset.

hindi: पत्थर दिल — सख़्त और बेरहम
definition: physically tough and emotionally unsentimental, showing little visible sympathy toward weakness
example: The coach was hard as nails during practice, then bought everybody sugarcane juice and pretended it never happened.

hindi: रिश्ते का खुला ऐलान — तस्वीर डालकर सबको बता देना
definition: announcing your relationship publicly with unmistakable photographs, revealing your partner without earlier hints
example: Her hard launch arrived without warning on Diwali morning, and forty relatives commented before she had finished breakfast.

hindi: कड़ी मेहनत — पसीना बहाने वाला काम
definition: heavy exhausting physical labour, tiring effort demanding genuine sweat daily, distinctly Australian phrasing
example: Digging the bore was hard yakka, so the family fed everyone rotis and jaggery until the last shovel stopped.

hindi: मेहनत की घिसाई — लगातार कठिन परिश्रम
definition: unglamorous sustained effort (Australian) earning slow progress through genuinely difficult work
example: Nobody photographed the hard yards behind that garden, only the roses, though her hands remembered every monsoon.

hindi: दिमाग़ का पेच ढीला — कुछ सनकी बरताव
definition: behave in slightly unhinged fashion, showing eccentric thinking without sensible ordinary judgement
example: Neighbours said the beekeeper had a screw loose, then queued politely whenever his honey appeared at the gate.

hindi: बुरी तरह आशिक़ होना — नींद तक उड़ जाना
definition: suffer helpless romantic longing, thinking constantly about somebody whose affection stays uncertain
example: He had it bad for her from the first monsoon week, agreeing to badminton every evening despite hating badminton.

hindi: भेजे में भूसा भरा होना — दिमाग़ में अक्ल न होना
definition: behave like a foolish person lacking intelligence and ordinary common judgement
example: Selling a working scooter to buy a broken motorcycle, Ravi's mother said, means having rocks in your head.

hindi: साथ खड़े रहना — मुश्किल में किसी का पूरा साथ देना
definition: loyally supporting someone through trouble, ready defending them whenever serious difficulty arrives
example: When the landlord shouted about the broken window, Meera stepped forward and said quietly that she had her brother's back.

term: have your cake and eat it
hindi: दोनों हाथों में लड्डू — दोनों फ़ायदे साथ चाहना
definition: wanting both incompatible advantages together, refusing whichever sacrifice sensible choice clearly demands
example: He wanted the hostel freedom and his mother's cooking, which is having your cake and eating it, as his father gently noted.

hindi: मज़ाक उड़ाना — मसखरी में कही बात, गंभीर नहीं
definition: joking around, teasing somebody playfully in British usage rather than speaking seriously
example: When Grandad announced he was learning skateboarding we assumed he was having a laugh, until the helmet arrived.

hindi: इक्कीस पड़ना — बाक़ी सबसे साफ़ तौर पर बेहतर
definition: clearly better than everyone else in the group, standing above them in quality
example: Her essay was head and shoulders above the rest, and the examiner said so aloud.

hindi: जान बचाकर भागना — सिर पर पैर रखकर भागना
definition: escape hurriedly, leaving approaching trouble behind rather than remaining somewhere dangerous
example: The moment their landlord appeared with a clipboard, the whole cricket team headed for the hills, leaving one bat behind.

hindi: ख़्यालों में खोया रहना — हवाई किले बनाना
definition: daydreaming unrealistically, ignoring practical details while imagining impossible pleasant futures
example: Her brother had his head in the clouds again, planning a mountain cafe while ignoring the leaking tap.

hindi: दिमाग ठिकाने पर — समझदार और व्यावहारिक
definition: thinking sensibly about practical trouble, judging situations calmly without foolish excitement (British)
example: Everyone trusted the youngest sister with the shop money because she clearly had her head screwed on.

hindi: कानोंकान खबर मिलना — अफ़वाह के ज़रिए पता चलना
definition: learn private news through informal gossip, before anybody official announces anything
example: We heard it on the grapevine that the school was closing early, so the whole lane planned an afternoon picnic.

hindi: उड़ती-उड़ती खबर सुनना — अफ़वाह से पता चलना
definition: learn news through informal gossip chains, also heard "on the grapevine", rather than official announcement
example: She heard on the grapevine about the transfer, and had already congratulated him before the letter came.

hindi: दिल बैठ जाना — हिम्मत टूट जाना
definition: spirits sunk into gloomy dread, unhappy expectation weighing every thought before anything actually happens
example: She walked into the results hall with her heart in her boots, and walked out grinning at a number she had not dared hope for.

hindi: दिल का सोना — ऊपर से रूखा, अंदर से नरम
definition: genuinely kind generous nature hidden beneath gruff manner, helping others quietly without expecting reward
example: The watchman scolds every child about the gate, then keeps bandages ready, having a heart of gold underneath.

hindi: पत्थर दिल — दूसरों के दुख से अनछुआ
definition: completely unmoved before other people's suffering, refusing sympathy however sadly somebody pleads
example: The landlord had a heart of stone about the rent until his own daughter mentioned the leaking ceiling.

hindi: दिल बैठ जाना — हिम्मत टूट जाना
definition: feeling sudden discouragement, losing courage completely when disappointing news finally arrives
example: His heart sank when the results page loaded, though his sister insisted the second attempt would feel easier.

hindi: दिल धड़क उठना — अचानक बेचैन कर देने वाली ख़ुशी
definition: feeling sudden breathless excitement when somebody attractive appears unexpectedly nearby
example: Her heart skipped a beat when the lift doors opened and he stood there holding the same novel.

hindi: दिल की बात — खुलकर आपसी बातचीत
definition: honest private conversation about difficult feelings, sharing worries frankly without pretending
example: After the shouting stopped, father and daughter finally had a heart to heart beside the parked scooter.

hindi: दोनों तरफ दाँव लगाना — जोखिम बाँट लेना
definition: spread your risk across several possible outcomes, protecting yourself whichever result arrives
example: She hedged her bets by applying locally as well, and later thanked herself when the distant college delayed everything.

hindi: आँधी की तरह — बेतहाशा और लापरवाह रफ़्तार से भागना
definition: moving extremely quickly and recklessly, riding onward with furious careless speed
example: The postman came hell for leather down the lane because the storm was already darkening the far hills.

hindi: कयामत आ जाएगी — भारी नतीजे भुगतने पड़ेंगे
definition: severe consequences waiting ahead, furious punishment certain once somebody discovers everything
example: There would be hell to pay when their mother noticed the cake, so both children ate the evidence.

hindi: बिल्लियों को हाँकना — बेकाबू भीड़ को संभालने की नाकाम कोशिश
definition: trying hopelessly to organise people scattering everywhere, wasting effort without visible progress
example: Getting eleven cousins into one wedding photograph was like herding cats until Grandmother simply held up the sweet box.

hindi: फिर वही रामकहानी — लो, दोबारा शुरू
definition: exclamation greeting tiresome familiar trouble repeating again, weary recognition rather than genuine surprise
example: When the lights flickered twice, Papa said here we go again and reached calmly for the candles.

hindi: बीच रास्ते छूट जाना — बिना मदद अकेला
definition: stranded without support, abandoned suddenly while everyone else escapes trouble safely
example: His partners withdrew the week before the exhibition and left him high and dry, holding forty unframed paintings and a signed lease.

hindi: बस अच्छे पल दिखाना — बाक़ी सब परदे के पीछे
definition: polished selection of best moments shown publicly, hiding ordinary struggle standing behind them
example: Comparing your ordinary Tuesday against somebody's highlight reel spoils an evening faster than burnt rice.

hindi: बंद गली में पहुँचना — रास्ता बंद मिलना
definition: reach a point where further progress becomes impossible, every route blocked
example: Their search for the old records hit a dead end at the flooded archive, so they started asking neighbours instead.

hindi: अचानक दम टूट जाना — आगे एक क़दम नहीं
definition: suddenly exhausted beyond continuing, concentration collapsing although plenty of work remains unfinished
example: She hit a wall halfway through the second chapter, closed everything, and walked to the park instead.

hindi: दिल तक उतरना — बात का पूरा असर समझ आ जाना
definition: suddenly understands full meaning emotionally, realizing truth that earlier explanation never quite reached
example: His mother's quiet thank-you hit home harder than the whole hour of arguing had.

hindi: जमना — पहली मुलाक़ात में दोस्ती हो जाना
definition: become friendly with somebody immediately, enjoying easy agreement from your very first conversation
example: They hit it off beside the sweets counter and were exchanging recipes before their families finished shopping.

term: hit it out of the park
hindi: छक्का मार देना — उम्मीद से कहीं बढ़कर कामयाबी
definition: achieve spectacular success beyond every expectation, delivering performance nobody could fault
example: She practised her recital piece nightly and hit it out of the park, leaving even the tabla teacher clapping above his head.

hindi: कभी हाँ कभी ना — कभी सही कभी ग़लत, भरोसे लायक़ नहीं
definition: working unpredictably, with results left to random chance rather than reliable skill or steady control
example: The old oven was hit or miss, so every birthday cake carried a small element of family suspense.

hindi: सोने की खान मिल जाना — फ़ायदे का ठिकाना मिलना
definition: an American mining phrase meaning sudden profitable success arriving after considerable patient searching
example: After forty rejections the illustrator hit pay dirt with a children's book about anxious dinosaurs.

hindi: रसातल में जाना — बिलकुल तल तक पहुँच जाना
definition: someone reaches the lowest possible point, where despair leaves nothing further remaining
example: He hit rock bottom that February, and the neighbour started leaving soup outside the door without knocking.

hindi: किताबों में सिर खपाना — जमकर पढ़ाई करना
definition: study textbooks intensively, reading lessons repeatedly while preparing anxiously before important examinations
example: Meera hit the books every evening after the shop closed, and her mother kept refilling the lamp without being asked.

hindi: चादर तान के सोना — नींद के हवाले होना
definition: head towards bedtime sleep, admitting tiredness rather than watching another late programme
example: Grandfather hit the hay before the second innings ended, trusting somebody would report the score at breakfast.

hindi: लॉटरी लग जाना — अचानक बड़ी क़िस्मत या मोटा धन हाथ लगना
definition: sudden unexpected fortune, usually money, arriving through luck rather than labour
example: She bought the crumbling corner shop for almost nothing, and when the metro line was announced she realised she had hit the jackpot.

term: hit the nail on the head
hindi: सटीक बात कहना — ठीक वही मर्म पकड़ लेना
definition: state precisely the correct point, naming exactly what everybody else struggled describing
example: Grandmother listened through the whole argument, then hit the nail on the head with one sentence about school fees, and nobody disagreed.

hindi: सफ़र पर निकल पड़ना — यात्रा शुरू कर देना
definition: begin a journey, departing promptly instead of lingering over long unfinished goodbyes
example: They hit the road before sunrise, thermos wedged between the seats, hoping to reach Nainital before the afternoon buses filled every road.

hindi: आग-बबूला होना — सुनते ही भड़क उठना
definition: react with sudden temper, shouting furious anger when unwelcome news finally arrives
example: Grandma hit the roof about the broken window, though she was mostly frightened that someone might have been hurt by the glass.

hindi: बिस्तर पकड़ना — सोने चल देना
definition: settle into bedtime sleep, finally tired enough that abandoning evening feels sensible
example: After the long drive everyone hit the sack early, leaving the unpacked bags standing beside the door.

hindi: ढलान पर आना — लगातार गिरावट में चले जाना
definition: a business slides steadily downward, losing money and standing until collapse seems certain
example: The little press hit the skids after the second printer broke, though the editor kept mailing pamphlets anyway.

hindi: रौ में आ जाना — लय पकड़ लेना
definition: settle into a confident rhythm, moving smoothly after difficult early stumbling
example: Around the second week of rehearsals the dancers hit their stride, and afternoons stopped feeling like punishment.

hindi: कुछ और असर करना — साधारण से कहीं गहरा लगना
definition: affects somebody unusually powerfully, feeling richer, stranger, memorable beyond ordinary comparable experiences
example: That same monsoon song hits different once you have actually waited beside a station platform alone, soaking.

hindi: नाम का विकल्प — लेना है तो यही लेना है
definition: apparent choice offering only single option, accepting whatever arrives rather than refusing, chiefly British
example: The last bus offered Hobson's choice, so they squeezed aboard beside crates of guavas and sang most of the journey.

hindi: सारी रौशनी खुद ले लेना — दूसरों को छाया में रखना
definition: grab constant audience attention during performance, refusing other performers their fair share
example: He hogged the limelight through every rehearsal until the director quietly moved his chair behind the chorus.

hindi: अपने ही जाल में फँसना — अपनी चाल से अपना नुकसान
definition: harmed badly through your scheming, suffering precisely what your trick intended against others
example: He locked the gate early to teach his cousin punctuality and stood outside in the drizzle, hoist by his own petard.

hindi: दरबार लगाना — घिरे रहकर बातों से सबको बांधे रखना
definition: dominate surrounding conversation happily while admirers gather, everybody listening rather than talking themselves
example: Grandfather held court beside the heater until midnight, retelling the flood story while nobody dared interrupt properly.

hindi: मोर्चा संभालना — पीछे रहकर काम चलाते रहना
definition: keeping ordinary work running alone while other people stay away, managing responsibility temporarily
example: Uncle held the fort at the shop through the wedding week, dozing between customers by afternoon.

hindi: मोर्चा थामे रखना — दबाव में भी स्तर गिरने न देना
definition: refuse to allow standards to slip, resisting steady pressure from every direction
example: Cheaper cheese would have doubled their margin, but the two brothers held the line, and regulars tasted the difference.

hindi: लगाम थामे रखना — संस्था की कमान संभालना
