definition: control an organisation, guiding every important decision that others must follow
example: Grandfather still held the reins of the tea estate, though he signed papers from a wicker chair now.

hindi: ज़रा रुको, गोली मत चलाओ — जवाब देने से पहले ठहरना
definition: stop attacking briefly, waiting quietly before continuing a quarrel until better information finally arrives
example: Hold your fire until the doctor phones back, his father said, folding the alarming letter into his shirt pocket.

hindi: ज़रा ठहरो — जल्दबाज़ी छोड़कर धीरज रखना
definition: waiting patiently, slowing down instead of rushing ahead before everything becomes ready
example: Hold your horses, said the cook, waving a spoon; the rice needs another minute under the lid.

hindi: ज़ुबान रोकना — चुप रह जाना
definition: staying quiet deliberately, holding back words that would worsen this fragile moment
example: Grandmother held her tongue through the entire argument, then quietly served everyone dessert.

hindi: दूसरा घर — जहाँ अपने घर जैसा सुख मिले
definition: place where visitors feel comfortably settled, almost belonging like their actual household
example: Her grandmother's kitchen became a home away from home during exams, complete with a spare quilt and endless roasted peanuts.

hindi: एक ही झटके में बाज़ी — पूरी कामयाबी
definition: single spectacular success settling everything decisively through well-judged confident effort
example: His first attempt at his grandmother's biryani turned into a home run, and cousins queued twice with empty plates.

hindi: आख़िरी दौर — मंज़िल बिलकुल सामने
definition: final demanding stage before completion, when exhausted effort nearly reaches finish
example: They painted the last window frame during the home stretch, then collapsed onto the veranda steps with cold lemonade.

hindi: अपना घर सबसे प्यारा — लौटने का सुख
definition: relieved delight upon returning inside your comfortable household after tiring travel
example: He dropped both suitcases in the corridor, sighed home sweet home, and went straight for the kettle without removing his shoes.

hindi: किस्मत चमकी हुई — हर दाँव सही बैठ रहा
definition: temporary spell during which everything attempted succeeds, fortune running unusually strong meanwhile
example: Grandmother had a hot hand at rummy that evening, and nobody dared mention how often she reshuffled the pack.

hindi: तमतमाया हुआ — गुस्से से लाल-पीला
definition: visibly furious and flustered, showing rising anger through reddened, sweating face
example: The umpire grew hot under the collar as both captains argued, until rain sent everyone laughing into the pavilion.

hindi: नाज़ों का पला — कठिनाई सहने का अभ्यास नहीं
definition: person raised sheltered from hardship, delicate and unprepared for difficulty outside family protection
example: Her first winter in the hostel, with cold water and shared kitchens, taught the hothouse flower more than four years of tutoring had.

hindi: फूट पड़ा घर — भीतरी झगड़े से कमज़ोर संगठन
definition: family or group weakened badly through internal quarrelling, heading toward likely collapse
example: Two brothers running one sweet shop with separate cash boxes made a house divided, and the customers chose sides too.

hindi: ताश का महल — देखने में खड़ा, छूते ही ढेर
definition: impressive looking arrangement that actually stands hollow, collapsing instantly once anyone questions it
example: One honest question from the auditor, and the family business turned out to be a house of cards.

hindi: घर-घर में नाम — हर किसी की ज़ुबान पर
definition: someone whose fame reached everywhere until almost everyone instantly recognises the name
example: Twenty years of radio mornings turned the weather announcer into a household name.

hindi: शिकायत की चादर में तारीफ़ — अपनी बड़ाई घुमाकर
definition: boasting disguised inside pretend complaint, displaying achievement while performing modest embarrassment
example: His humble brag about exhausting travel fooled nobody, least of all the sister counting every foreign stamp.

hindi: घुटने टेकना — अपनी गलती मानकर सबके सामने माफ़ी मांगना
definition: humiliating public admission that you were completely wrong, elsewhere phrased as eating crow
example: After insisting the shortcut existed, Ramesh had a plateful of humble pie before the whole family and asked his cousin to lead the way.

hindi: किसी पर अटका रहना — भुला नहीं पाना
definition: remaining stubbornly attached to somebody romantically, thinking about them constantly despite long separation
example: Three years later he stayed hung up on her, keeping the postcard inside his passport wallet.

hindi: मैं तटस्थ हूँ — किसी का पक्ष नहीं लूँगा
definition: declaring yourself neutral, refusing to take sides between friends quarrelling around you
example: When his cousins started arguing about the wedding caterer, Aman raised both palms and said he was Switzerland until dessert arrived.

hindi: ठंडा बर्ताव कर दूर करना — धीरे-धीरे किनारा कर लेना
definition: gradually freezing somebody from your attention, withdrawing warmth until they understand they seem unwanted
example: The group iced him out slowly, replies arriving later each week until the invitations simply stopped.

hindi: सोने पे सुहागा — अच्छी बात पर और अच्छा जुड़ना
definition: pleasant final addition improving something already thoroughly satisfying without being necessary
example: Passing the exam delighted her, and the scholarship letter arriving that same week was simply icing on the cake.

hindi: औकात से बड़े सपने — हैसियत से ऊँची चाहत
definition: ambitions and manners pretending higher social rank than your actual background honestly supports
example: His grandmother said ideas above your station never hurt anybody, then packed him off to the city with two shirts.

hindi: मूड ख़राब — चिड़चिड़े मिजाज़ में
definition: badly tempered in Irish usage, snapping resentfully at anybody speaking nearby
example: Grandad was in a bad skin about the flooded shed, so everybody discussed cricket instead until the mood shifted.

hindi: धुंधलाया दिमाग़ — उलझन में होना, कुछ साफ़ समझ न आना
definition: confused and unable to think clearly, understand the situation, or notice ordinary surroundings
example: After three nights awake with the baby, Daniel wandered through the office in a fog, greeting the printer politely.

hindi: टूटकर बिखर जाना — थकान और चिंता से चूर
definition: utterly exhausted in Irish usage, emotionally collapsed after relentless worry
example: After three nights beside the hospital bed she was in a heap, and her aunt simply took the children home without asking.

hindi: मुसीबत में फँसना — कोई आसान रास्ता नहीं
definition: trapped inside awkward difficult situation where every available escape looks equally troublesome
example: With guests arriving early and the cylinder empty, Amma stood in a pickle until the neighbour offered her stove.

hindi: बदहवास हालत — घबराहट में सब गड़बड़
definition: flustered, in Cockney rhyming slang, describing somebody panicking amid messy confusion
example: Mum arrived in a right two and eight, having posted the tickets instead of the birthday card.

hindi: हर मौसम में — सर्दी-गर्मी की परवाह किए बिना
definition: steady faithful presence maintained regardless of miserable conditions, British phrasing
example: She cycled to the library in all weathers, arriving with damp shoulders and dry books wrapped carefully inside plastic.

hindi: मौज में होना — सुख-समृद्धि में जीना
definition: living comfortably, luxuriously, without money worry, surrounded plenty, enjoying prosperity gained recently
example: After the little cafe caught on with tourists, Anil and his sister were in clover.

hindi: दाखिल दफ़्तर करना — फ़ाइल बंद करके भुला देना
definition: postponed indefinitely and forgotten, waiting quietly for attention arriving much later
example: His grandmother's letters stayed in cold storage inside a biscuit tin, and reading them at forty felt like meeting a stranger who loved him.

hindi: गहरे पानी में — गंभीर मुसीबत में फँसा हुआ
definition: struggling inside serious trouble beyond your ability, needing rescue from somebody more capable
example: By the third month of the loan he was in deep water, and his brother-in-law arrived with a calculator and no lecture.

hindi: पूरे निखार पर — सबसे सुंदर अवस्था में
definition: flourishing completely, showing healthy beauty exactly when growth reaches finest possible moment
example: At sixty-two, with grandchildren shouting in the courtyard, our neighbour insisted her happiness was only now in full bloom.

hindi: मन प्रसन्न होना — तबीयत चहकती हुई
definition: cheerful, delighted mood carrying lively happiness through everything happening around you that afternoon
example: The whole carriage travelled in high spirits, passing sweets along the aisle to strangers who became temporary cousins.

hindi: गिरवी रखकर चलना — कर्ज़ में
definition: owing money against pawned belongings, unable to reclaim them until that debt clears
example: His trumpet sat in hock behind the counter, and the pawnbroker promised nobody else would touch it.

hindi: मुसीबत मोल लेना — नाराज़गी के चलते संकट में फँसना
definition: facing serious trouble after angering people, with punishment or unpleasant consequences approaching rather quickly
example: Ravi landed in hot water with his mother after borrowing the scooter without asking and returning it scratched.

term: in one ear and out the other
hindi: एक कान से सुना दूसरे से निकाला — कुछ याद न रखना
definition: forget instruction immediately after hearing, remembering nothing despite patient repeated explanation
example: Grandmother's cooking advice went in one ear and out the other, which the burnt rice announced clearly.

hindi: सातवें आसमान पर होना — परम आनंद में डूब जाना
definition: extremely happy inside perfect contentment, delighted enough that ordinary worries briefly disappear
example: Give him a plate of hot jalebis and a cricket match, and my brother is in seventh heaven until sundown.

hindi: किसी का पक्ष लेना — मुश्किल में हौसला और समर्थन देना
definition: actively supporting someone, staying loyally encouraging through difficulty until trouble finally passes
example: Before the audition she looked out and found her old teacher clapping already, and knew somebody was still in her corner.

hindi: किसी की जगह खुद को रखकर — उसकी स्थिति महसूस करना
definition: imagining another person's difficult position sympathetically, feeling what facing their circumstances means
example: Standing there in his brother's shoes for a moment, he stopped composing the lecture he had planned.

term: in the blink of an eye
hindi: पलक झपकते ही — क्षण भर में हो जाना
definition: happening instantly, finished within moments, before anyone notices anything changed
example: In the blink of an eye the wedding lawn emptied, and only the string lights kept swaying above the empty chairs.

hindi: बेदाग़ निकलना — शक और इल्ज़ाम से पूरी तरह मुक्त
definition: released from blame, suspicion, and danger after a worrying period finally ends
example: The auditors closed their files, told the old shopkeeper he was in the clear, and he sat down heavily on his stool and laughed.

hindi: निशाने पर — सबकी आलोचना का केंद्र
definition: singled out as the chosen target, everybody's criticism and blame pointing steadily toward you alone
example: Once the accounts went missing, the treasurer found himself in the crosshairs of aunties who had never counted anything.

hindi: अँधेरे में रखा जाना — जानकारी से वंचित रहना
definition: confused and understanding nothing about a situation because others deliberately withheld important information
example: The whole street knew about the wedding; only the groom's uncle stayed in the dark.

hindi: नाराज़गी झेलना — अपनों की खफ़गी में रहना
definition: stuck facing displeasure from someone close, remaining quietly troubled until forgiveness finally arrives
example: Having forgotten their anniversary entirely, he spent Sunday in the doghouse, washing vegetables without being asked once.

hindi: पतवार अपने हाथ में होना — दिशा तय करने की ताक़त होना
definition: control the direction of a group, making every important decision that others follow
example: After her father retired, Meera found herself in the driver's seat of the little press on Lane Four.

hindi: समय आने पर — जब वक़्त पक जाएगा
definition: eventually, after considerable delay, whenever circumstances finally allow something happening naturally
example: In the fullness of time the youngest inherited the workshop, though nobody discussed inheritance while their father still whistled there.

term: in the lap of the gods
hindi: ऊपर वाले के हाथ में — नतीजा अब किसी के बस में नहीं
definition: situation whose outcome nobody controls, uncertain result depending entirely upon chance beyond human effort
example: The seeds were sown, the canal was dry, and the whole season now lay in the lap of the gods.

hindi: ऐन मौके पर — बिलकुल आख़िरी क्षण में
definition: arriving at the final possible moment, just before a deadline expires completely
example: She reached the platform in the nick of time, hair everywhere, waving her ticket like a small flag.

hindi: आसार दिखना — निकट भविष्य में होने के संकेत
definition: visibly approaching soon, expected shortly although nothing formal announced anywhere
example: There was a transfer in the offing, so Father started sorting the bookshelves months before anybody mentioned packing.

hindi: लाल-भबूका होना — खिली हुई सेहत
definition: glowing with excellent health, rested and cheerful, showing colour that signals real wellbeing
example: Two weeks in the hills and the children came home in the pink, sunburnt and starving.

hindi: एक ही नाव में सवार — सबकी हालत एक जैसी
definition: sharing identical difficult circumstances alongside others, facing similar unpleasant trouble without special advantage
example: Every family on the lane lost power that week, and being in the same boat turned the terrace into one long dinner.

hindi: सुर्ख़ियों में — हर हरकत पर निगाहें
definition: receiving intense public audience attention, where every action stays closely watched during performance
example: Suddenly in the spotlight after one viral clip, the shy tailor started answering his phone in a whisper.

hindi: पर्दे के पीछे तैयार — मौके के इंतज़ार में
definition: waiting quietly offstage, ready to enter performance whenever somebody ahead falters or leaves
example: A younger cousin sat in the wings with the account books, patient, certain his turn would arrive.

hindi: दुविधा में पड़ना — मन का बँट जाना
definition: unable to decide between competing choices, hesitating while weighing both options endlessly
example: She was in two minds about the transfer letter, and her mother simply asked which city let her sleep better.

hindi: अपने रंग में होना — अपनी सबसे मज़बूत कला में डूबा हुआ
definition: performing confidently inside your strongest talent, everything landing easily without visible strain
example: Three songs into the set the drummer was completely in his bag, grinning at nobody, hearing only the room.

hindi: अपने रंग में होना — अपनी ही दुनिया में सहज
definition: relaxed, comfortable, confident doing something familiar, perfectly suited toward natural talent, surroundings
example: Give him a garden, a spade, and a whole Sunday, and my father is entirely in his element.

hindi: जेब में होना — किसी के पूरे काबू में होना
definition: kept under another person's secret control while publicly appearing completely independent
example: The referee insisted he was neutral, but half the town believed he was in the club president's pocket.

hindi: नींद में भी कर लेना — इतना अभ्यास होना
definition: performing something easily, automatically, without thinking, effort, concentration, after endless repeated practice
example: Forty years behind the counter, and she could weigh, wrap, and total an order in her sleep.

hindi: अंदर की जानकारी — मुक़ाबले में ख़ास बढ़त
definition: privileged knowledge granting quiet advantage, favoured position among other people competing
example: Having grown beside the orchard gave her the inside track about which mangoes ripened first, so neighbours followed her basket.

hindi: सोशल मीडिया पर रिश्ता पक्का — तस्वीर डालकर मुहर लगाना
definition: declaring your relationship publicly through shared photographs, letting followers confirm your chosen partner
example: They became Instagram official beside the Marine Drive railing, and his mother learned about it from a neighbour's daughter.

hindi: याद दिलाना — भूली बात कुरेदकर उभारना
definition: help somebody recall forgotten details, mentioning something familiar until their memory returns properly
example: She jogged his memory with the old photograph, and suddenly he remembered every name around that table.

hindi: तार जोड़ना — बिखरी बातों से तस्वीर बनाना
definition: connect separate pieces of information, understanding pattern nobody explained clearly beforehand
example: She joined the dots between the missing sugar and her nephew's sudden generosity with morning tea for everyone.

hindi: साये की तरह साथ — हर वक़्त साथ रहने वाले
definition: inseparable close friends, constantly together, rarely seen apart from each other anywhere
example: Since the first day of hostel they have been joined at the hip, sharing notes, noodles and every complaint about the mess food.

hindi: मीठी छुरी — अपनापन दिखाकर किया गया विश्वासघात
definition: betrayal hidden beneath warm affection, greeting a trusted friend kindly while quietly planning treacherous harm
example: He hugged his cousin warmly on the courthouse steps, and only later did that Judas kiss make sense.

term: judge a book by its cover
hindi: सूरत देखकर सीरत आँकना — ऊपरी रूप से राय बनाना
definition: assess somebody entirely from outward appearance, misjudging character before learning anything genuine
example: They judged the visitor by his cover until he sat down and repaired the harmonium in twenty minutes.

hindi: मौका लपक लेना — बिना सोचे अवसर तुरंत स्वीकार कर लेना
definition: accept a rare opportunity eagerly and instantly, taking action before that favourable moment slips quietly away
example: When the bakery offered her the early shift, Rukhsana jumped at the chance, because mornings smelled better than anything else in that town.

hindi: बहती गंगा में हाथ धोना — चलन देखकर शामिल होना
definition: join sudden popular trend rather late, supporting something only after crowds began cheering
example: Once the local team started winning, every shop jumped on the bandwagon and hung flags above the shutters.

hindi: डूबती नाव छोड़ना — संकट से पहले साथ छोड़ देना
definition: abandon a group or commitment early, leaving companions behind before trouble arrives
example: Half the choir jumped ship the week before the concert, so the remaining seven sang louder and nobody noticed.

hindi: जल्दबाज़ी करना — समय से पहले शुरू कर देना
definition: starting something before the proper moment, acting hastily before preparations finish
example: He jumped the gun and announced the baby's name, though his sister had not chosen between the final three.

hindi: बेढंगा पैंतरा — जहाँ से गिरावट शुरू हो जाती है
definition: an American phrase describing series, career, project attempting desperate gimmick where quality declines permanently afterwards
example: Fans agreed the show jumped the shark when the detective adopted a talking parrot, though everybody kept watching anyway.

hindi: बात दबा कर रखना — राज़ छिपाना
definition: prevent secret spreading further, holding private information away from curious listeners
example: Keep a lid on it until Friday, she pleaded, knowing her cousin could never manage silence.

hindi: नज़र रखना — ध्यान से देखते रहना
definition: watching carefully over time, checking regularly whether trouble might begin
example: Grandmother kept an eye on the boiling milk while pretending to read yesterday's newspaper.

hindi: हाथ भर की दूरी रखना — नज़दीकी से बचना
definition: maintain deliberate emotional distance, refusing closeness while remaining superficially friendly
example: She kept him at arm's length all winter, warm in conversation yet careful never to answer anything personal.

hindi: बात पेट में रखना — भेद किसी को न बताना
definition: keeping news completely secret, telling nobody until permission finally arrives
example: She told me about the engagement and made me keep it under my hat for three long weeks.

hindi: पट्टे में बाँधे रखना — किसी को खुली छूट न देना
definition: closely watched and forced to obey another person, given little freedom
example: The new intern was kept on a short leash for a month, then handed the keys to the darkroom.

hindi: सबूत सहेज कर रखना — कागज़ात संभालना
definition: preserve screenshots, messages and evidence proving what somebody actually promised earlier
example: She kept receipts through every excuse, and produced them calmly when the landlord denied everything.

hindi: दूर रखना — पास आने से रोकना
definition: holding trouble or people away steadily, preventing anybody unwanted from coming closer
example: Two friendly street dogs kept the pamphlet-distributors at bay, and the family enjoyed a quiet Sunday afternoon.

hindi: काँटे पर टाँगे रखना — उम्मीद देकर आज़ाद भी न करना
definition: retain someone's romantic hope without commitment, refusing either closeness or honest release
example: She kept him on the hook through two summers, until his transfer letter arrived and decided the matter kindly for everyone.

hindi: हिसाब रखना — नज़र बनाए रखना
definition: an American phrase meaning supervising somebody quietly, watching activity closely through steady patient tracking
example: She kept tabs on her brother's studying through cheerful phone calls disguised as questions about football.

hindi: घर संभालना — पीछे से चूल्हा-चौका चलाते रहना
definition: maintaining steady work at home while other people stay distant, keeping ordinary responsibility alive
example: She kept the home fires burning for two years, letters arriving with sand still in the folds.

hindi: बात सँभालना — माहौल बिगड़ने से पहले शांत करा देना
definition: avoiding confrontation by calming angry tempers, quietly preventing quarrel from starting again
example: Uncle kept the peace at every reunion by seating the rival cousins at opposite ends of the table.

term: keep the wolf from the door
hindi: दो जून की रोटी जुटाना — भुखमरी टालना
definition: manage with little, earning barely enough for food and rent while holding poverty away
example: Two evening shifts kept the wolf from the door until her proper contract finally came through.

hindi: हिम्मत बनाए रखना — मुश्किल में भी चेहरा न लटकाना
definition: stay cheerful under continuing difficulty, refusing to show despair while pressure lasts
example: He kept his chin up through the third round of rejections, still ironing a shirt each morning.

hindi: ठंडा दिमाग रखना — गुस्से में न आना
definition: holding personal calm steady during provocation, refusing anger despite deliberate insults
example: The autorickshaw driver kept his cool through ten minutes of shouting, then quietly pointed at the traffic signal.

hindi: दूरी बनाए रखना — नज़दीकी से बचना
definition: staying deliberately apart from somebody, refusing closeness, contact, further conversation
example: He kept his distance from his old business partner at the wedding, nodding politely across the lawn and choosing another table.

hindi: आँखें खुली रखना — चौकन्ना रहना
definition: watching alertly, noticing immediately whenever something important finally appears
example: Keep your eyes peeled for the blue gate, he warned, because the driver always misses that turning.

hindi: दुआ करना — अच्छे नतीजे की उम्मीद रखना
definition: hoping quietly that something turns successful, silently wishing somebody luck without announcing anything
example: Everyone kept their fingers crossed while the results loaded, and Amma quietly lit another stick of incense.

hindi: दिमाग ठंडा रखना — घबराए बिना सोचना
definition: staying calm during frightening trouble, thinking clearly instead of panicking foolishly
example: The young conductor kept his head when the brakes failed, guiding passengers calmly toward the rear doors.

hindi: जैसे-तैसे निभाना — डूबे बिना मुश्किल दौर काट लेना
definition: barely surviving continued difficulty, exhausted and short of strength, still avoiding complete collapse
example: Between night classes and her mother's medicines, Fatima kept her head above water on tuition money and stubbornness.

hindi: सिर झुकाकर रहना — मुश्किल दौर में चुपचाप काम करते रहना
definition: avoid attracting hostile attention, working quietly until whatever dangerous trouble around you finally passes
example: New in the hostel, she kept her head down through the ragging weeks and quietly topped the term examinations.

hindi: नाक मत घुसाओ — दूसरों के मामले में दखल मत दो
definition: avoid interfering with private affairs that never concerned somebody outside them
example: Father kept his nose out of his daughter's flat-hunting entirely, offering only lunch and the occasional useful phone number.

hindi: रास्ते खुले रखना — अंतिम फैसला टाले रखना
definition: avoid final commitment deliberately, preserving several possible choices until better information arrives
example: He kept his options open until March, filling a notebook with pencilled plans nobody else understood.

hindi: मन की बात मन में रखना — योजना किसी से न कहना
definition: holding back private plans, staying quiet about opinions until decisions finally harden
example: He kept his own counsel about moving abroad until the tickets were printed and folded away.

hindi: बारूद सूखी रखना — तैयार रहना, पर वार सही मौके पर करना
definition: prepare quietly and stay watchful, holding resources back until trouble actually arrives
example: He had the evidence printed and filed, but kept his powder dry until the committee finally asked for it.

hindi: आराम रखो — गुस्सा थामो
definition: remain patient during irritation, controlling temper instead of shouting while waiting
example: Keep your shirt on, said the mechanic gently, the scooter will be ready before the rain even starts.

hindi: अलग ही बखेड़ा — बिल्कुल दूसरी तरह की उलझन
definition: awkward troublesome situation entirely different from whatever everybody comfortably expected beforehand
example: Repainting the room was simple; discovering the leaking pipe behind the almirah was quite another kettle of fish.

hindi: गिरे को और मारना — मुसीबत में और चोट
definition: attack somebody already suffering badly, worsening their misfortune through needless public cruelty
example: Nobody mentioned the exam results at dinner; there was no sense kicking the boy when he was down.

hindi: टें बोल जाना — मृत्यु हो जाना, बेतकल्लुफ़ हँसी-मज़ाक के अंदाज़ में
definition: blunt comic euphemism about death, reached when solemn language feels excessive
example: Grandpa joked he would kick the bucket before the mangoes ripened, then ate two bowls of them.

hindi: हाय-तौबा मचाना — शिकायत का शोर करना
definition: complain loudly enough creating commotion, forcing everybody notice your unresolved personal grievance
example: Father kicked up a fuss about the broken fan until the landlord arrived himself, carrying tools and unexpected sweets.

hindi: अपना सिर पीटना — अपनी गलती पर पछताना
definition: regret your careless mistake bitterly, blaming yourself repeatedly although that finished decision cannot change
example: He kicked himself the entire train journey for leaving the tickets beside the kettle, while his sister quietly charmed the conductor.

hindi: मारे या तारे — जोखिम भरा आखिरी इलाज
definition: drastic remedy likely either rescuing somebody completely or ruining everything, British favourite
example: Selling the shop felt kill or cure, and his wife agreed only because the alternative looked slower and sadder.

hindi: समय काटना — खाली वक्त यूँ ही बिताना
definition: filling empty hours with trivial amusements while waiting, since nothing useful demands attention
example: They killed time counting kites over the rooftops until the power came back and the fans stirred.

term: kill two birds with one stone
hindi: एक पंथ दो काज — एक ही कोशिश में दो काम
definition: achieve both separate aims through single well-planned effort, saving trouble afterwards
example: She carried the tiffin to her father's shop before college, killing two birds with one stone and getting fresh jalebis besides.

hindi: बेशुमार रकम — राजा की फिरौती जितनी बड़ी कीमत
definition: enormously expensive amount, large enough that paying would ruin most ordinary households
example: Grandmother's little brooch turned out to be worth a king's ransom.

hindi: गले मिलकर सुलह करना — रूठे लोगों का फिर से मिल जाना
definition: settle a quarrel warmly and return to easy friendship, both sides forgiving the harsh words spoken
example: After an hour of sulking at opposite ends of the sofa, they kissed and made up over cold pizza.

hindi: काठ छूना — शुभ बात कहकर बुरी नज़र टालना
definition: hoping current luck continues, American superstition warding away misfortune after boasting
example: Nobody has forgotten their keys since March, knock on wood, said the watchman patting the wooden doorframe.

hindi: छक्का खा जाना — सदमे से पूरी तरह हिल जाना
definition: left shaken completely by sudden unwelcome news, British cricket phrasing describing somebody floored
example: The village team was hit for six before lunch, so the losing captain bought everybody kulfi and promised revenge next Sunday.

hindi: ऊपर का बुलावा आना — मौत के क़रीब होना
definition: seriously weakened and close to dying, with the remaining time understood to be short
example: He joked that he was knocking on heaven's door, then beat us all at cards.

hindi: ज़ुबानी याद होना — रटा हुआ होना
definition: remembering something perfectly from memory, reciting every detail without checking anything
example: Their grandmother knew forty songs by heart, and every wedding ended with someone begging her for another.

hindi: सारे पेच जानना — काम की बारीकियाँ समझना
definition: knows every step of a difficult practical system, taught through long personal experience
example: Ask Bela which counter opens first; she knows the ropes at that post office.

hindi: समय रहते पत्ते रख देना — हार मान लेने की समझ
definition: recognise that withdrawing early prevents deeper losses than stubborn continuing would ever allow
example: He knew when to fold, closed the second stall quietly, and kept enough saved money to reopen the first properly.

hindi: अपने विषय का धुरंधर होना — पूरी जानकारी रखना
definition: understand your chosen subject thoroughly, British praise towards somebody genuinely knowledgeable
example: The tailor knows his onions, measuring shoulders once and cutting cloth that fits perfectly every time.

hindi: बलि का बकरा — अनजाने ही ख़तरे में उतर जाना
definition: walking innocently toward serious harm, defenceless because nobody warned about waiting danger
example: The new player went into that argument like a lamb to the slaughter, and the older members later apologised over samosas.

hindi: दूध-घी की नदियाँ — सुख-समृद्धि की जगह
definition: region imagined offering living comfortably, plenty, without money worry, hunger, hardship troubling anyone
example: His letters home described the coast as a land of milk and honey, though he mostly washed dishes.

hindi: हर हाल में सँभल जाना — गिरकर भी अप्रत्याशित रूप से ठीक-ठाक निकल आना
definition: recovering unexpected fortune quickly after trouble, ending steadier than circumstances promised
example: The bakery closed in March and by June he had landed on his feet running the kitchen at the hotel down the road.

hindi: आख़िरी चक्कर — बस अंतिम पड़ाव
definition: concluding final stage demanding steady endurance until tiring contest finally finishes
example: Thesis writing entered its last lap in February, and his flatmates started leaving quiet plates outside the bedroom door.

hindi: आख़िरी मोर्चा — हारी बाज़ी में अंतिम कोशिश
definition: final desperate effort defending a position almost certainly lost, also called a last-ditch stand
example: Their last stand was a handwritten petition, delivered by three retired teachers who refused to sit down.

hindi: सब्र का बाँध टूटना — आख़िरी झटका जो सहनशीलता तोड़ दे
definition: the final small annoyance collapsing patience, ending tolerance after accumulated earlier troubles
example: The missing teaspoon was the last straw, and my mother reorganised every drawer in the kitchen before breakfast ended.

hindi: मुँह के बल गिरना — तमाशा बुरी तरह पिट जाना
definition: fail completely before watching audience, American theatre slang describing performance nobody enjoys
example: Their comedy sketch laid an egg at the annual function, though the same jokes had wrecked the hostel corridor for weeks.

hindi: कानून बघारना — सख़्ती से हुक्म सुनाना
definition: state household rules with firm authority, expecting family members obey decisions immediately
example: After the third broken window, their father laid down the law about cricket, then bought a softer ball the following weekend.

hindi: हथियार डाल देना — लड़ाई छोड़कर शांति मान लेना
definition: abandon fighting completely, accepting peace terms rather than continuing a quarrel already clearly hopeless
example: After nine months of silent birthdays, she laid down her arms and simply called her sister about the recipe.

hindi: दोष मढ़ देना — जिम्मेदारी दूसरे के दरवाज़े
definition: place blame firmly upon another person, treating them responsible regardless what actually happened
example: Every delay in the kitchen was laid at the new cook's door, though the oven had been failing for months.

hindi: ज़िम्मेदारी उनके दरवाज़े छोड़ देना — दोष जहाँ का वहीं
definition: placing responsibility exactly where it belongs, refusing blame that belongs entirely elsewhere
example: The trip collapsed because two people never booked anything, and she laid it at their door without a single speech.

hindi: चापलूसी की हद कर देना — बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर तारीफ़
definition: offer exaggerated praise obviously beyond honest measure, flattering somebody until listeners stop believing
example: The salesman laid it on thick about her excellent taste, and she quietly enjoyed every word while buying nothing.

hindi: नींव रखना — बड़े काम से पहले पूरी तैयारी
definition: prepare essential foundations beforehand, building careful basis before larger effort becomes possible
example: They spent a quiet winter laying the groundwork, visiting every household before anybody mentioned the word library.

hindi: फुस्स — जिस बात पर कोई तालियाँ नहीं बजीं
definition: a British image for something disappointing that failed completely, impressing nobody among listeners
example: His pun about the vicar's hat went down like a lead balloon, so he offered around the biscuits.

hindi: नाक में नकेल डालना — किसी को अपने पीछे-पीछे चलाना
definition: made to obey another person meekly, following their wishes without question
example: He let the salesman lead him by the nose around the showroom and came home with a car nobody needed.

hindi: झूठी उम्मीद बँधाना — दिल बहलाकर लटकाए रखना
definition: encourage romantic hope deliberately while intending nothing serious, wasting someone's affection
example: She realised she had been leading him on for months, apologised properly over coffee, and both slept better afterwards.

hindi: सब्ज़बाग़ दिखाना — झूठे सपने दिखाकर भटकाना
definition: tricking hopeful victim with pleasant false promises that quietly lead absolutely nowhere
example: The producer praised her script for eight months, borrowed her scenes, and had been leading her up the garden path throughout.

hindi: रटना — बिना समझे याद करना
definition: memorise material through mechanical repetition, remembering words without understanding their meaning
example: They learned the multiplication tables by rote, chanting together until the classroom windows seemed to hum.

hindi: मंडप से भाग जाना — ऐन मौके पर विवाह तोड़ देना
definition: abandon your partner during the wedding, ending the romantic relationship publicly
example: Nobody in the family mentions the cousin who was left at the altar in 1998.

hindi: पीछे छोड़ देना — सबसे बहुत आगे निकल जाना
definition: outpace rivals in a contest until nobody else remains anywhere close behind
example: She trained through winter mornings and left the whole district in the dust by spring.

hindi: कोई कसर न छोड़ना — हर संभव जगह खोज डालना
definition: search every possible place, making exhaustive effort until nothing important remains unchecked
example: The neighbours left no stone unturned looking for the old tabby, torches under every hedge until midnight.

hindi: जो ठीक है उसे छेड़ना नहीं — दखल बंद
definition: chiefly British; stopping interference completely, letting a settled argument rest untouched
example: The sisters were speaking again, so their mother decided to leave well alone and stopped asking who apologised first.

hindi: मन ही न लगना — ज़रा भी न भाना
definition: failing completely interest someone, lacking appeal despite everybody around praising something enthusiastically
example: The celebrated film left her cold, though she smiled politely while her cousins argued about every scene.

hindi: अधर में लटकना — बिना जवाब पाए बीच में छूट जाना
definition: waiting without answer, uncertain much longer than expected while someone withholds their reply
example: She was left hanging after the audition, and she cleaned the entire kitchen twice before the phone finally rang with good news.

hindi: गले में ढोल पड़ना — सब भाग गए, ज़िम्मेदारी तुम्हारी
definition: abandoned suddenly with unwanted blame plus responsibility after everybody involved quietly disappeared
example: Every cousin vanished toward the terrace, leaving Meera holding the baby when the caterer arrived demanding final payment.

hindi: अकेले फँस जाना — बाकी बचकर निकल गए
definition: abandoned carrying blame alone after others escaped, facing punishment their careless decisions created
example: Everybody vanished before the caterer arrived, leaving her holding the bag with an unpaid bill and forty empty chairs.

hindi: संदेश पढ़कर चुप्पी — जवाब देने की ज़हमत नहीं
definition: having messages visibly seen while nobody bothers replying, signalling casual romantic dismissal
example: Three thoughtful paragraphs left on read since Thursday, so he finally closed the chat and went downstairs for badminton.

hindi: पैरों तले ज़मीन खिसकना — सदमे से ताक़त निकल जाना
definition: strength draining suddenly in Irish usage, leaving somebody trembling weakly after shock
example: When the telegram came her legs went from under her, and the postman stayed standing awkwardly until a neighbour arrived.

hindi: हाथ बँटाना — मदद कर देना
definition: helping willingly with practical work, sharing someone's burden without being asked
example: Neighbours lent a hand carrying the almirah upstairs, refusing everything afterwards except cold water.

hindi: बात को दबी रहने देना — दोबारा न उठाना
definition: letting a finished argument rest untouched, refusing further discussion, engagement, stirring
example: They both wanted the last word about the wedding seating, and both, wonderfully, decided to let it lie.

hindi: जीता हुआ फिर से लगा देना — मुनाफ़ा उठाने के बजाय दांव पर छोड़ देना
definition: leave every winning staked upon another risky round, keeping nothing safely aside
example: He had doubled his money by ten o'clock, grinned at his sister, and let it ride one more time.

hindi: बात को बहने देना — असर न लेना
definition: allowing insults, criticism, provocation to pass through without disturbing your composure
example: She learned to let the neighbour's remarks about her cooking wash over her, humming while she folded the rotis.

hindi: भड़ास निकालना — गुस्सा हल्का करना
definition: release building anger harmlessly through activity, avoiding quarrel with anybody nearby
example: After the exam results he ran eight kilometres to let off steam, then came home hungry and cheerful.

hindi: सोए हुए कुत्ते को न जगाना — शांत झगड़े को छेड़ना नहीं
definition: avoid reviving settled trouble, leaving quarrelling people undisturbed rather than risking fresh anger
example: Someone almost mentioned the property papers, until an aunt changed the subject and everyone gratefully let sleeping dogs lie.

term: let the cat out of the bag
hindi: भांडा फोड़ देना — अनजाने में राज़ ज़ाहिर कर देना
definition: reveal a secret accidentally, often ruining a surprise others were guarding
example: He let the cat out of the bag when he asked her about the ring size.

hindi: जो होगा देखा जाएगा — नतीजा किस्मत पर छोड़ देना
definition: accepting whatever outcome follows your honest choice, refusing further interference afterwards
example: She posted the letter, decided against rewriting anything, and let the chips fall while making herself strong tea.

hindi: बराबरी पर — दोनों एक जैसे
definition: equally matched throughout contest, British phrasing where neither participant clearly leads
example: Their carrom rivalry remained level pegging across three summers, which both brothers considered better than either winning outright.

hindi: बराबरी का मैदान — सबके लिए एक जैसे हालात
definition: conditions arranged under equal rules, letting everybody compete without unfair hidden advantage
example: Providing textbooks through school created a level playing field, and results improved among children whose families owned nothing spare.

hindi: दुबक कर बैठना — शोर थमने तक नज़रों से दूर रहना
definition: stay hidden quietly, avoiding attention from police, angry relatives, curious neighbours, until trouble fades
example: After breaking the temple lamp, both boys decided lying low near the canal beat facing Ammamma before dinner.

hindi: सफ़ेद झूठ बोलना — आँख में आँख डालकर झूठ
definition: telling deliberate falsehoods confidently while knowing the complete truthful story perfectly well
example: Standing beside the broken window with the cricket bat still warm, the boy lied through his teeth about a passing bird.

hindi: ऐश की ज़िंदगी — बेफ़िक्र आरामदायक जीवन
definition: living comfortably, luxuriously, without money worry, effort, hardship, enjoying carefree pleasant existence
example: Since retiring to the hills he swims each morning and naps each afternoon, living the life of Riley.

term: light at the end of the tunnel
hindi: सुरंग के आख़िर में रोशनी — मुश्किल का अंत दिखना
definition: first visible sign that difficult journey nears finishing, hardship easing toward relief
example: After the third surgery there was finally light at the end of the tunnel, and her sister repainted the kitchen yellow.

hindi: बत्ती जल जाना — अचानक बात समझ में आ जाना
definition: moment when someone suddenly understands a confusing problem, realizing the answer without further help
example: Halfway through the walk home she had a light bulb moment about the leaking tap.

hindi: चिंगारी लगा देना — झगड़े की शुरुआत
definition: deliberately provoke argument between others, adding remark certain drama follows quickly
example: One innocent question about the wedding seating lit the fuse, and dessert arrived amid raised voices.

hindi: आते ही रौशनी भर देना — मौजूदगी से माहौल खिल उठना
definition: brighten everybody's mood merely through arriving, warmth spreading across every conversation already happening
example: Whenever Meera pushed through that noisy doorway she lit up the room, and even the cousins arguing politics softened.

hindi: एक ही राग अलापना — वही बात दोहराते रहना
definition: repeating identical complaint again endlessly, tiresome even when everybody already agrees completely
example: Amma sounded like a broken record about the leaking tap until the plumber finally climbed the stairs.

term: like a dog with two tails
hindi: फूला नहीं समाना — ख़ुशी छिपाए नहीं छिपती
definition: visibly delighted, showing bubbling happiness that everybody around immediately notices, chiefly British
example: When his daughter's results appeared, the tailor walked between shops like a dog with two tails, telling people who had not asked.

hindi: कटे मुर्गे की तरह भागना — घबराहट में बिना सोचे दौड़ना
definition: rushing about frantically without thinking, wasting effort while achieving almost nothing useful
example: He ran around like a headless chicken hunting the train tickets, which were resting inside the book he had carried downstairs.

hindi: फ़ालतू पुरज़े जैसा — बेकार खड़ा रहना
definition: british phrase describing awkward uncomfortable person standing around unwanted, belonging nowhere useful
example: I stood like a spare part beside the kitchen door until Dadi handed me a bowl of peas to shell.

hindi: घड़ी की तरह — नियम से, बिना गड़बड़ी
definition: happening smoothly, reliably, regularly, without trouble, delay, mistakes, exactly following expected timing
example: Every evening at six the neighbour's dog barked twice and the street lamps flickered on, like clockwork.

hindi: बिजली की तरह — पलक झपकते ही निकल जाना
definition: moving extremely quickly, travelling with startling speed that leaves onlookers blinking afterwards
example: The puppy went like greased lightning the moment the gate swung open, and my father chased it down three gardens in his slippers.

hindi: दाँत उखाड़ने जैसा — बड़ी मुश्किल से कुछ निकलवाना
definition: extracting cooperation only through exhausting effort against stubborn resistance, making every small progress painfully difficult
example: Asking her teenager about school was like pulling teeth, four questions traded for a single shrugged syllable.

term: like the back of your hand
hindi: हथेली की लकीरों की तरह जानना — पूरी तरह परिचित होना
definition: knowing something completely, remembering every detail through long familiar experience
example: She guided the visitors through the old bazaar lanes like the back of her hand, pausing only to greet the tailor.

term: like two peas in a pod
hindi: एक ही साँचे में ढले — हमेशा साथ, एकदम एक जैसे
definition: people who closely resemble each other in appearance, habits, and constant companionship
example: The cousins arrived in matching yellow raincoats they had chosen separately, and the whole family agreed they were like two peas in a pod.

hindi: ऊँघ आने जैसा — इतना धीमा और उबाऊ कि नींद आ जाए
definition: moving painfully slowly and tediously, almost nothing visible happening across long stretches
example: The village council meeting was like watching paint dry until someone's goat wandered in and became the evening's main business.

hindi: शेर का हिस्सा — सबसे बड़ा भाग हड़प लेना
definition: largest portion taken before others receive anything, leaving small remainder behind
example: The eldest cousin claimed the lion's share of the mangoes, then quietly refilled everyone's plates once the aunties noticed.

hindi: तंगी में गुज़ारा करना — बस ज़रूरत भर
definition: spend money only upon bare necessities, keeping nothing spare beyond simple food and shelter
example: The couple lived close to the bone in that attic, and still kept flowers on the windowsill.

hindi: ऐश की ज़िंदगी जीना — शान-शौकत से रहना
definition: to live lavishly, spending money on rich comfort and expensive daily pleasures
example: They lived high on the hog that summer, ordering breakfast to the room like film stars.

hindi: बहुत कम पैसों में जीवन चलाना
definition: manage daily living using money barely enough, spending almost nothing beyond essentials
example: They lived on a shoestring that first winter, heating one room and reading together inside it.

term: live rent free in your head
hindi: दिमाग़ में बसा रहना — बेवजह किसी का ख़याल छाया रहना
definition: occupy somebody's thoughts constantly, dominating their attention although nothing warrants such lasting obsession
example: That single sarcastic comment lived rent free in her head for weeks, until her sister finally made her laugh about it.

hindi: दिमाग़ में बसे रहना — भुलाए न भूलना, याद बार-बार लौट आना
definition: occupying somebody's thoughts constantly afterwards, memorable enough that nobody manages forgetting whatever happened
example: One compliment from that teacher stayed living rent free, resurfacing whenever Anil doubted whether writing suited him.

hindi: जी भर के जीना — बेझिझक अपनी ज़िंदगी का मज़ा लेना
definition: enjoying yourself openly without apology, savouring small pleasures while nobody's disapproval slows anything
example: Nani sent photographs from Goa, hair loose, plate piled high, clearly living her best life among strangers half her age.

hindi: छल भरा पासा — नतीजा पहले से तय
definition: contest dishonestly arranged beforehand, ensuring particular people cannot possibly finish first however hard
example: The village tournament felt like loaded dice until the retired postmaster volunteered as umpire and started rejecting every convenient decision.

hindi: सींग फँसाना — जिद में एक-दूसरे से टकरा जाना
definition: clash directly in stubborn dispute where opposing sides push hard against each other
example: The coach and the captain locked horns over the batting order until rain settled the argument for them.

hindi: पूरा सामान समेत — जड़ से लेकर पत्ती तक
definition: completely, including every single part together, leaving absolutely nothing behind
example: They moved lock, stock and barrel into the new flat, even the cracked pickle jar nobody would throw away.

hindi: बस अब बंद करो — इंटरनेट छोड़ो
definition: leave online arguments entirely, closing screens before the internet spoils your evening
example: His sister looked over his shoulder at the comment thread and told him kindly that tonight he should log off.

hindi: लटका हुआ मुँह — उदासी साफ़ दिखना
definition: gloomy unhappy expression worn openly, spirits sunk enough that everybody nearby notices immediately
example: He carried a long face through the whole picnic, and his cousins kept sliding extra samosas onto his plate without comment.

hindi: लंबी दौड़ — सब्र वाला सफ़र
definition: lengthy demanding effort, destination distant enough that patience matters across years
example: Rebuilding the library was always going to be a long haul, so the volunteers planted shade trees first.

hindi: संक्षेप में कहूँ तो — लंबी बात छोटी करना
definition: compress lengthy explanation deliberately, reaching conclusion without exhausting patient listeners further
example: To cut a long story short, the goat escaped, the neighbours helped, and everyone laughed about it for years.

hindi: मुर्दे जैसा दिखना — बेहद बीमार और थका दिखाई देना
definition: appearing dreadfully unwell, drained and grey, although the actual sickness remains fairly minor
example: He looked like death warmed up at breakfast, then cheerfully asked for extra toast.

hindi: मुँह फेर लेना — जान‑बूझकर अनदेखा करना
definition: deliberately ignore misbehaviour happening openly, allowing wrongdoing continue rather than starting public trouble
example: Every guard looked the other way while the stray puppies slept beside the warm generator through January.

hindi: जमना — जैसा काम वैसा ही रूप
definition: appearing convincingly suited for the expected role, clothing and grooming matching everybody's assumptions
example: Borrowed spectacles, ironed kurta, folder under his elbow: he looked the part long before understanding the syllabus.

hindi: बेलगाम आदमी — जो कभी भी कुछ भी कर बैठे
definition: unpredictable person causing damage anywhere, ignoring warnings while nobody controls their behaviour
example: Everybody loved him and nobody invited him twice, because a loose cannon at a family dinner eventually finds the sore subject.

hindi: इसकी नींद नहीं उड़ने देना — परवाह न करना
definition: remaining calm about criticism, insults, mistakes, refusing to worry through sleepless nights
example: His uncle disapproved of the haircut loudly at dinner, and the boy lost no sleep over it, snoring by eleven.

hindi: रिश्ते की चिंगारी बुझना — प्यार में ताज़गी ख़त्म होना
definition: romantic attraction quietly fading between partners until affection feels ordinary rather than exciting
example: They still cooked together every Sunday, though both quietly admitted they had lost that spark around winter.

hindi: सिरा हाथ से छूट जाना — बात की समझ ही खो देना
definition: stops understanding a situation, growing confused and thinking thoughts that sensible listeners cannot follow
example: Three hours into the road trip, the map upside down, we had properly lost the plot.

hindi: तारतम्य टूटना — बात की कड़ी छूट जाना
definition: become confused during a conversation, unable to follow what the speaker is saying
example: Grandpa began with the fishing trip, drifted into the war, and lost the thread somewhere near his cousin's wedding.

hindi: दिशा भूल जाना — समझ न आना कहाँ जाना है
definition: become thoroughly confused about direction, losing track where progress should sensibly continue
example: Halfway through the second week of shifting house he lost his bearings entirely, and his daughter taped a simple list beside the door.

hindi: धार कम पड़ जाना — पहले जैसी तेज़ी नहीं रही
definition: an American baseball phrase meaning losing sharpness, ability declining below your earlier strongest years
example: The old lawyer joked about losing his fastball, then dismantled the argument before lunch arrived.

hindi: पकड़ ढीली पड़ना — काबू धीरे-धीरे हाथ से निकलना
definition: gradually losing control and power over people once firmly commanded
example: By the third winter the old contractor was losing his grip, and his foremen began deciding things themselves.

hindi: आपा खो देना — घबराकर बेवकूफ़ी कर बैठना
definition: panicking badly during trouble, unable to think clearly about sensible choices
example: He lost his head at the sweet shop counter and ordered enough laddoos for three neighbouring streets.

hindi: दिल दे बैठना — किसी से प्रेम में पड़ जाना
definition: become completely enamoured with someone, surrendering ordinary caution to sudden romantic feeling
example: She lost her heart somewhere between the second dance and the last slice of birthday cake.

hindi: लुट जाना — दांव में सब कुछ गंवा बैठना
definition: forfeit almost every possession through reckless gamble that collapses, leaving nothing behind afterwards
example: He lost his shirt on the second horse, walked home, and never again explained racing to anyone at dinner.

hindi: डूबी नैया — जिसका बचना अब मुमकिन नहीं
definition: something hopeless from the beginning, where continued effort brings success to nobody involved
example: The rusted scooter was a lost cause, but he polished the mirror anyway and parked it proudly.

hindi: शब्द न सूझना — कहने को कुछ न बचना
definition: unable to speak, standing silent because words vanish exactly when they matter most
example: When the whole street turned up for his retirement tea, he stood lost for words beside the samosas.

hindi: अनुवाद में अर्थ खो जाना — असली मतलब न पहुँचना
definition: misunderstanding created when meaning shifts between different languages and people miss sense
example: The joke about pickles delighted the family in Kerala and left the visitors politely blank, entirely lost in translation.

hindi: पहली नज़र का प्यार — देखते ही मोहब्बत हो जाना
definition: instant overwhelming romantic certainty felt immediately upon first meeting somebody
example: They insist it was love at first sight, although both remember different weather that afternoon.

hindi: जैसी क़िस्मत — जो भी मिले, महज़ संयोग का नतीजा
definition: outcome decided purely by random chance rather than skill, effort, fairness, or personal control
example: Whether you got the window seat or the wheel arch was pure luck of the draw on that overnight bus.

hindi: क़िस्मत का दरवाज़ा खुलना — अचानक मिला सुनहरा मौक़ा
definition: sudden turn where fortune arrives unexpectedly, luck opening chance that effort alone never provided
example: She had been singing at weddings for nine years when a lucky break put her beside a microphone that was actually recording.

hindi: सिरफिरा होना — पूरी तरह सनकी
definition: completely irrational and eccentric, behaving strangely enough to worry watching relatives
example: The old professor was mad as a hatter about pigeons, and the entire building quietly enjoyed his morning announcements.

hindi: जादुई इलाज — एक ही झटके में पूरा समाधान
definition: hoped-for treatment solving complicated trouble instantly, usually imagined rather than actually existing
example: There was no magic bullet for his back, only stretching every morning while the radio played old film songs.

hindi: अपनी कहानी का नायक बनना — खुद को केंद्र में रखने वाला आत्मविश्वास
definition: confident presence treating your ordinary routine like cinema, refusing quiet background roles anywhere
example: She walked into the wedding late, sunglasses still on, carrying enough main character energy that even the band turned around.

hindi: मौका देखकर भाग खड़ा होना — पहरा हटते ही दौड़ लगाना
definition: attempt a sudden escape from confinement by running while nobody watches
example: The goat had been eyeing the open gate all morning, and the moment the milkman turned his back it made a break for it.

hindi: दिल का बोझ उतारना — पूरा अपराध साफ़-साफ़ कबूल करना
definition: confess every detail of past wrongdoing, unburdening a heavy conscience through complete voluntary admission
example: Twenty years after the prank, the retired teacher made a clean breast of it at the reunion, and nobody could stop grinning.

hindi: बंटाधार कर देना — काम पूरी तरह बिगाड़ देना
definition: handling something badly through carelessness, turning straightforward work into a ruined, muddled mistake
example: She meant to trim the hedge into a neat rectangle and made a hash of it, leaving something between a cloud and a staircase.

hindi: बंटाधार कर देना — काम बिगाड़कर रख देना
definition: botching something clumsily in British usage, leaving messy results everybody notices
example: He made a pig's ear of the shelving, then hung pictures cleverly over every crooked joint.

hindi: बलि का बकरा बनाना — सबकी गलती एक के सिर
definition: choose innocent person deliberately, loading collective blame onto them while genuine culprits escape
example: The committee made a scapegoat of the youngest teacher, and the parents saw straight through the arrangement.

hindi: तमाशा खड़ा करना — सबके सामने हंगामा करना
definition: create embarrassing public commotion, forcing bystanders witness argument better handled quietly indoors
example: She refused to make a scene inside the crowded shop, saving her actual argument for the autorickshaw home.

hindi: धूम मचाना — पहली बार में ही सबका ध्यान खींचना
definition: earn sudden fame everywhere with a first success that impresses watching crowds
example: Her debut painting made a splash at the local fair and sold before lunch.

hindi: जो है उसी में काम चलाना — मरम्मत करके निभाना
definition: manage with little, repairing worn belongings rather than replacing them with newer purchases
example: She taught the children to make do and mend, and every jumper carried a story in its patches.

hindi: गुज़ारा चलाना — मुश्किल से खर्च पूरा करना
definition: manage barely enough money covering essential household spending each month
example: Between two jobs and a jar of coins on the kitchen table, she just about makes ends meet.

hindi: नज़रें लड़ाना — इशारों से प्रेम-रुचि जताना
definition: glance repeatedly toward someone, signalling flirtatious romantic interest without speaking aloud
example: They spent the whole wedding making eyes at each other across the sweets table.

hindi: धूप रहते फ़सल सुखा लेना — मौके का पूरा फ़ायदा उठाना
definition: take full advantage of a favourable moment while good conditions last, because the chance will soon disappear
example: Their grandmother had one clear afternoon between the rains, so she made hay and dried every last chilli on the terrace.

hindi: आगे बढ़ना — प्रगति करना
definition: advance steadily toward a goal despite slow difficult conditions holding progress back
example: By the fourth evening they were finally making headway, the ridge closer and the water bottles lighter.

hindi: चुटकियों में निपटा देना — मुश्किल काम फुर्ती से खत्म करना
definition: finish demanding task quickly through brisk efficient action, saving considerable time
example: Four hungry teenagers made short work of the pakoras, leaving behind a plate that needed almost no washing.

hindi: चलते बनना — जल्दी निकल जाना
definition: leave quickly, heading away before staying longer becomes awkward or tiring
example: Once the last guests began yawning over their tea, Meera decided to make tracks and slipped away with a quiet wave.

hindi: अपना ही घर समझो — बेतकल्लुफ़ रहिए
definition: invitation telling guest to relax comfortably, treating another household with easy familiar belonging
example: Make yourself at home, she said, pushing the kettle towards him and pointing at the biscuit tin behind the radio.

hindi: मोर्चा सँभालना — डटकर अपनी जगह बचाना
definition: rush energetically toward defending your position, resisting attack alongside everybody else willing to help
example: When developers measured the old banyan, half the colony manned the barricades with folding chairs and endless flasks.

hindi: ऊपरवाले की मदद — अचानक मिली राहत
definition: unexpected generous help arriving exactly when desperate people needed rescue badly
example: The neighbour's spare generator during that long blackout arrived like manna from heaven, and dinner happened after all.

hindi: चलता कर देना — जाने का सख़्त फ़रमान
definition: firm instructions about leaving or dismissal, delivered with authority nobody present expects anybody to question
example: After the third broken window, the boys got their marching orders and finished their cricket in the empty lot.

hindi: नक़ाब उतरना — दिखावा टूट जाना
definition: careful pretence briefly failing, letting hidden reality show through the practised friendly presentation
example: His mask slipped for one second when the bill arrived, and everybody at the table pretended otherwise.

hindi: बीच का रास्ता निकालना — दोनों पक्षों का थोड़ा-थोड़ा झुकना
definition: settle a disagreement when both sides offer equal concessions and accept a fair compromise
example: The neighbours met halfway on the fence height and shared the cost of the timber.

hindi: ख़ुदा को प्यारा होना — मरकर ईश्वर के सामने हाज़िर होना
definition: religious euphemism about death, facing judgement once breathing stops
example: He said he would rather meet his maker with the garden weeded and every letter answered.

hindi: रिश्ते की मरम्मत करना — बिगड़े संबंध दोबारा सुधारना
definition: repair a damaged friendship by reaching forward first, settling the quarrel that kept both sides apart
example: She spent the whole train ride writing the letter that would mend fences with her sister.

hindi: पागलपन में भी तरीक़ा — बेतुकी हरकत के पीछे छिपी समझ
definition: hidden sensible reasoning behind confusing behaviour, understandable once somebody explains properly
example: His shelves looked chaotic until he found every spice instantly, proving there was method to the madness after all.

hindi: छलनी जैसा दिमाग़ — कुछ भी याद न रहना
definition: memory losing information constantly, remembering almost nothing despite genuine careful attention
example: Uncle has a mind like a sieve about birthdays, though he remembers every cricket score since childhood.

hindi: अपने काम से काम रखो — दूसरों के मामले में दखल मत दो
definition: attend only your personal affairs, without interfering where nobody invited your concern
example: Auntie asked about their savings again, and Priya smiled and suggested everybody mind their business until the mangoes ripened.

hindi: गाड़ी छूट जाना — मौका हाथ से निकल जाना
definition: lose a valuable chance through arriving late, after the opportunity already passed beyond recovery
example: Ravi thought about the corner flat for a fortnight, and missed the boat by a single afternoon.

hindi: निशाना चूकना — अंदाज़ा बिल्कुल गलत बैठना
definition: falling short of the intended target, when a guess proves completely mistaken about what somebody wanted
example: She guessed her grandmother wanted a quiet birthday, and missed the mark entirely: the old woman had already invited forty neighbours.

hindi: फायदे में छिपा नुकसान — अच्छा भी बुरा भी
definition: fortunate development carrying obvious drawbacks alongside benefits, complicating your honest gratitude
example: The new highway was a mixed blessing: mangoes reached market faster, though nobody could nap through afternoons anymore.

hindi: उलझे हुए संकेत — कुछ समझ नहीं आना
definition: contradictory romantic messages leaving somebody unsure whether genuine interest actually exists
example: She collected his mixed signals like receipts, comparing them with her flatmate every Sunday morning.

hindi: बाद की समझदारी वाला आलोचक — बीत जाने पर राय देने वाला
definition: an American term for somebody offering confident criticism afterwards about decisions carrying none of the original responsibility
example: Every Monday he explained which plays would have saved the game, though nobody remembered hearing those ideas before kickoff.

hindi: फ़ालतू पैसा — ज़रूरत से कहीं ज़्यादा दौलत
definition: having plenty of spare money, wealth generous enough that waste causes little worry
example: After the bonus arrived he acted like a man with money to burn, gifting sweets to every neighbour.

hindi: जन्मों लग जाएँ — असंभव सा लंबा समय
definition: impossibly long period, years passing before something unlikely finally happens
example: He promised to whitewash the veranda, though everyone knew that would take a month of Sundays and possibly another monsoon.

hindi: आहें भरना — दूर से दीवाना बना रहना
definition: sighing dreamily about somebody romantically unreachable, imagining romance constantly instead of actually speaking
example: He mooned over the girl from the bookshop for months before finally asking about her favourite author.

hindi: रातों-रात घर खाली करना — किराया चुकाए बिना भाग जाना
definition: secret overnight household departure, escaping unpaid rent without telling anybody (British usage)
example: The tenants did a moonlight flit before Diwali, and the landlord found only a swept floor and three unwashed teacups.

hindi: दाल में कुछ काला — दिखने से ज़्यादा कुछ
definition: hidden depth existing beneath the visible surface, where outward appearance reveals only part
example: There was more than meets the eye about the sleepy bookshop, whose owner had once sailed cargo ships.

hindi: बकवादी — जिसकी ज़ुबान कभी नहीं रुकती
definition: person producing endless chatter, burying every listener under unstoppable talk nobody requested
example: Our cab driver was a cheerful motor mouth, and by the airport we knew his entire family tree.

hindi: राई का पहाड़ बनाना — छोटी बात को बहुत बड़ा कर देना
definition: exaggerating minor trouble enormously, creating loud argument about something genuinely unimportant
example: Making a mountain out of a molehill over one missing spoon kept the family group chat awake until midnight.

hindi: आसमान-ज़मीन एक करना — हर मुमकिन कोशिश कर डालना
definition: make every possible effort, overcoming enormous obstacles to achieve something deeply important
example: She moved heaven and earth to reach the hospital before visiting hours ended, three buses and one borrowed bicycle.

hindi: बीच खेल में नियम बदलना — शर्तें चालाकी से बढ़ा देना
definition: change agreed rules midway, unfair trick denying somebody success already nearly earned
example: Every time she finished the chores her uncle moved the goalposts, adding another errand before the promised bicycle appeared.

hindi: बदनामी का दाग़ रह जाता है — इल्ज़ाम पीछा नहीं छोड़ता
definition: damaged reputation lingers stubbornly, since accusations survive longer than corrections reaching listeners
example: The charges collapsed within weeks, but mud sticks, and neighbours still lowered their voices around him.

hindi: बेवकूफ़ों का काम — जिसमें नुकसान पक्का है
definition: in British usage, pursuit almost certain to lose money, attempted only by hopeful fools
example: Uncle called scratch cards a mug's game, then bought one every Diwali purely to annoy his very sensible brother.

hindi: चुप्पी साधे रहना — यह बात यहीं तक
definition: everybody stays silent, keeping the news secret and telling nobody outside
example: We are moving the party to the terrace, and mum's the word until she opens the door.

hindi: कुर्सी दौड़ — पदों की लगातार अदला-बदली
definition: constant shuffling of people between positions, leaving somebody finally without place
example: Bedrooms became musical chairs once the guests arrived, and the youngest cousin ended up happily asleep beneath the dining table.

hindi: बुढ़ापे में जवानी का शौक — उम्र छिपाने की कोशिश
definition: older person pretending youthful glamour through clothing that hides their actual years unconvincingly
example: Aunty called her own reflection mutton dressed as lamb, laughed, and wore the sequinned jacket anyway.

hindi: रही-सही कसर पूरी करना — पतन को पक्का करने वाली आख़िरी चोट
definition: another damaging blow pushing something nearer final collapse, making the ending certain
example: The flooded basement was the last nail in the coffin for the little bookshop, though the owner still waters its window plants.

term: nail your colours to the mast
hindi: डंके की चोट पर कहना — खुलेआम अपना पक्ष घोषित करना
definition: declare your loyalty publicly, refusing afterwards every chance quietly changing sides
example: She nailed her colours to the mast at the meeting, and afterwards three quieter neighbours admitted they agreed with her.

hindi: नाम लेकर बदनाम करना — सार्वजनिक भर्त्सना
definition: publicly expose wrongdoers, naming them openly until shame reaches every watching audience
example: The residents' page decided to name and shame whoever kept leaving bin bags beside the gate.

hindi: कांटे की टक्कर — बराबर चल रहे
definition: closely matched competitors advancing together through contest, neither gaining decisive separation
example: The cousins stayed neck and neck through every board game until their grandmother declared honourable peace before supper.

hindi: जोड़-पूँजी — भविष्य के लिए बचाकर रखी रकम
definition: savings kept steadily in reserve, protecting against future hardship or sudden difficulty
example: Thirty years of tailoring had grown into a modest nest egg, enough to send both daughters through college.

hindi: रात भर रंगरलियाँ — देर तक घूमना-पीना
definition: celebratory evening spent drinking, dancing, arriving home exhausted in Irish and British usage
example: After a night on the tiles the four of them shared chips on the harbour wall, watching trawlers leave without them.

hindi: दस में नौ बार — लगभग हमेशा
definition: almost always, happening with overwhelming regularity apart from genuinely rare exceptions
example: Nine times out of ten the missing keys were inside her other bag, though nobody dared mention this aloud.

hindi: शुरू में ही खत्म करना — कली में मसल देना
definition: stop harmful trouble early, before growing quietly beyond comfortable control
example: The rumour about the missing cash was nipped in the bud when their aunt simply counted it aloud.

hindi: बिना दिखावे वाला — सादा और बेतकल्लुफ़
definition: friendly unpretentious manner, sensible person refusing superior behaviour despite wealth position
example: Their landlord has no airs and graces, sitting cross-legged on the veranda floor while everyone shares peanuts.

hindi: इस लड़ाई में अपना कुछ नहीं — किसी पक्ष से मतलब नहीं
definition: having nothing personally invested in somebody else's quarrel, therefore refusing either side
example: Both cousins wanted him to declare a winner, but he smiled and said he had no dog in this fight, then went back to peeling oranges.

hindi: कुछ ख़ास नहीं — साधारण, जिसमें दम नहीं
definition: disappointing, ordinary enough in British understatement that nobody feels particularly impressed
example: Dad admits his lasagne is no great shakes, but everybody keeps arriving on Tuesdays anyway.

hindi: कोई मलाल नहीं — दिल में कड़वाहट न रहना
definition: without resentment after a defeat or quarrel, the past grievance genuinely forgotten between both sides
example: They shook hands at the net, no hard feelings, and split a plate of chips afterwards.

term: no room to swing a cat
hindi: तिल रखने की जगह नहीं — बेहद तंग जगह
definition: cramped living space offering barely enough floor room between crowded furniture
example: Their first flat had no room to swing a cat, so guests sat on the bed and everyone agreed it was cosy.

hindi: बुरा मत मानना — तंज़ से पहले सफ़ाई
definition: spoken before criticism, claiming friendly intention while delivering pointed insult anyway
example: No shade, but, she began, and everybody around the table reached for their drinks simultaneously.

hindi: अब जवान नहीं रहे — उम्र अपना असर दिखा रही
definition: noticeably beyond youthful years, older than energetic pursuits comfortably allow nowadays
example: He reminded everyone he was no spring chicken, then carried both suitcases upstairs before anybody could reach them.

hindi: कोई बड़ी बात नहीं — बिना मेहनत का काम
definition: something managed easily, without effort, worry, trouble, difficulty, hardly deserving anxious thinking beforehand
example: When she apologised about the extra guests, the cook waved a ladle and said no sweat.

hindi: घाट घाट का पानी पिया हुआ — जिसे कोई बहका नहीं सकता
definition: understands quickly when others attempt deception, remaining shrewd about details behind smooth promises
example: The landlord raised his voice, but Meera was nobody's fool and asked for the paperwork.

hindi: तुम्हारा काम नहीं — तुम्हें बताने की ज़रूरत नहीं
definition: playfully refusing questions about private affairs which never concerned somebody asking
example: Asked what she had spent on the guitar, Nandini said it was none of his beeswax and strummed something loud.

hindi: जस का तस — समझाने पर भी कुछ पल्ले न पड़ना
definition: remaining unaware after an explanation, holding exactly the same knowledge that the confusion started with
example: The mechanic talked about pistons for twenty warm minutes, and she drove away none the wiser but strangely reassured.

hindi: किताब में डूब जाना — पढ़ाई में खो जाना
definition: study reading material intensively, ignoring conversation happening around your quiet corner
example: Whenever relatives arrived with questions about marriage, Anil kept his nose in a book until the subject changed.

hindi: जी-तोड़ मेहनत — बिना रुके लगातार काम
definition: steady tiring labour continued through many hours, refusing every pleasant distraction
example: With exams three weeks away she kept her nose to the grindstone, though the mangoes outside her window were ripening loudly.

term: not a penny to your name
hindi: कंगाल होना — नाम पर एक पैसा भी नहीं
definition: completely without money, savings, wages, or property that could cover ordinary living costs
example: She arrived in the city with not a penny to her name and a borrowed suitcase of winter clothes.

hindi: खेल भावना के ख़िलाफ़ — नाइंसाफ़ी वाली हरकत
definition: unfair conduct breaking unwritten decency rules, British phrasing disapproving somebody's sneaky behaviour
example: Reading his teammate's notes before the quiz was simply not cricket, and he confessed before the scores were announced.

hindi: मेरे मतलब की चीज़ नहीं — शौक़ मेरा नहीं
definition: declining something politely in British usage because personal taste finds nothing appealing there
example: Opera really isn't my bag, she said, though she happily held everybody's coats outside the theatre.

hindi: मेरा सिरदर्द नहीं — दूसरों का झगड़ा दूसरों का
definition: declaring somebody else's quarrel entirely their responsibility, refusing involvement without apology
example: Their neighbours were fighting about parking again, and Meera shrugged, said it wasn't her circus, and went back inside.

hindi: मेरे मिज़ाज का नहीं — अपनी पसंद से बाहर
definition: something personally disliked without judgement, simply lacking appeal despite others enjoying enormously
example: Loud rooftop parties are not my cup of tea, so I stayed downstairs with the dog and a paperback.

term: not playing with a full deck
hindi: दिमाग़ का पेच ढीला — कुछ सनकी और नासमझ
definition: describes a person lacking intelligence or ordinary judgement, foolish and mentally unreliable
example: The landlord painted the windows shut for warmth, and the tenants agreed he was not playing with a full deck.

hindi: पूरा होश नहीं — कुछ कम अक़्ल
definition: limited intelligence, somebody considered slightly foolish, hardly sensible under pressure, said across Australia
example: Neighbours whispered that the fellow was not the full quid, though nobody mended fences faster after every storm.

hindi: पूरा सिक्का नहीं — अक्ल थोड़ी कम
definition: considered slightly foolish in Irish and Scottish usage, missing ordinary practical sense
example: The neighbours decided he was not the full shilling when he painted the gate three different colours, though the garden looked cheerful afterwards.

hindi: फूटी कौड़ी भर का नहीं — बिलकुल बेकार
definition: worth nothing whatever, holding value nobody sensible would spend actual money upon
example: The scooter warranty proved not worth a red cent, so their mechanic fixed everything himself over three patient evenings.

hindi: यह बोझ तुम्हारा नहीं — किसी और की ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: somebody else's burden entirely, therefore refusing responsibility, guilt, carrying, repair
example: She grieved for her friend's failing marriage until her mother reminded her it was not her cross to carry.

hindi: नट बोल्ट की बात — काम की बुनियादी बारीकियाँ
definition: practical essential details making something actually function, rather than grand vague theory
example: Her father skipped the speeches and asked about the nuts and bolts, mainly rent, wiring and honest monthly numbers.

hindi: पगला जाना — हर बात में सनक
definition: thoroughly eccentric and irrational, cheerfully strange about nearly every ordinary domestic matter
example: He labels every jar in three languages and calls himself organised; his sisters call him nutty as a fruitcake.

hindi: सबसे अलग पड़ जाना — भीड़ में बेजोड़
definition: single person left outside belonging, different from everybody around, awkwardly unmatched within group
example: She arrived as the odd one out, the only cousin without a cricket story, and left holding somebody's bat.

hindi: पक्का दावेदार — जीतने की सबसे ज़्यादा उम्मीद
definition: competitor widely expected succeed, whose chances look better than everybody else's chances
example: The odds-on favourite for the singing prize spent the interval calming a nervous younger boy who eventually finished second.

hindi: पटरी से उतरा हुआ — तथ्यों से कोसों दूर
definition: badly mistaken about the facts, standing completely apart from what the situation actually requires
example: Every guess about why the bakery closed was wildly off base; the owner had simply gone to visit her sister for a month.

hindi: रंग उड़ा होना — चेहरा उतरा और बीमार लगना
definition: looking pale and unwell, showing mild temporary sickness that friends notice before complaint
example: You look rather off colour, Dad said, already reaching for the thermometer in the drawer.

hindi: अनजानी राह पर — भीड़ से दूर
definition: somewhere remote, away from routes ordinary travellers usually follow (British; American: beaten path)
example: They found a village well off the beaten track, where the bus arrived twice weekly and everybody waved.

hindi: बिना तैयारी कहा गया — तुरंत सूझा जवाब
definition: spoken without preparation, invented immediately instead of following planned written remarks
example: His off the cuff toast at the engagement was warmer than anything the printed programme had promised.

hindi: दुनिया से कटकर — बिना संपर्क रहना
definition: living without screens, networks, or offline reachability, deliberately outside ordinary connection
example: They spent April off the grid at his grandfather's farm, learning that goats never once asked about notifications.

hindi: फंदे से छूटना — इल्ज़ाम या ज़िम्मेदारी से बरी हो जाना
