definition: released from blame, punishment, or heavy obligation that once seemed unavoidable
example: When the neighbour admitted his own dog had dug up the tulips, my brother was suddenly off the hook and grinning into his teacup.

hindi: नज़रों से ओझल — कोई पता नहीं, कोई जवाब नहीं
definition: gone completely quiet and unreachable, vanished from public notice, also heard as under the radar
example: She stayed off the radar for three weeks, painted the spare bedroom, and returned with nothing whatsoever to report.

hindi: दबी ज़ुबान से — बिना हवाला
definition: said privately, journalism phrase meaning information cannot be published, quoted, or attributed
example: Off the record, he admitted the whole department already knew, then changed the subject firmly.

term: off the top of your head
hindi: जो याद आया वही — बिना सोचे-समझे तुरंत
definition: answering immediately from memory, guessing roughly without checking written records
example: Off the top of his head he named nine cousins, then admitted he had forgotten the twins entirely.

hindi: ख़यालों में गुम — कहीं और खोया हुआ
definition: daydreaming vacantly, thinking muddled distant thoughts, hardly sensible whenever addressed, said across Australia
example: Halfway through the maths lesson she went off with the pixies, drawing seabirds along the margin of every page.

hindi: पुराना खिलाड़ी — लंबे अनुभव वाला माहिर व्यक्ति
definition: someone whose long practical experience makes difficult work look calm and unhurried
example: An old hand at monsoon leaks, our neighbour arrived with buckets before the ceiling gave way.

hindi: बासी बात — जो अब नई नहीं रही
definition: familiar, unexciting, outdated because everybody already knows everything thoroughly
example: Her card tricks were old hat among the cousins, so she learned three new ones before the winter holidays began.

hindi: पुश्तैनी दौलत — पीढ़ियों से चली आती संपत्ति
definition: family wealth inherited across generations, carrying quiet privilege and established social standing
example: Their house smelled of beeswax and old money, and nobody in it had bought a new dining chair since the war.

hindi: पुराने स्कूल की यारी — रसूख वाला जाल
definition: privileged British network where former schoolmates quietly favour each other's advancement
example: The appointment smelled faintly of the old school tie, since both men remembered the same cricket pavilion fondly.

hindi: सुलह का पैग़ाम — शांति का प्रस्ताव
definition: a gesture offered to calm the hostility between opposing sides, easing tension towards peaceful agreement
example: He arrived with mangoes from the garden, an olive branch nobody in the family could refuse.

hindi: तलवार की धार पर — नतीजा ज़रा से तय
definition: balanced precariously between rescue and disaster, where slightest change decides everything remaining uncertain
example: The last over left the whole colony on a knife edge, radios pressed against seven different balcony railings.

hindi: क़िस्मत चमकना — लगातार कामयाबी का दौर चलना
definition: stretch where fortune keeps arriving, luck stacking success after success without visible effort
example: Four sales before lunch, and the new boy was so clearly on a roll that nobody dared send him on a tea run.

hindi: संतुलन में — शांत और स्थिर
definition: steady, calm, balanced again after trouble, nothing wobbling dangerously anymore
example: Three quiet months after the hospital stay, the household felt on an even keel again, mornings unhurried and the radio playing.

hindi: ख़ुशी से फूला न समाना — सातवें आसमान पर होना
definition: feeling extremely delighted, floating through ordinary hours because something wonderful finally happened
example: She was on cloud nine for a week after the results, distributing sweets to neighbours who had already congratulated her twice.

hindi: अलग-अलग तार पर होना — सोच का मेल न बैठना
definition: constant misunderstanding between people whose thinking follows completely different lines
example: He wanted quiet mountains, she wanted markets and music; about holidays they were always on different wavelengths.

hindi: चैन की बंसी बजाना — पैसों की चिंता से मुक्त
definition: living comfortably, securely, without money worry, thanks toward steady wealth covering every expense
example: Two good harvests and the loan cleared, and suddenly the family found themselves on easy street.

hindi: एकदम सही — हर बात नपी-तुली और सलीक़ेदार
definition: exactly correct, stylish, faultless, every small detail judged where careful taste demanded
example: The eyeliner, earrings, even the borrowed scarf were entirely on point, though she swore everything happened accidentally.

hindi: ठंडे बस्ते में डालना — किसी काम को टालकर बाद के लिए रख देना
definition: postponed for later, receiving little attention while other matters keep moving ahead
example: Her novel sat on the back burner through three winters, the notebook still under the bed, until a quiet January finally gave it back to her.

hindi: बैकफ़ुट पर — बचाव में सिमटा हुआ
definition: forced defensive position, struggling awkwardly against difficult attacks from stronger opponents
example: The debating team spent twenty minutes on the back foot before their quietest speaker turned the whole argument around.

hindi: चौकस — पूरी तरह सतर्क और काबिल
definition: alert competent attentive, noticing important details quickly instead of drifting through duties
example: The young pharmacist was thoroughly on the ball, spotting the wrong dosage before anybody swallowed anything unfortunate.

hindi: दारू के पीछे पड़ जाना — कई दिन शराब में डूबे रहना
definition: drinking heavily across several days in Irish usage, neglecting work entirely
example: His cousin had been on the batter since the wedding, and the whole family took turns minding the shop until he surfaced.

hindi: ठीक समय पर — एकदम सही वक़्त
definition: exactly punctual, arriving precisely when promised without keeping anybody waiting
example: The milkman arrived at half past five on the dot, and the household set every other chore around him.

hindi: चुपके चुपके — गुप्त रूप से
definition: arranged quietly between trusted people, American phrase keeping matters hidden from gossip
example: They kept the engagement on the down low until both grandmothers could hear about it directly.

term: on the flat of your back
hindi: बिस्तर पकड़ लेना — बीमारी से चारपाई पर पड़ जाना
definition: flattened completely in Irish usage, bedridden through serious illness or utter exhaustion
example: She spent February on the flat of her back with fever, and half the street called round carrying soup nobody had requested.

hindi: क्षितिज पर — आने वाला दिखाई देना
definition: becoming visible ahead, expected soon although still considerable distance away
example: With exams on the horizon, their mother quietly stopped inviting relatives and kept the study lamp burning until midnight.

hindi: फ़रार होना — पुलिस से छिपकर भागते रहना
definition: fleeing constantly from police pursuit, hiding across towns after committing serious wrongdoing
example: Grandfather loved retelling how their village barber went on the lam for stealing goats, then returned selling insurance.

hindi: तबीयत सँभलना — धीरे-धीरे सेहत सुधरना
definition: steadily recovering from illness or injury, with health improving quietly after proper treatment
example: Three weeks after the surgery Nani was on the mend, scolding everyone about the salt again.

hindi: बिल्कुल सही — अनुमान एकदम ठीक बैठा
definition: exactly correct about details, matching reality closely enough that further argument stops
example: His guess about the wedding budget turned out completely on the money, which annoyed his brother more than being wrong would have.

hindi: जोड़ी ढूँढने निकलना — शाम को साथी तलाशना
definition: actively seeking casual romantic partners during evening outings, British informal register
example: His flatmates went into town on the pull, while he stayed behind happily reheating leftover khichdi and watching cricket.

hindi: सेहत सुधरने की राह पर — धीरे-धीरे ठीक होना
definition: steadily regaining health after serious illness, improving gradually although still fragile
example: Three weeks after the surgery she was clearly on the road to recovery, walking the corridor twice each evening with her son.

hindi: रिश्ते में दरार — संबंध टूटने के कगार पर
definition: describing a romantic relationship failing badly, probably ending within coming months
example: Everyone guessed the marriage was on the rocks when they arrived separately at the reunion.

hindi: घुटनों पर आना — हार के कगार पर होना
definition: close to losing power completely, barely surviving against stronger opponents
example: The little bookshop was on the ropes until the neighbourhood started holding its poetry evenings there.

hindi: हाथों-हाथ — मौके पर ही फ़ैसला कर देना
definition: deciding instantly, acting within moments while everyone present waits, giving immediate answer
example: The tailor measured the boy and, on the spot, promised the shirt would be ready before the festival.

hindi: रिश्वतखोर — नियमित घूस लेने वाला
definition: regularly accepting secret payment while holding official position, betraying honest public duty
example: Everybody suspected the inspector stayed on the take, which explained those three trucks parked nightly beside the closed weighbridge.

hindi: पतली बर्फ़ पर चलना — ज़रा-सी चूक से बड़ा नुकसान
definition: occupying risky position where slight mistakes bring serious trouble with immediate, harsh consequences
example: After two missed rehearsals the drummer knew he stood on thin ice, so he arrived an hour early with chai for everyone.

hindi: सातवें आसमान पर — ख़ुशी से भरपूर
definition: delighted, glowing with cheerful happiness because everything currently feels wonderfully successful and light
example: After the letter arrived she felt on top of the world, and spent the evening telephoning relatives who pretended surprise.

hindi: आख़िरी साँसें गिनना — बिलकुल चुक जाना
definition: barely standing, close to collapse or death after exhaustion, illness, or long overuse
example: The village bus was on its last legs, wheezing up every slope while the driver patted the dashboard like an old horse.

hindi: दाने-दाने को मोहताज — बेहद तंगी में
definition: reduced to poverty, completely without money, wearing shoes and clothes worn beyond decent repair
example: Grandad was on his uppers that winter, yet he still brought jam whenever he visited us.

hindi: कभी-कभार — बहुत लंबे अंतराल पर होना
definition: happening extremely rarely, occurring perhaps once across several years instead of regularly
example: Once in a blue moon the cousins reach the same city together, and nobody sleeps before three.

hindi: जीवन में एक बार — दोबारा न मिलने वाला मौका
definition: happening only once across an entire life, most unlikely ever coming round again
example: She called the scholarship letter a once in a lifetime thing and framed it beside her grandmother's photograph.

hindi: एक पैर क़ब्र में होना — मौत के बेहद क़रीब
definition: extremely frail and close to dying, weakened by serious illness or advancing years
example: With one foot in the grave, said Uncle at eighty, before climbing onto the roof.

hindi: लाखों में एक — बेहद विरला
definition: rare person or chance appearing seldom among enormous numbers, remarkably exceptional
example: The old tailor stitched the torn sherwani overnight and refused payment, which his neighbours agreed made him one in a million.

hindi: अपनी तरह का अकेला — बेजोड़
definition: utterly unique, having nothing comparable anywhere, unmatched among everything otherwise similar
example: Her father's hand-painted trunk was one of a kind, and every child in the family wanted it eventually.

hindi: घर का ही आदमी — परिवार जैसा अपनापन
definition: accepted with warmth into household belonging, treated exactly like relatives rather than visiting guest
example: By the second monsoon the lodger was one of the family, arguing about cricket and knowing where the spare keys hung.

term: one sandwich short of a picnic
hindi: अक्ल से पैदल — बुद्धि में कमज़ोर
definition: describes a person lacking intelligence, foolish and slow about ordinary everyday matters
example: He tried to defrost the chicken with a hairdryer, and his sister decided he was one sandwich short of a picnic.

hindi: बस एक ही दिखना — किसी और पर नज़र न जाना
definition: feel romantic attention fixed entirely upon somebody, noticing nobody else present
example: The hall was full of cousins in silk, but he only had eyes for the woman arranging marigolds near the door.

hindi: बर्रे के छत्ते में हाथ डालना — नई उलझनें खोल देना
definition: triggering complicated hidden troubles, creating messy situation growing beyond original harmless innocent question
example: Asking gently about the missing photograph opened a can of worms that occupied three aunts until midnight.

hindi: खुली किताब — जिसके मन में कुछ छिपा न हो
definition: person whose thoughts remain completely visible, hiding nothing from watching friends
example: Their youngest cousin is an open book, announcing every secret plan before anybody thinks about asking.

hindi: खुला दरवाज़ा — जहाँ कोई भी बेझिझक आ सके
definition: household welcoming every visitor freely, keeping doors unlocked for casual arriving guests
example: Their grandmother kept open house every Sunday, so lunch was never for six people and somehow never ran short either.

hindi: खुला भेद — छिपी बात जो सबको मालूम
definition: widely known private matter everybody discusses quietly although nobody announces publicly
example: Their engagement stayed an open secret through Diwali, discussed over every plate of ladoo and denied at every doorway.

hindi: पहली पेशकश — असली आकर्षण से पहले
definition: smaller performance appearing before main attraction, warming audience while nearly nobody remembers afterwards
example: Their band spent three summers as the opening act, playing beautifully to people still queueing outside.

hindi: कोहनी से फटा कोट — गरीबी की निशानी
definition: wearing threadbare clothing worn through, showing poverty despite respectable earlier circumstances
example: Uncle arrived out at the elbows but insisted on paying for everybody's tea, which nobody had the heart to refuse.

hindi: किसी अनजान पिछड़े कोने में — नक़्शे से बाहर
definition: somewhere extremely remote in mocking Australian usage, distant, unfashionable, barely worth visiting
example: He grumbled about being posted out in Woop Woop until the neighbours arrived with mangoes and stayed until midnight.

hindi: पलक झपकते सो जाना — गहरी नींद में गुम
definition: falling asleep instantly, tired body sleeping deeply seconds after reaching comfortable bedtime pillow
example: The toddler was out like a light halfway through the story, still clutching the wooden elephant.

hindi: कहीं से भी अचानक — बिल्कुल अनपेक्षित बात
definition: arriving suddenly from unexpected direction, surprising everyone with something completely unrelated
example: The question about her childhood dreams came out of left field, and she laughed before answering honestly.

hindi: तबीयत ढीली होना — मन और देह दोनों बेमन
definition: mildly unhappy, gloomy mood mixed with slight illness, neither cheerful nor properly comfortable within yourself
example: Amma was out of sorts all afternoon, so nobody argued when she declared the evening belonged to blankets and old radio songs.

hindi: नूह के ज़माने का — बेहद पुराना
definition: comically outdated, British phrase describing something everybody considers absurdly antiquated
example: The scooter looked out of the ark, though it still carried three brothers and a tiffin box uphill every morning.

hindi: अचानक बिन बुलाए — कहीं से टपक पड़ना
definition: happening suddenly without warning, surprising everybody because nothing suggested beforehand
example: Out of the blue, her college roommate rang after eleven years and asked whether the tamarind tree still stood.

hindi: आसमान से गिरे खजूर में अटके — एक मुसीबत से बड़ी मुसीबत
definition: escaping serious trouble while landing somewhere considerably worse, exchanging difficulty for greater immediate danger, usually 'out of the frying pan into the fire'
example: Leaving the leaking room for his cousin's noisy terrace took him out of the frying pan into the fire, cheerfully.

hindi: खतरे से बाहर होना — संकट का दौर बीत जाना
definition: past the dangerous stage of illness and recovering, although complete health still lies ahead
example: The doctor said she was out of the woods, and the whole waiting room exhaled together.

hindi: गहरे पानी में — मुश्किल जो बस से बाहर
definition: caught within serious trouble beyond your abilities, unable handling worsening difficulty alone, also 'in deep water'
example: Two missed payments and a broken tractor later, Baba admitted he was out of his depth and telephoned his uncle.

hindi: दिमाग़ ठिकाने नहीं — बेतुका बरताव करना
definition: behaving wildly in Irish usage, talking nonsense nobody sensible would believe
example: You would think he was out of his tree, swimming in November, but he came out grinning and swore it cured everything.

hindi: अकेले जोखिम में — बिना सहारे टहनी पर
definition: stranded alone holding risky position nobody else supports, exposed without helpful allies
example: She went out on a limb defending the new schedule, and stood there quietly until two colleagues joined her.

hindi: गुस्से की मशीन — रोज़ नया बवाल, वही मुनाफ़ा
definition: arrangement of accounts feeding constant public anger, harvesting attention from furious strangers
example: Her uncle deleted three applications, called the outrage machine exhausting, and joined the morning walking group instead.

hindi: ढलान पर — बेहतरीन दिन बीत चुके
definition: an American phrase describing somebody past their strongest years, ability quietly declining beyond earlier peak
example: They teased Dad about being over the hill until he beat every grandchild across the swimming pool.

hindi: बाग़-बाग़ हो जाना — बेहद ख़ुश
definition: completely delighted about welcome news, unable to stop smiling before everyone
example: Grandfather was over the moon when the letter arrived, and read it aloud to the milkman as well.

hindi: सिर के ऊपर से निकल जाना — बात समझ में ही न आना
definition: beyond someone's understanding, leaving an ordinary listener confused about a situation full of difficult ideas
example: The lecture on quantum spin went cheerfully over my head, though the biscuits were excellent.

hindi: अपने ही पैर पर कुल्हाड़ी — अपनी चाल अपने खिलाफ
definition: careless action damaging nobody except yourself, harming your position through avoidable mistake
example: Announcing the surprise party inside the family group chat was a spectacular own goal.

hindi: महफ़िल लूट लेना — मौजूदगी भर से सबका ध्यान खींच लेना
definition: command everybody's attention immediately through presence alone, steering surrounding conversation without raising volume
example: Her father barely spoke twenty sentences all evening, yet somehow owned the room from beside the samosa tray.

hindi: मुँह फुलाकर बैठ जाना — रूठ जाना
definition: lose temper quietly, sulking childishly after minor setback, said across New Zealand
example: The toddler packed a sad about wearing gumboots, then wore them indoors proudly for the rest of the weekend.

hindi: बोरिया-बिस्तर बाँधना — काम छोड़कर चल देना
definition: abandon an activity completely, leaving the unfinished work behind without further regret
example: After the fourth burnt batch of caramel, Nadia packed it in, opened the window, and ordered dessert instead.

hindi: झूठ का पुलिंदा — शुरू से आख़िर तक गढ़ी कहानी
definition: story built entirely from deliberate falsehoods without single truthful detail anywhere inside
example: Her brother's account of the missing sweets grew longer with every question until it stood exposed as a pack of lies.

hindi: भेड़-बकरियों की तरह ठुँसे हुए — बहुत भीड़ में दबे हुए
definition: crowded tightly together inside narrow space, pressed against everybody standing around
example: Fourteen relatives packed like sardines onto one sofa for the photograph, and nobody moved until the flash finally worked.

hindi: अपनी नाव खुद खेना — अपने काम खुद निपटाना
definition: manage personal affairs independently, without help, advice, or interference from other people
example: Grandmother sold her jewellery, bought a sewing machine, and paddled her own canoe for forty years without ever asking anybody for anything.

hindi: भूत जैसा पीला — डर से चेहरा बेरंग होना
definition: colourless frightened appearance suggesting terrible shock, leaving somebody looking bloodless and slightly unsteady
example: He stepped off the roller coaster pale as a ghost, insisting cheerfully that he wanted another turn.

hindi: दरारों पर कागज़ चिपकाना — दोष छिपाकर ठीक दिखाना
definition: conceal serious underlying damage cosmetically, treating appearance instead repairing genuine broken structure
example: They papered over the cracks before the guests arrived, and only the uncle who tapped walls noticed anything.

hindi: कागज़ी शेर — डरावना दिखने वाला कमज़ोर
definition: threatening surface appearance covering real weakness, frightening nobody once somebody actually tests substance
example: The landlord's eviction notices turned out to be a paper tiger, and the tenants stayed another eleven years.

hindi: दरार पर पुताई — असली खराबी ऊपर से ढँकना
definition: hiding serious underlying problems with temporary cosmetic repair that solves absolutely nothing
example: Fresh paint before the inspection was papering over the cracks, and everyone avoided leaning against that wall.

hindi: तोते की तरह रटना — बिना समझे दोहराना
definition: repeat memorised words mechanically, British phrase describing reciting without understanding anything
example: He recited the safety rules parrot fashion, then asked which button actually stopped the machine.

hindi: घर का पुराना सामान — इतना पुराना कि किसी का ध्यान नहीं जाता
definition: somebody present so long they belong completely, comfortable familiar fixture nobody consciously notices anymore
example: After nineteen winters the old caretaker was part of the furniture, and the students greeted him before greeting each other.

hindi: ठीकरा दूसरे के सिर फोड़ना — ज़िम्मेदारी दूसरे पर डालना
definition: shifting responsibility toward other people, avoiding work that properly belongs with yourself
example: The form travelled from window seven back to window three; everybody passed the buck beautifully.

hindi: अव्वल दर्जे से पास होना — शानदार सफलता पाना
definition: succeed brilliantly in examinations, finishing well above every expected standard
example: Sunita passed her driving test with flying colours and drove her father home very slowly, grinning.

hindi: दिन लद जाना — उपयोगिता चुक जाने के बाद भी बचा रह जाना
definition: stale and unwanted, having outlived whatever usefulness once made something worth keeping
example: He said his cricket bat was past its sell-by date, then scored forty runs with it at the Sunday match.

hindi: अय्यूब जैसा धैर्य — घोर दुख में भी शांति
definition: extraordinary endurance shown during prolonged suffering, never complaining about unfair hardship
example: Teaching forty restless children through three broken fans took the patience of Job, which she somehow found daily.

hindi: रास्ता बनाना — आगे के लिए ज़मीन तैयार करना
definition: prepare conditions carefully beforehand, making later progress easier for somebody following behind
example: Her aunt paved the way years earlier, arguing with relatives until studying abroad stopped sounding scandalous.

hindi: किए की कीमत चुकाना — पुरानी लापरवाही का हिसाब
definition: accept delayed consequences finally arriving, paying heavily afterwards through earlier reckless borrowed enjoyment
example: Three festival weekends of borrowed money were lovely, and paying the piper arrived quietly with January's electricity bill.

hindi: कीमत चुकानी पड़ती है — नतीजा भुगतना
definition: suffer painful consequences later, punished eventually because earlier choices proved reckless
example: He skipped every practice through summer and paid the price during the very first match.

hindi: मुँहमाँगी कीमत चुकाना — मजबूरी में हद से ज़्यादा दाम देना
definition: hand over an outrageously expensive amount, usually because paying elsewhere remains impossible
example: We forgot to book early and paid through the nose for the last two seats.

hindi: सस्ती सीटों की भीड़ — मुफ़्त टीका-टिप्पणी करने वाले
definition: an American term for noisy onlookers offering unwanted criticism while shouldering none of the awkward responsibility
example: The children heckled from the kitchen doorway until Dad thanked the peanut gallery and handed them potatoes to peel.

hindi: देर से समझ आना — काफ़ी देर बाद बात दिमाग़ में बैठना
definition: suddenly understands something confusing after long delay, realizing meaning others already grasped
example: He stared at the photograph for a minute, and then the penny dropped: same garden, thirty years earlier.

hindi: बेमन से निपटा देना — नाम भर का काम करना
definition: deliver lazy minimal performance, skipping proper preparation because nobody seems watching closely
example: The singer phoned it in during the afternoon rehearsal, then apologised sheepishly when the tabla player played beautifully anyway.

hindi: कांटे की टक्कर — बेहद मामूली अंतर से फ़ैसला
definition: a contest decided by margin so narrow that almost nobody could separate the competitors
example: The school relay ended in a photo finish, and both mothers claimed victory.

hindi: रफ़्तार पकड़ना — धीमी शुरुआत के बाद ज़ोर आना
definition: gather increasing momentum gradually after slower beginning, moving faster once confidence arrives
example: The reading circle picked up steam by December, growing from three shy members into a crowd fighting over chairs.

hindi: दूसरे का बोझ उठाना — छूटा हुआ काम संभाल लेना
definition: taking additional work other people left unfinished, keeping shared responsibility from quietly collapsing
example: When their mother fell ill, the twins picked up the slack without anyone drawing a rota.

hindi: चेहरे से सेहत टपकना — देखते ही स्वस्थ लगना
definition: someone showing excellent health visibly, strong colour and easy energy that others immediately notice
example: She arrived at the reunion a picture of health, and three people asked for her routine.

hindi: तस्वीर जैसा सुंदर — असली गड़बड़ फ्रेम के बाहर
definition: looking flawless like an arranged photograph, hiding whatever messiness stands outside the frame
example: The picture perfect terrace had one unswept corner where the children kept their frogs and broken cricket bat.

hindi: आकाश-कुसुम — कभी न मिलने वाला सपना
definition: unrealistic promised reward, mentioned pleasantly forever although never actually delivered
example: The promised community swimming pool remained pie in the sky, though children still measured the empty plot every summer.

hindi: बाएँ हाथ का खेल — बहुत आसान काम
definition: something finished easily, without effort, trouble, worry, because task remains simple throughout
example: She had dreaded the driving test for weeks, then came home grinning and said the whole thing was a piece of cake.

hindi: अपने रंग में रंगा — गंदगी में भी पूरा आनंद
definition: blissfully delighted amid messy surroundings other people find thoroughly unpleasant, chiefly British
example: The boy sat in the monsoon puddle like a pig in muck while his mother watched from the doorway, laughing despite herself.

hindi: एक-एक पैसा जोड़ना — कंजूसी से खर्च करना
definition: spend money with anxious care, refusing every small purchase that seems even slightly unnecessary
example: They pinched pennies all spring so the twins could have proper boots before the rains came.

hindi: दिन के उजाले जैसा साफ़ — बिल्कुल स्पष्ट
definition: completely obvious and easily noticeable, needing nothing explained because everybody already understands
example: It was plain as day that the puppy had been sleeping on the sofa, though the cushions had been carefully rearranged.

hindi: राह साफ़ होना — बिना रुकावट आगे बढ़ना
definition: progress continuing smoothly, steadily, without trouble, delay, obstacles, complications slowing anything down
example: Once the visa arrived, the rest of the move was plain sailing: packing, goodbyes, a quiet flight.

hindi: मन में बात डाल देना — सोच की शुरुआत करना
definition: introduce suggestion gently, planting quiet actions someone chooses much later themselves
example: His teacher planted a seed with one remark about drawing, and years later that remark filled entire notebooks.

hindi: छोटा किरदार निभाना — मामूली हिस्सेदारी
definition: having only minor role within larger performance, contributing briefly while other people carry everything
example: He played a bit part in the whole rescue, carrying blankets, yet retold it beautifully for years.

hindi: इंतज़ार की चाल चलना — जान-बूझकर देर करके सही क्षण साधना
definition: delay deliberately, waiting patiently until impatience weakens the other side and the favourable moment arrives
example: The two brothers played a waiting game over the last mango, neither willing to reach across the table first.

hindi: दोनों नावों पर पैर — दोनों पक्षों से साठगाँठ
definition: support opposing parties simultaneously, keeping advantage whichever side finally prevails afterwards
example: Playing both sides in the cousins' argument worked until they compared notes over lunch and started laughing together.

hindi: वक़्त काटना — जान-बूझकर बात टालकर समय निकालना
definition: deliberately delaying a decision, stalling until circumstances become somewhat more favourable
example: The old shopkeeper played for time, polishing glasses and asking about their families, while his son ran home for the missing key.

hindi: कबाब में हड्डी — जोड़े के बीच तीसरा
definition: chiefly British: awkward third person tagging along with courting couple, belonging nowhere while romance continues around
example: He agreed to play gooseberry at the cinema, then quietly bought his own ticket three rows further back.

hindi: भाव खाना — जान-बूझकर रुचि छिपाना
definition: pretend indifference toward someone whose flirtatious romantic interest already seems obvious
example: He played hard to get for exactly nine days, then arrived early with two cinema tickets.

hindi: स्कूल से गोल मारना — कक्षा से भाग जाना
definition: skip school lessons deliberately without permission, American phrase covering cheerful classroom truancy
example: They played hooky exactly once, spent the afternoon beside the canal, and confessed before dinner anyway.

hindi: मौके के हिसाब से चलना — पहले से योजना नहीं बनाना
definition: decide gradually while events unfold, improvising instead of following any prepared plans
example: They reached the hill station without bookings, playing it by ear until a kindly dhaba owner mentioned his cousin's spare rooms.

term: play it close to the vest
hindi: पत्ते सीने से लगाए रखना — इरादे छिपाए रखना
definition: keep your plans hidden carefully, telling nobody more than absolutely necessary meanwhile
example: He played it close to the vest about the transfer, so only his grandmother knew, and she guarded it beautifully.

hindi: सुरक्षित रास्ता चुनना — जोखिम से बचकर चलना
definition: choose the cautious option carefully, avoiding risks that might cause trouble or unwanted loss
example: The sky looked bruised over the hills, so they played it safe and pitched the tent below the ridge.

hindi: दिमागी खेल खेलना — जान-बूझकर उलझाकर रखना
definition: manipulating somebody's feelings through calculated confusion, keeping them anxious about your real intentions
example: Her cousin warned her plainly that anybody playing mind games this early would keep playing them forever.

hindi: दूसरे दर्जे पर रहना — पीछे रहकर साथ देना
definition: accept lesser subordinate role while another person receives greater attention
example: He played second fiddle during his brother's wedding songs and still knew every harmony better than anybody present.

hindi: खाली कुर्सियों के आगे बजाना — कोई सुनने वाला नहीं
definition: performing devotedly while almost nobody attends, wasting effort before rows of vacant seats
example: They played to an empty house that rainy Tuesday, and still finished every song beautifully.

hindi: सस्ती तालियाँ बटोरना — भीड़ को खुश करने का अभिनय
definition: acting deliberately toward cheapest audience approval, exaggerating instead of performing something honest
example: The candidate played to the gallery all evening, promising fountains nobody had asked about.

hindi: आग से खेलना — जानबूझ कर खतरे को न्योता देना
definition: behave recklessly inside a dangerous situation, inviting serious harm through careless confidence
example: Riding the parapet wall for photographs was playing with fire, and their teacher said so twice before they climbed down.

hindi: मन मयूर नाचना — गर्व से खिल उठना
definition: extremely delighted and cheerful about something achieved, unable to hide obvious satisfaction
example: He was pleased as punch about the certificate and carried it around the wedding until somebody finally asked to read it.

hindi: वापसी असंभव मोड़ — अब पीछे हटना नामुमकिन
definition: stage beyond which turning backward becomes impossible, commitment running entirely forward
example: Once the invitations were printed, they had passed the point of no return, so her mother started ordering marigolds.

hindi: दोष दूसरे पर डालना — उंगली उठाना
definition: publicly blame somebody else, damaging their reputation while protecting yourself from consequences
example: He pointed the finger at his younger brother the moment their mother asked about the broken window.

hindi: मज़ाक बनाना — किसी पर हँसी उड़ाना
definition: mock somebody openly for amusement, criticise their habits playfully while everybody listening enjoys teasing
example: The children poked fun at their teacher's careful handwriting until she copied their scrawl perfectly on the blackboard.

hindi: सोते शेर को जगाना — जान-बूझकर खतरनाक व्यक्ति को छेड़ना
definition: deliberately provoke someone dangerous, inviting angry conflict that sensible people would carefully avoid
example: Asking the librarian why the closing bell rang early was poking the bear, and the whole reading room knew it.

hindi: भावहीन चेहरा — मन की बात छिपा लेना
definition: expression revealing nothing whatever about feelings, hiding your intentions from watching rivals
example: She kept a perfect poker face through the entire announcement, then cried happily beside the water cooler five minutes later.

hindi: सबसे आगे की जगह — शुरुआत से बढ़त
definition: strongest starting position giving clear advantage over everybody else competing
example: Arriving before dawn gave him pole position outside the ticket window, and he shared his flask with the shivering queue.

hindi: फटेहाल — सख़्त गरीबी में जीना
definition: extremely poor, owning hardly any money and unable to afford small everyday comforts
example: The poet was poor as a church mouse, yet he never let a visitor leave without tea.

hindi: विवाह का प्रस्ताव रखना — शादी के लिए पूछ बैठना
definition: propose marriage aloud, asking your partner formally about lifelong commitment together
example: He carried the ring around for three months before finally popping the question on the ferry.

hindi: चल बसना — जीवन समाप्त होना
definition: dying, said lightly in British usage about somebody's eventual peaceful death
example: She joked about popping her clogs before finishing the crossword, then filled the final square triumphantly.

hindi: ठंडा पानी डाल देना — उत्साह पर पानी फेरना
definition: dampen somebody's enthusiasm deliberately, showing polite doubt until their excitement quietly disappears
example: Grandfather poured cold water on the scooter plan with three quiet questions about petrol, and nobody mentioned it again.

hindi: ख़ाली बर्तन से देना — जो अपने पास नहीं वही बाँटना
definition: offer others energy and caring you simply lack, being completely exhausted yourself first
example: Her friend reminded her that nobody pours from an empty cup, then took the phone away and made toast.

hindi: आग पर पानी डालना — बिगड़ी बात शांत कर देना
definition: calm a rising tension with soothing words, cooling the hostility before an argument turns worse
example: The head waiter poured oil on troubled waters with an apology and a free round of dessert.

hindi: दिल खोलकर रख देना — मन की सारी बात कह देना
definition: describing private feelings openly at length, confessing sadness nobody previously suspected
example: She poured her heart out over two cups of tea, and her cousin simply listened without offering advice.

hindi: तख़्त के पीछे की ताक़त — असली फ़ैसले करने वाला छिपा व्यक्ति
definition: person holding secret control over decisions while another publicly appears responsible
example: The headmaster read the speeches, but the librarian was the power behind the throne in that school.

hindi: जिन्हें पता है उन्हें समझाना — बेकार की मेहनत
definition: persuading listeners already convinced, wasting argument nobody needed; American speakers prefer preach to the choir
example: Explaining monsoon drainage to the plumbers was preaching to the converted, and they let him finish politely anyway.

hindi: मोटी रकम — अच्छी-खासी कीमत चुकाना
definition: a surprisingly large amount of money spent on something more expensive than expected
example: Grandmother's wedding sari cost a pretty penny in 1971, and it still hangs in the almirah.

hindi: भटका बेटा — पछताकर घर लौटा
definition: wasteful young family member returning humbly after squandering money living abroad
example: The prodigal son arrived at midnight with one bag, and his mother lit the stove without asking anything.

hindi: अपनी ऊर्जा बचाना — जो थकाए उससे दूरी
definition: guarding your calm deliberately, limiting people, drama, demands that drain everything inside
example: She protects her energy on Sundays: phone face down, one long walk, nobody's crisis borrowed before Monday morning.

hindi: अपना सुकून बचाना — अशांति से दूरी बनाना
definition: guarding personal calm firmly, leaving conversations and people that reliably create distress
example: Sana muted the family group after midnight, protecting her peace so mornings could begin with birds instead of arguments.

hindi: चकमा देना — चालाकी से झाँसा दे जाना
definition: tricking trusting victim with clever false move finished before anyone notices anything wrong
example: He swapped the queue tokens while everyone stared at the platform announcement, and pulled a fast one on the whole line.

hindi: रात भर जागकर पढ़ना — नींद छोड़कर तैयारी करना
definition: study through entire night without sleeping, cramming lessons before morning examinations
example: The hostel corridor smelled of instant coffee because half the floor was pulling an all-nighter before economics.

hindi: मुँह पर सुनाना — बिना लाग-लपेट के सच बोलना
definition: criticise someone bluntly, delivering harsh criticism without softening painful words even slightly
example: The tailor pulled no punches about the jacket, and the groom was quietly grateful for it later.

hindi: पूरा ज़ोर लगा देना — सारे साधन झोंक देना
definition: make every possible effort, using each available resource without holding anything back
example: For their parents' fortieth anniversary the sisters pulled out all the stops: garden lights, a cellist, and the family's oldest recipes.

hindi: रुतबा दिखाकर बात मनवाना — तर्क नहीं, ओहदे का ज़ोर
definition: settle a disagreement by using superior authority instead of winning through reasoning or evidence
example: When the argument over the menu dragged past midnight, Grandmother simply pulled rank, and mutton biryani was decided.

hindi: टांग खींचना — मज़ाक में झूठ बोलकर छेड़ना
definition: tease somebody playfully with harmless untruths, joking gently rather than intending genuine deception
example: Grandfather insisted peacocks lived inside the water tank, then laughed and admitted he was pulling the child's leg.

hindi: और सुनाओ — यानी तुम्हारी बात पर यक़ीन नहीं
definition: a British reply refusing belief, accusing somebody of teasing rather than reporting truth
example: He swore the cat had answered the telephone, and his sister just said pull the other one and kept stirring.

hindi: बीच में ही बंद कर देना — चलती चीज़ से सहारा हटा लेना
definition: to deliberately stop supporting something, ending an activity permanently before natural completion
example: They pulled the plug on the summer play three days before opening, and the cast ate the celebration cake anyway.

term: pull the rug out from under
hindi: पैरों तले ज़मीन खींच लेना — अचानक सहारा छीन लेना
definition: remove essential support suddenly, leaving somebody helpless without warning
example: The landlord pulled the rug out from under them a fortnight before the move, and friends arrived with a van by evening.

hindi: डोर हिलाना — पर्दे के पीछे से सब चलाना
definition: hold secret control over events while other people publicly appear responsible
example: The committee chairman smiled for the cameras, but the treasurer had been pulling the strings all season.

term: pull the wool over your eyes
hindi: आँखों में धूल झोंकना — भरोसा जीतकर पूरी तरह बेवकूफ़ बनाना
definition: deceive someone thoroughly, keeping them from seeing plain truth about something
example: The mechanic tried to pull the wool over my eyes about the new brakes.

hindi: जड़ से उखाड़ना — पूरी तरह मिटा देना
definition: remove harmful trouble completely including hidden causes, preventing stubborn return later
example: They pulled the leaking pipe up by the roots rather than patching it, and the kitchen stayed dry all monsoon.

hindi: पुल उठा लेना — अपने आप को सबसे बंद कर लेना
definition: closing yourself away from other people deliberately, refusing visitors, conversation, further demands
example: After a fortnight of relatives and phone calls she pulled up the drawbridge, cooked khichdi, and answered nobody until Monday.

hindi: कमर कसना — कामकाज सुधारना
definition: improve careless effort quickly, working harder after disappointing performance (British)
example: After the terrible mid-term marks, she pulled her socks up and started studying beside the window every morning.

hindi: अपना बोझ खुद उठाना — अपने हिस्से का काम करना
definition: doing your fair share of shared responsibility, contributing honest work other people rightly expect
example: The youngest pulled his weight all winter, hauling water before anybody thought about asking him.

hindi: कठपुतली नचाने वाला — दूसरों को अपने इशारों पर चलाने वाला
definition: someone with secret control over other people while publicly appearing uninvolved
example: In every village drama there is a puppet master, and here it was the man who owned the sound system.

hindi: दिल खोलकर खर्च करना — जश्न पर जमकर पैसा लगाना
definition: to spend money lavishly on celebration, paying freely for extra comfort and generous treats
example: For their fiftieth anniversary the couple pushed the boat out and hired the whole terrace garden.

hindi: दुखती रग छेड़ना — जान-बूझकर चिढ़ाना
definition: deliberately provoke annoyance, raising touchy subjects certain to spark quick anger
example: My younger brother knows exactly how to push my buttons, and he grins for a whole minute before I even react.

hindi: किस्मत को ज़्यादा आज़माना — मिली रियायत पर और अड़ना
definition: risk losing existing good fortune by demanding still more from generous circumstances
example: Having already received extra jalebis, the youngest pushed his luck and asked about pocket money, which ended negotiations immediately.

hindi: मिट्टी ओढ़कर सोना — दफ़न हो चुका, यानी मरा हुआ
definition: gardening euphemism describing someone buried, death softened into flowers above
example: The old cricketer laughed that half his winning eleven was already pushing up daisies.

hindi: उत्साह ठंडा कर देना — माहौल फीका पड़ जाना
definition: dampen general enthusiasm, leaving cheerful gathering suddenly subdued and awkward
example: The power cut put a damper on the party until somebody found candles and started singing anyway.

hindi: चुप कर! — बकवास बंद करने की खरी हिदायत
definition: blunt demand that somebody holds back noisy words and stays completely quiet
example: Halfway through the film, someone behind us begged the commentators to put a sock in it.

term: put a spoke in your wheel
hindi: टाँग अड़ाना — किसी के काम में जान बूझकर रुकावट
definition: obstruct somebody deliberately, British phrasing for blocking carefully arranged plans
example: The landlord put a spoke in their wheel days before opening, and the brothers spent that evening redrawing everything.

hindi: जड़ें जमाना — कहीं स्थायी रूप से बस जाना
definition: settle permanently somewhere, building firmly rooted belonging instead of constant restless moving
example: After eleven rented flats they finally put down roots near the market, planting a lemon tree the first weekend.

hindi: हवा में उड़ना — बड़प्पन का दिखावा करना
definition: behaving with superior manners while pretending greater importance than your actual position deserves
example: Ramesh started putting on airs the week his son moved abroad, mentioning the flight timings to everybody at the tea stall.

hindi: नाटक करना — झूठे भाव दिखाना
definition: pretending emotions convincingly before other people, performing feelings nobody actually experiences inside
example: She put on an act of surprise for the party, though she had iced the cake herself.

hindi: ठंडा करके रखना — काम को फ़िलहाल रोककर एक तरफ़ रख देना
definition: postponed and kept inactive, stored away until someone revives interest later
example: They put the wedding on ice when his mother fell ill, and nobody minded; the cake baker simply wrote a new date beside the old.

hindi: टालमटोल करना — काम आगे खिसका देना
definition: postpone something indefinitely, delaying decisions everybody dislikes making, Irish phrase
example: The roof repair was put on the long finger for another season, until the first heavy rain settled the argument.

hindi: स्वागत के लिए द्वार खोलना — मेहमान को खुले दिल से बुलाना
definition: signal friendly welcome openly, encouraging visiting guests toward comfortable relaxed arrival
example: The new neighbours put out the welcome mat immediately, and within a week half the lane knew where their spare keys hung.

hindi: सबके सामने बेइज़्ज़त करना — सार्वजनिक फ़ज़ीहत
definition: publicly expose somebody's behaviour before large audience, deliberately maximising embarrassment
example: Instead of messaging him privately, she put him on blast in the group chat, screenshots included.

term: put the cart before the horse
hindi: गाड़ी को घोड़े के आगे जोतना — उल्टा क्रम अपनाना
definition: starting with the later step before finishing preparations that properly come first
example: Painting the nursery before the lease was signed put the cart before the horse, as the landlord cheerfully reminded them.

hindi: बंद करा देना — योजना पर पूरी रोक
definition: stopping plans completely in British usage, ruining arrangements nobody manages to revive afterwards
example: Three days of horizontal rain put the kibosh on their plans for a garden wedding beside the pond.

hindi: दो और दो जोड़ना — बिखरे संकेतों से सच्चाई भाँप लेना
definition: understands hidden truth quickly by connecting scattered details into a single obvious conclusion
example: Flour on his sleeve, the missing tin, and Amma put two and two together before tea.

hindi: खिड़कियाँ बंद कर लेना — भावनात्मक रूप से दरवाज़ा बंद
definition: chiefly British; closing yourself emotionally against other people, refusing further conversation or questions
example: Ask him about the divorce and he puts up the shutters, offering tea instead of answers until the subject quietly changes.

hindi: कमर कसकर लगना — पूरी जान लगाकर मेहनत करना
definition: apply serious physical effort willingly, pushing harder instead of working feebly
example: Once the boys finally put their backs into it, the stuck almirah slid across the room and everybody cheered like cricket.

hindi: पाँव पसारना — काम के बाद आराम करना
definition: relaxed, comfortable rest taken after finishing work, allowing yourself deserved quiet leisure, stillness
example: The last guest left, the dishes could wait, and she finally put her feet up with cold coffee.

hindi: पाँव जमा देना — सख्ती से मना कर देना
definition: refuse firmly to permit something continuing, applying your authority against mounting pressure
example: When the third sleepover request arrived before exams, their mother finally put her foot down, kindly but completely.

term: put your foot in your mouth
hindi: मुँह से बुरी बात निकल जाना — बेवजह शर्मिंदगी
definition: cause embarrassment through tactless words, saying something clumsy that offends people unintentionally
example: Asking whether the photograph showed her mother rather than herself, he realised immediately that he had put his foot in his mouth.

hindi: हाथ उठाकर गलती कबूलना — बरतानवी अंदाज़ में साफ़ इक़रार
definition: admit fault immediately, British usage, accepting blame before anybody accuses
example: He put his hand up about the broken window straight away, which softened the caretaker considerably.

hindi: अपना घर पहले सँभालना — अपने मामले दुरुस्त करना
definition: prepare by settling your own affairs properly before trouble or scrutiny arrives
example: Before the audit letter even reached them, the old shopkeeper put his house in order and squared every ledger.

term: put your shoulder to the wheel
hindi: कंधा लगाना — मिलकर पूरी ताक़त से जुट जाना
definition: commit determined strength completely toward difficult shared task, pushing until visible progress appears
example: Every family put their shoulder to the wheel before the festival, and the muddy lane became walkable within a single afternoon.

hindi: दिमाग़ पर ज़ोर देना — सोच-विचार शुरू करना
definition: begin thinking carefully about problem, concentrating hard before offering considered answer
example: Grandmother put her thinking cap on and found the missing key inside the rice tin within minutes.

hindi: मैदान में उतरना — दिल खोलकर सामने आना
definition: risk romantic rejection openly, meeting strangers instead of waiting safely alone indoors
example: After a quiet year she finally put herself out there, joining the pottery class purely because strangers went there.

hindi: खेल बिगाड़ना — दूसरे की योजना चौपट करना
definition: spoiling somebody's careful plans in British usage, ruining arrangements before they begin
example: Announcing the surprise party in the family group chat rather queered the pitch for everybody else.

hindi: फुर्ती से — बिजली की सी तेज़ी में जवाब देना
definition: reacting extremely quickly, moving or answering before anyone expects response
example: Quick as a flash, my grandmother caught the falling teacup, still humming the song she had been humming all morning.

hindi: बात पकड़ने में तेज़ — इशारा भर काफ़ी होता है
definition: understands a fresh explanation almost immediately, rarely needing repetition before grasping small details
example: The new baker was quick on the uptake; one demonstration and the loaves came out perfect.

hindi: फटाफट सीखने वाला — जल्दी समझ जाने वाला
definition: person learning unfamiliar material rapidly, understanding fresh lessons after minimal explanation
example: The new apprentice proved a quick study, wiring the shop lights correctly before the electrician finished explaining.

hindi: दबे पाँव — चूहे जैसी चुप्पी
definition: almost soundless, moving carefully through quiet rooms so nobody notices you
example: She crept downstairs quiet as a mouse for the last laddoo, and found her father already there with the same idea.

hindi: पूरी चुप्पी — कोई जवाब नहीं आना
definition: complete absence of expected replies, leaving messages unanswered while everybody waits anxiously
example: There was radio silence from the group chat all weekend, so she finally telephoned her friend like people did before.

hindi: गुस्सा भड़काने वाला चारा — जानबूझकर उकसावा
definition: content designed deliberately provoking furious argument, harvesting attention from annoyed audience
example: The headline was pure rage bait, and half the family argued about it before anybody read further.

hindi: रंग में भंग डालना — किसी की ख़ुशी बिगाड़ना
definition: spoil someone's happiness deliberately, dampening excitement they were openly enjoying
example: She hated raining on his parade, so the broken oven news waited until after the birthday candles.

hindi: मूसलाधार बरसात — पानी की झड़ी लगना
definition: raining extremely heavily, water falling hard enough soaking anybody walking outside
example: It began raining cats and dogs during the school picnic, and thirty children ate their sandwiches happily inside the bus.

hindi: बाज़ी ऊँची करना — नतीजे को और भारी बना देना
definition: increase whatever stands risked, making the eventual outcome matter considerably more than before
example: Announcing the match on the school notice board raised the stakes, and suddenly even the shyest player began practising before breakfast.

hindi: आड़े हाथों लेना — गलती पर कड़ी फटकार लगाना
definition: scold someone severely, delivering harsh criticism about mistakes they should clearly have avoided
example: The editor raked the young reporter over the coals for spelling the mayor's name three different ways.

hindi: मुर्गी के दाँत जैसा — जो कहीं मिलता ही नहीं
definition: extremely rare, seldom found anywhere despite searching patiently through many likely places
example: Parking spaces near the temple during festival week were rare as hen's teeth, so uncles walked cheerfully from the highway.

hindi: पंक्तियों के बीच पढ़ना — अनकही बात समझ लेना
definition: senses hidden meaning behind careful words that someone deliberately leaves politely unspoken
example: His letter praised the weather twice and never mentioned coming home; she read between the lines.

hindi: किसी को पढ़ लेना — मन की बात भाँप लेना
definition: understand another person's thoughts easily, sensing hidden feelings before anything gets spoken
example: His mother reads him like a book and had already warmed the milk before he admitted feeling unwell.

hindi: खरी-खोटी सुनाना — गुस्से में डाँट पिलाना
definition: scold someone loudly, delivering harsh criticism about behaviour that finally exhausted your patience
example: Amma read the riot act to all four children after finding paint handprints along the staircase wall.

hindi: माहौल भाँपना — मौके के मूड को समझना
definition: sense unspoken feeling among people present, adjusting words carefully before saying something unwelcome
example: He arrived ready with jokes, read the room once, and quietly offered to carry the tea tray instead.

hindi: हवा का रुख़ पढ़ना — छोटे संकेतों से नतीजा भाँपना
definition: guess likely outcomes from small unclear signals, understanding meaning others cannot notice
example: Uncle spent Sunday reading the tea leaves of ministry rumours, while everybody around insisted he simply enjoyed sounding informed.

hindi: जैसा बोओगे वैसा काटोगे — अपनी लापरवाही का भयानक फल
definition: suffer violent consequences that your earlier reckless behaviour quietly created
example: Having ignored every letter from the water board, the landlord reaped the whirlwind on the hottest week of summer.

hindi: जैसा बोओगे वैसा काटोगे — कर्मों का फल
definition: receive consequences matching earlier behaviour, harvesting exactly what your careless actions planted
example: He ignored every reminder about the loan papers, and reaped what he sowed when the office asked for them together.

hindi: आ बैल मुझे मार — तबाही का पक्का इंतज़ाम
definition: situation almost certain to become troublesome disaster, combining every wrong ingredient together
example: Three cooks, one stove and no shopping list was a recipe for disaster, so grandmother appointed herself supervisor.

hindi: ख़तरे की घंटी — रिश्ते में चेतावनी वाला लक्षण
definition: warning behaviour revealing somebody unsuitable, signalling likely trouble inside future relationship
example: Shouting at the waiter over cold rasam was the red flag, and her friend simply raised both eyebrows across the table.

hindi: आँखों पर खून चढ़ना — गुस्से में सुध-बुध खोना
definition: sudden blinding anger overwhelming judgement completely, making somebody reckless before reason returns, chiefly British usage
example: The red mist descended when the taxi scraped his scooter, and only the chaiwala's steady voice cooled him down.

hindi: लाल कपड़ा दिखाना — गुस्से को न्योता देना
definition: something certain to provoke furious anger immediately, inflaming somebody already easily irritated, chiefly British usage
example: Mentioning the umpire's decision was a red rag to a bull, so his wife quietly changed the channel.

hindi: निगरानी रखना — हाँकते रहना
definition: an American cowboy phrase meaning supervising people closely, watching constantly nobody wanders somewhere careless
example: Grandpa rode herd over four cousins, three bicycles and one escaping puppy, somehow returning everybody unharmed.

hindi: जान से प्यारा दोस्त — हर मुश्किल में साथ रहने वाला साथी
definition: fiercely loyal companion supporting someone through difficulty, staying beside them whenever trouble arrives
example: Anjali drove four hours in monsoon rain just to sit with him at the hospital, which is roughly the definition of a ride or die.

hindi: बराबर वाली सीट पर — साथ चलकर हिफ़ाज़त करना
definition: an American phrase meaning travelling inside the front passenger seat beside whoever happens to be driving
example: The youngest cousin finally won the right to ride shotgun, choosing music nobody else particularly wanted.

hindi: एकदम चंगा — पहले जैसा स्वस्थ
definition: completely healthy again, restored after illness without weakness or lingering trouble
example: After two days of soup and sleep the boy was right as rain, arguing about cricket scores before breakfast finished.

hindi: कुछ याद-सा आना — धुँधली पहचान जागना
definition: sound vaguely familiar, stirring partial memory without letting somebody recall complete details
example: The name rang a bell, and halfway through dinner she remembered they had shared a train compartment years earlier.

hindi: बड़प्पन दिखाना — छोटी बातों से ऊपर उठना
definition: answering insults with dignity instead, guarding personal calm rather than retaliating
example: Shabana rose above the whispering at the reunion, complimented somebody's saree sincerely, and enjoyed the rest of her evening.

hindi: शोर से ऊपर रहना — बातों का जवाब न देना
definition: keeping your composure while insults, gossip, provocation continue, refusing to answer anything
example: The comments under her recipe video turned unkind, so she rose above the noise and posted the next one anyway.

hindi: कम चली राह — सबसे अलग रास्ता
definition: unconventional path deliberately chosen, differing from routes most people quietly follow
example: She took the road less travelled into puppetry, and twenty years later schools invite her every winter.

hindi: एक कर्ज़ चुकाने को दूसरा लेना
definition: settle debt with money borrowed elsewhere, leaving another patient creditor still owing repayment
example: Robbing Peter to pay Paul got them through January, though nobody slept well doing it.

hindi: आगे कुआँ पीछे खाई — दोनों रास्ते बुरे
definition: choosing between equally unpleasant options where either careful decision brings certain difficulty, often 'between a rock and a hard place'
example: Selling the buffalo hurt, keeping her cost more, and Baba sat between a rock and a hard place until sunrise.

hindi: नाव हिलाना — बनी-बनाई व्यवस्था में खलल डालना
definition: disturb a settled arrangement by openly challenging those holding authority
example: Nobody wanted to rock the boat at the housing society meeting, so the broken lift stayed broken.

hindi: कँटीली राह — मुश्किलों भरा रास्ता
definition: long difficult course through repeated hardship before conditions finally begin improving
example: Learning classical singing proved a rocky road, but her teacher measured progress in years, never weeks.

hindi: पासा फेंकना — नतीजा पूरी तरह क़िस्मत के भरोसे छोड़ना
definition: risky choice whose outcome depends entirely upon random chance rather than careful judgement or control
example: Moving to the coast without work waiting was a roll of the dice, and they knew it while packing.

hindi: पीठ से फिसल जाना — कोई चुभन बाकी नहीं
definition: insults, criticism, unkindness leaving your composure completely untouched, disturbing nothing inside
example: Twenty years of coaching had taught him to let the parents' shouting roll off his back before the second half.

hindi: पलक-पाँवड़े बिछाना — शानदार स्वागत करना
definition: welcome somebody lavishly with special treatment, honouring important visitors through unusually generous arrangements
example: They rolled out the red carpet when their teacher visited, cooking three sweets although she wanted only conversation.

hindi: पासा फेंकना — नतीजा किस्मत के भरोसे छोड़ देना
definition: accept uncertain outcome deliberately, letting chance decide results that careful planning cannot control
example: They could wait another year for permission, or roll the dice and open the little bakery before the festival.

hindi: हालात से समझौता करना — चोट खाकर भी संभल जाना
definition: endure repeated setbacks flexibly, adapting instead of collapsing under painful pressure
example: Two flat tyres, a lost tent, rain every night, and still the children rolled with the punches and asked about tomorrow.

hindi: पैसों में खेलना — दौलत की कोई कमी न होना
definition: having such enormous wealth that money never runs short, comfortably rich beyond ordinary need
example: His cousin came back from Dubai rolling in money and bought everyone dinner three nights running.

term: roos loose in the top paddock
hindi: दिमाग़ ठिकाने पर नहीं — कुछ ढीला-ढाला
definition: muddled thinking, somebody slightly crazy, unreliable, hardly sensible whenever serious, said across Australia
example: Everyone agreed the inventor had roos loose in the top paddock, until his rainwater contraption watered the whole street.

hindi: गुलाबी चश्मा — बीती बातें सुहानी लगना
definition: remembering earlier times unrealistically pleasantly, ignoring difficulties that genuinely troubled everybody then, American variant rose-coloured
example: Uncle recalls hostel food through rose-tinted glasses, though his letters home complained about it weekly.

hindi: काम चलाऊ — अनगढ़ मगर काफ़ी
definition: crude approximate arrangement lacking careful finish, adequate although obviously unpolished
example: The rough and ready shelf held their entire library for eleven years without complaint from either wood or reader.

hindi: घाव पर नमक छिड़कना — दर्द फिर याद दिलाना
definition: deepening existing painful trouble deliberately, reminding someone about their humiliating failure repeatedly
example: Repeating the interview question aloud only rubbed salt in the wound, so his sister changed the subject toward mangoes.

hindi: नाक रगड़वाना — गलती बार-बार याद दिलाना
definition: remind somebody repeatedly about their humiliating mistake, worsening embarrassment through needless cruelty
example: She had won the argument already, so rubbing his nose in it only made the kitchen colder.

hindi: नागवार गुज़रना — बिना कारण खटकना
definition: cause unintended annoyance, leaving quiet irritation that never becomes open anger
example: His cheerful morning whistling rubbed the whole hostel corridor the wrong way, though nobody could explain quite why.

hindi: तिलमिला देना — किसी को नाराज़ कर देना
definition: spread annoyance among settled people, upsetting habits and stirring mild anger
example: Moving the tea trolley ruffled feathers across two floors until somebody wheeled it back to its old corner.

hindi: मोटा-मोटा नियम — अनुभव से बनी अंदाज़ी कसौटी
definition: rough practical guideline drawn from experience, useful although inaccurate about unusual cases
example: Her rule of thumb for rice was one knuckle of water, taught without measuring cups and never once wrong.

hindi: घर में हुकुम चलाना — घर का फ़ैसला अपने हाथ
definition: hold authority within a household, making decisions that other family members follow
example: Grandmother ruled the roost from a cane chair, deciding holidays, marriages, and which mango tree stayed standing.

hindi: अफ़वाहों का बाज़ार — गपशप फैलाने वाला जमघट
definition: informal network constantly grinding private gossip into stories that spread through everybody
example: The rumour mill had them moving abroad, opening a bakery, and adopting twins, all before Tuesday.

hindi: नाव किनारे अटक जाना — काम बीच में रुक जाना
definition: progress stops completely, leaving plans stranded without direction until somebody arranges rescue
example: The wedding preparations ran aground when the caterer vanished, and an aunt with a phonebook quietly saved the whole evening.

hindi: दम टूट जाना — ऊर्जा ख़त्म हो जाना
definition: an American phrase meaning strength declining midway, ability finished before reaching intended destination
example: The choir ran out of gas somewhere during the fourth encore, laughing through the final wobbly chorus.

hindi: वक़्त पूरा करना — समय ख़त्म होने तक बात खींचते रहना
definition: deliberately delaying until remaining time expires, stalling rather than taking action
example: The children ran out the clock at bedtime with water, questions about dinosaurs, and one urgent story that could absolutely not wait.

hindi: उँगलियों पर नचाना — बहुत आसानी से मात देना
definition: defeat rivals in a contest so completely that the result never looks close
example: Grandfather still runs rings around us at carrom, laughing between every impossible shot.

hindi: कोड़ों की क़तार से गुज़रना — चारों तरफ़ से ताने सुनते हुए निकलना
definition: endure hostile criticism from crowds lining your path, suffering repeated attacks throughout the whole passage
example: Carrying his failed report card, he ran the gauntlet of relatives between the gate and his own bedroom door.

hindi: गाड़ी अपने हिसाब से चलाना — सारा इंतज़ाम अपने हाथ में रखना
definition: control every important daily decision, deciding what other people must follow
example: The head chef was on holiday, so the twenty-two-year-old sous chef ran the show for a fortnight.

hindi: बेलगाम होना — बिना रोक-टोक मनमाना बर्ताव
definition: behave with complete freedom, without restriction, discipline, or supervision from anyone
example: For three weeks of holidays the cousins ran wild through the mango grove, returning only when hunger and mosquitoes drove them indoors.

hindi: बकबक करना — बिना सोचे सब बोल देना
definition: repeat private gossip carelessly, talking about others without considering damage caused afterwards
example: He ran his mouth about the engagement before the couple had told either family, and spent weeks apologising.

hindi: फिरकी की तरह चलना — बिल्कुल सधी हुई चाल
definition: working smoothly without trouble, steady performance continuing exactly like properly maintained machinery
example: Grandfather's scooter was still running like a top, and he refused every offer of something newer.

hindi: आख़िरी साँस पर चलना — बची-खुची ताकत से काम चलाना
definition: continuing while exhausted, strength nearly finished, moving forward only slightly before collapse becomes certain
example: By the fourth day of the festival kitchen the volunteers were running on fumes, stirring pots and laughing at nothing.

hindi: उतावली में काम बिगाड़ना — धैर्य वाले काम में हड़बड़ी
definition: hurrying something that needs patience, starting before careful preparations properly finish
example: Don't rush your fences with the sourdough; the starter needs another quiet night on the windowsill.

hindi: पक्की बात — जिसमें हारने का डर नहीं
definition: choice almost certain to succeed, carrying very little genuine risk worth worrying about
example: Ordering extra rasgullas was always a safe bet at family gatherings, because even the fussiest cousins finished their plates.

hindi: भरोसे के हाथ — काम सौंपकर निश्चिंत
definition: thoroughly dependable person trusted with important responsibility, steady, reliable, never dropping anything crucial
example: They handed her the accounts because she was a safe pair of hands, and slept better than they had all year.

hindi: सुरक्षा जाल — गिरने पर बचा लेने वाला सहारा
definition: arrangement kept in reserve, protecting someone against sudden hardship or complete failure
example: He quit the bank to paint, knowing his brother's spare room was the safety net beneath him.

hindi: झूठा भेस धरना — पहचान छिपाकर चलना
definition: operating behind borrowed identity, hiding hostile intentions beneath harmless friendly outward appearance
example: He sailed under false colours through three weddings before somebody recognised him from the missing bicycle poster.

hindi: जवानी के दिन — बेफ़िक्री का शुरुआती दौर
definition: youthful carefree early years remembered fondly, before heavy responsibility arrived
example: In her salad days she shared one room with four girls, and still calls that year the happiest.

hindi: नेक इंसान — सीधा-सादा और भरोसेमंद व्यक्ति
definition: honest, reliable, unpretentious people whose decency, kindness, kept promises earn lasting trust
example: The couple running the corner bakery remembered every child's birthday: salt of the earth, everybody agreed.

hindi: वही ढाक के तीन पात — हर बार वही किस्सा
definition: familiar tiresome situation repeating again predictably, disappointing everybody exactly like before
example: Late buses and full seats, the same old story, so the neighbours shared an autorickshaw and laughed about it.

hindi: बुरे दिनों के लिए जोड़ना — मुश्किल वक्त के वास्ते बचत करना
definition: keep money quietly in reserve, protecting yourself against harder times arriving later
example: Every month she folded two notes into the tin behind the rice, saving for a rainy day nobody wanted to name.

term: say the quiet part out loud
hindi: मन की बात मुँह पर आ जाना — जो सब सोचते थे वही बोल देना
definition: state openly the embarrassing truth everybody understood although nobody intended mentioning
example: The youngest cousin said the quiet part out loud about who really cooked lunch, and three aunts suddenly needed water.

hindi: मुश्किल से रोज़ी कमाना
definition: manage with little, surviving upon small earnings from whatever work happens to become available
example: He scraped a living mending bicycles, and half the village learned to ride on his repairs.

hindi: ऊपर-ऊपर देखना — गहराई तक नहीं पहुँचना
definition: examine only shallow outer portion, missing larger complicated problem lying underneath
example: Their weekend cleaning barely scratched the surface, because every cupboard opened onto another decade of saved carrier bags.

hindi: सिर खुजाना — उलझन में पड़ जाना
definition: feel puzzled and confused, unable to understand something that makes little obvious sense
example: The recipe called for two cups of flour and then, four lines later, none at all; Meera scratched her head.

hindi: पेट काटकर बचाना — कम खर्च कर जोड़ना
definition: spend money sparingly and hoard small amounts, refusing ordinary comforts to build modest savings
example: Mum scrimped and saved for years, and the piano that arrived was worth every skipped holiday.

hindi: नहा-धोकर पहचान बदल जाना — तैयार होते ही रूप निखर आना
definition: said mainly across British households: transforming surprisingly handsome once washed, dressed properly beyond weekday scruffiness
example: His sister laughed that farmhands scrub up well, then straightened his collar twice before the photographer noticed anything.

hindi: मंसूबे डुबो देना — काम शुरू होने से पहले ख़त्म
definition: sinking somebody's arrangements in British usage, ruining plans before they ever sail
example: A single missing signature scuppered their plans, so they spent the afternoon feeding ducks instead.

hindi: आदत में शुमार होना — बिना सोचे सहज हो जाना
definition: behaviour performed easily, automatically, without thinking, effort, conscious attention, following years repeated practice
example: Checking the stove twice before leaving became second nature after that winter kitchen fire.

hindi: लासानी — जिसका कोई सानी नहीं
definition: better in quality than everyone else, ranked above every rival within the group
example: The old baker's morning bread was second to none, and the queue proved it daily.

hindi: नई ऊर्जा का संचार — थकान के बाद दोबारा जोश आना
definition: renewed energy that lets somebody continue a difficult effort after exhaustion nearly stopped them
example: Twenty kilometres into the walk her legs were gone, then the smell of pine hit and she found a second wind.

hindi: एक राय होना — सोच में पूरी सहमति
definition: reach complete agreement with somebody, sharing similar opinions instead of arguing about differences
example: The sisters rarely saw eye to eye about music, though both agreed the neighbours played theirs far too loudly.

hindi: अंत तक निभाना — शुरू किया काम पूरा करके ही छोड़ना
definition: continue a difficult commitment until the finish, refusing to quit partway through
example: He promised his grandmother he would finish the boat they started together, and he saw it through, plank by crooked plank.

hindi: खून खौलना — गुस्से में अंधा हो जाना
definition: become instantly furious, losing clear judgement when blinding anger overwhelms reason
example: She usually stays gentle, but she saw red when the boys started throwing stones at the street dogs.

hindi: आँख खुलना — उलझन के बाद अचानक सच दिख जाना
definition: suddenly understands truth after confusion, realizing something obvious that stayed puzzling before
example: After the third burnt batch, she finally saw the light and lowered the oven temperature.

hindi: आज का दिन जी लेना — वर्तमान क्षण का पूरा उपयोग करना
definition: grasp the present moment completely and take action today, rather than saving every chance for some safer, later moment
example: He had circled the ferry timings for three summers running; this year he seized the day, packed nothing, and simply went.

hindi: ख़राब माल टिका देना — नुक़्स छिपाकर बेच देना
definition: cheating hopeful buyer with defective goods while hiding faults, taking honest money dishonestly
example: The scooter shone beautifully in the photographs, and the engine died before the second monsoon; they had sold him a lemon.

hindi: बेच खाना — भरोसा करने वाले को धोखा देना
definition: betraying trusted friends secretly, harming loyal people seeking personal profit, comfort, advantage
example: He promised to protect his cousin's share, then sold him down the river for a slightly larger room.

hindi: हाथों-हाथ बिकना — माल उड़ जाना
definition: an American phrase meaning goods selling extremely quickly, eager buyers emptying stock almost immediately
example: Her hand-painted mugs sold like hotcakes at the school fair, leaving nothing behind except paint under her fingernails.

hindi: जेल भेज दिया जाना — अदालत से सज़ा पाकर
definition: ordered into prison punishment directly from courtroom sentencing, British phrasing
example: Their Manchester landlord was sent down that winter, and nobody along the terrace could stop discussing it over fences.

hindi: अदा दिखाना — एक के बाद एक शानदार पहनावा पेश करना
definition: displaying strikingly stylish appearance confidently, outfits assembled purely for maximum admiring attention
example: Across four wedding days Rhea kept serving looks, while her brother rotated between exactly whichever shirt smelled cleanest.

hindi: तहलका मचा देना — चारों ओर हलचल और वाहवाही
definition: achieve something dazzling enough to earn sudden fame and excited admiration everywhere
example: He never set the world on fire, yet every student remembered his chemistry classes.

hindi: अक्ल का धनी — जिसकी बुद्धि उम्र के साथ भी तेज़ बनी रहे
definition: understands things quickly and remembers small details, staying mentally alert despite advanced years
example: Grandmother beat every one of us at cards again, sharp as a tack at ninety-one.

hindi: अक्ल का पैदल — समझ में कुछ धीमा इंसान
definition: mildly foolish person lacking quick intelligence, kindly phrased judgement about slower thinking
example: He was never the sharpest tool in the shed, but he remembered every birthday and always arrived carrying something warm.

hindi: सब ठीक हो जाएगा — चिंता मत करो
definition: reassurance, common across Australia, that present trouble will settle itself without anxious worry, also heard as she'll be apples
example: The tent pole snapped, but Dad said she'll be right, then propped everything with a cricket bat until morning.

hindi: तलवार म्यान में रखना — लड़ाई अपनी मर्ज़ी से रोकना
definition: stop fighting deliberately, ending a lengthy quarrel while both sides still keep their strength
example: The brothers sheathed the sword over the mango tree the winter their mother fell ill, and never raised it again.

hindi: दोष दूसरे पर डालना — अपनी गलती किसी और के सिर
definition: move blame onto another person, escaping punishment for your genuine fault
example: Rather than admit the numbers were wrong, he shifted the blame onto the intern who had merely typed them.

hindi: अब गाड़ी छूट गई — मौका हाथ से निकल गया
definition: opportunity gone permanently, since acting became impossible after everybody moved beyond that particular chance
example: He finally decided to apply for the hostel room, but the ship had sailed and even the warden looked apologetic.

hindi: बिना सोचे तीर चलाना — तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया दे देना
definition: acting hastily without proper thought, reacting immediately instead of weighing careful judgement
example: Asked about the recipe, Nani shoots from the hip, and somehow the answer always tastes right.

hindi: बातों में समय बिताना — बेमतलब सुखद गपशप
definition: pass time chatting idly about unimportant subjects, enjoying easy conversation rather than useful discussion
example: We stood shooting the breeze beside the tea stall while the rain decided whether it wanted to start again.

hindi: गप्पें हाँकना — बेमतलब की बातचीत करना
definition: an American phrase, also heard as shoot the breeze, meaning relaxed aimless chatter about unimportant everyday matters
example: They stood beside the pickup shooting the bull about fishing until the sunlight finally slipped behind the grain silo.

hindi: हिम्मत करके बोल देना — मौका हाथ से न जाने देना
definition: approach somebody attractive despite likely refusal, risking rejection rather than wondering forever
example: He shot his shot beside the library photocopier, mumbled everything wrong, and somehow received a phone number anyway.

hindi: अपने पैर पर कुल्हाड़ी मारना — अपना ही नुक़सान कर बैठना
definition: someone damages their cause through careless actions that harm nobody except themselves
example: He shot himself in the foot arguing with the referee, and watched the rest of the match from the bench.

hindi: मटके में मछली मारना — बिलकुल आसान शिकार
definition: absurdly easy, aimed against defenceless targets that cannot possibly escape harm
example: Beating his little sister at carrom felt like shooting fish in a barrel, so he started letting her open the board.

hindi: कम तौलना — हक़ से कम देकर ठगना
definition: cheating trusting person deliberately, returning less honest money than the buyer rightfully deserved
example: The vegetable seller weighed the tomatoes with a thumb resting on the scale, short-changing every customer in the evening rush.

hindi: चेतावनी की गोली — पहले से आगाह करना
definition: sharp early warning, chiefly British wording, showing punishment follows unless behaviour changes
example: The landlord's letter was a shot across the bows, polite enough, though everybody upstairs began paying rent promptly afterwards.

hindi: अंधेरे में तीर — बेतुका अनुमान
definition: an American phrase for wild uncertain guess offered without information, hoping approximate answer somehow lands correctly
example: Her answer during the quiz final was pure shot in the dark, and the entire table erupted when it landed.

hindi: दोष अपने सिर लेना — जिम्मेदारी खुद उठाना
