definition: accept responsibility openly, carrying blame yourself instead of naming other people
example: She shouldered the blame for the missed deadline, though half the team knew she had warned everybody twice.

hindi: कंधा देने वाला — दुख कहने की जगह
definition: dependable sympathetic listener offering comfort, letting somebody release unhappy feelings without judgement
example: She wanted advice from nobody, only a shoulder to cry on, and her friend understood without being told.

hindi: बाहर का रास्ता दिखाना — अवांछित मेहमान को विदा करना
definition: dismiss an unwelcome visitor firmly, forcing them outside your household immediately
example: After the third rude remark about the cooking, grandmother showed him the door with a smile nobody dared argue against.

hindi: पत्ते खोलना — अपनी योजना खुलकर सामने रख देना
definition: reveal your hidden position openly, letting others finally learn the secret plans held back earlier
example: After an hour of polite circling, he finally showed his cards and admitted the family wanted to sell the orchard.

hindi: असली रंग दिखाना — छिपा चेहरा सामने आना
definition: revealing hidden character once careful pretence becomes impossible, exposing reality behind long presentation
example: The quiet neighbour showed his true colours during the flood, carrying strangers' children upstairs until midnight.

hindi: शर्मीला स्वभाव — भीड़ से कतराने वाला
definition: painfully timid person avoiding attention, retreating whenever unfamiliar strangers notice them
example: The shrinking violet of the family sang beautifully, but only after every guest had gone home.

hindi: इस नश्वर देह से मुक्ति — दुनिया छोड़ जाना
definition: dying, leaving worldly troubles behind through death, from British literary usage
example: Uncle read Hamlet aloud, announcing that whenever he shuffles off this mortal coil somebody must inherit his slippers.

hindi: बहुत बीमार — उठने तक की हालत नहीं
definition: violently unwell with nausea and dizziness, barely able to stand upright anywhere
example: He arrived from the wedding sick as a dog, and his mother blamed the roadside kulfi without waiting for evidence.

hindi: बीच का भटकाव — असली काम पड़ा रह गया
definition: unplanned detour swallowing attention while important chapters of your life wait unfinished
example: The pottery classes became a lovely side quest, though her half-written thesis watched from the same table.

hindi: तमाशबीन निरीक्षक — काम देखकर मुफ़्त राय देने वाला
definition: an American term for onlooker watching workers closely, offering criticism without holding real responsibility
example: Two retired neighbours became sidewalk superintendents outside the building site, bringing folding chairs and strong coffee every morning.

hindi: क़ब्र जैसी ख़ामोशी — पूरी तरह सन्नाटा
definition: completely soundless, holding quiet secrecy however long anybody keeps listening nearby
example: The classroom went silent as the grave when the headmaster asked who had drawn the moustache on the founder's portrait.

hindi: सिरफिरा जैसा — बेवजह उछल-कूद करने वाला
definition: scatty foolish behaviour, somebody cheerfully unreliable, hardly sensible about anything, Australian simile
example: Their cousin acted silly as a two-bob watch at the party, and by midnight even the grandparents were dancing.

hindi: अँधेरे में उजाले की किरण — बुरे में भी अच्छा
definition: consoling advantage hidden inside genuinely unfortunate circumstances, offering comfort during obvious difficulty
example: The cancelled train had a silver lining, because they finally walked through the old bazaar together.

hindi: सदियों से — जब से याद है
definition: covering extremely long period, since remembered history began, British phrase
example: The sweetshop had stood beside the bus stand since the year dot, weighing laddus with the same brass scales.

hindi: रोटी के बदले गाना — सेवा देकर पाना
definition: performing some service before receiving reward, entertaining hosts instead of accepting plain charity
example: The travelling puppeteer sang for his supper every winter, trading two shows for a warm room.

hindi: दुखड़ा सुनाना — अपनी उदासी बार-बार गिनाना
definition: complain repeatedly about personal sadness and misfortune, sharing gloomy feelings with anybody listening
example: Grandfather sang the blues about his knees until the children dragged him outside to umpire their match.

hindi: तैरो या डूबो — अपने बल पर ही बचना
definition: surviving entirely alone without help, either managing somehow otherwise failing completely
example: They handed him the accounts ledger, said sink or swim, and by Diwali he understood the figures better than anybody expected.

hindi: दो नावों में पैर रखना — किसी एक पक्ष में फैसला नहीं लेना
definition: refusing deliberately to choose either side, staying neutral while everyone waits impatiently for your decision
example: Every cousin argued about the wedding venue while Nanaji sat on the fence, sipping chai and admiring the ceiling fan.

hindi: टस से मस न होना — जान-बूझकर कोई कदम न उठाना
definition: deliberately delaying every response, refusing action while other people await movement
example: Everyone sat on their hands about the leaking roof until October rain settled the argument in a single loud afternoon.

hindi: जमे रहना — हिले-डुले बिना धीरज से प्रतीक्षा करना
definition: waiting patiently without moving, resisting every urge toward rushing into hasty action
example: Sit tight until the rain passes, her mother said, pouring another cup and pulling the shutters closed.

hindi: बैठा शिकार — बिना बचाव खुला निशाना
definition: completely defenceless target, easily harmed because nobody provides shelter against obvious danger
example: Parked under the mango tree during the storm, the little car was a sitting duck, and the branch found it by midnight.

hindi: बारूद के ढेर पर बैठना — कभी भी फट सकने वाली हालत
definition: waiting inside dangerously unstable situation where sudden violent trouble could explode almost anytime
example: With both brothers seated beside the property papers, everyone realised dinner was sitting on a powder keg and served extra sweets.

hindi: मिट्टी में मिल जाना — कब्र में दफ़्न होना
definition: buried underground after death, describing a person who passed away and lies beneath grave soil
example: She still argues with her father, though he has been six feet under since the winter she turned thirty.

term: six of one, half a dozen
hindi: वही ढाक के तीन पात — दोनों बराबर
definition: either option amounts to exactly the same result, difference hardly worth further argument
example: Train or bus, it was six of one, half a dozen, so they picked whichever left before dinner.

hindi: छठी इंद्रिय — बिना प्रमाण के सच भाँप लेना
definition: senses hidden danger or meaning without evidence, catching what ordinary careful observation misses
example: Some sixth sense made her turn back for the stove; the flame was still burning.

hindi: पतली बर्फ़ पर चलना — खतरे के बिलकुल किनारे होना
definition: behave carelessly in a dangerous position, inviting serious trouble from slight mistakes
example: Borrowing the neighbour's scooter without asking again, he knew he was skating on thin ice.

hindi: घर का भेद — छिपाया हुआ पारिवारिक राज़
definition: shameful family secret hidden from outsiders, embarrassing relatives across several generations
example: Sorting the attic, they found letters revealing a skeleton in the closet nobody had mentioned across three generations of Sunday lunches.

hindi: ऊपरी चमक — सिर्फ़ सतह तक
definition: existing only across the outward surface, with nothing beneath the pleasant appearance worth trusting
example: Their friendship looked skin deep until the hospital night proved everybody comfortably wrong.

hindi: ज़मानत तोड़कर भागना — पेशी पर हाज़िर न होना
definition: vanish before promised courtroom appearance after release, abandoning money pledged toward guaranteed attendance
example: The contractor skipped bail, and his brother-in-law spent that whole monsoon apologising to everybody who had signed papers.

hindi: हल्की डाँट — गंभीर गलती पर मामूली सज़ा
definition: punishment gentle enough that serious wrongdoing carries almost nothing painful, discouraging nobody afterwards
example: Breaking the neighbour's window earned nothing worse than a slap on the wrist, so both boys were back with the bat by evening.

hindi: मच्छर पर तोप — छोटी बात पर बड़ा ज़ोर
definition: enormous excessive force applied against trivial problem needing only gentle careful handling
example: Calling three lawyers over a broken flowerpot was a sledgehammer to crack a nut, and both families later laughed about it.

hindi: नींद का उधार — कम सोने का हिसाब चुकता होना बाक़ी
definition: accumulated exhaustion from months of short nights, quietly draining concentration, patience, humour
example: Two quiet weekends barely dented the sleep debt he had gathered across a whole examination season.

hindi: सोच-विचार कर बताना — रात भर सोचना
definition: postpone decisions overnight, letting tired judgement recover before choosing anything important
example: She wanted to accept immediately, but her aunt insisted she sleep on it, and morning brought three sensible questions.

hindi: चुपके से संदेश भेजना — निजी बातचीत शुरू करने की कोशिश
definition: approach someone privately through direct messages, hoping romantic conversation begins without public attention
example: He slid into her dms with a question about her bookshelf, which everybody agreed showed considerable strategic patience.

hindi: बंधन तोड़ना — पट्टा छुड़ाकर आज़ाद घूमना
definition: escape from close control or confinement and enjoy sudden unsupervised freedom
example: For one golden afternoon the children slipped the leash, wandering the orchard until the light went orange and somebody rang a bell for dinner.

hindi: हाथ आया मौका गँवाना — मौका फिसल जाना
definition: allowing valuable opportunity escape through carelessness, losing chance nobody offers anybody twice
example: The scholarship slipped through his fingers over one unsigned form, and his teacher marked the deadline on next year's calendar.

hindi: कछुए की चाल — बहुत सुस्त और धीमी गति
definition: moving painfully slowly, taking forever before making even small forward progress
example: Their old dog was slow as molasses on the stairs, and the whole family learned to wait halfway down for him.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे किनारा — रिश्ता चुपचाप ठंडा पड़ना
definition: gradual reduction of romantic contact replacing honest ending, replies arriving slower until silence
example: It was a slow fade rather than a breakup, weekly calls becoming monthly, until neither remembered who stopped calling first.

term: small cog in a big wheel
hindi: बड़े चक्के का छोटा दाँता — तंत्र में नगण्य हैसियत
definition: minor insignificant person inside large organisation, holding almost none of genuine authority
example: She joined feeling like a small cog in a big wheel, until the senior clerk began saving her the window seat.

hindi: रात के पिछले पहर — आधी रात के बाद
definition: quiet hours after midnight, when night stretches toward morning without sleeping
example: They talked into the small hours about cousins nobody had seen for years, until the kettle finally went cold.

hindi: मामूली बात — बड़ी परेशानियों के आगे कुछ नहीं
definition: trivial unimportant matter beside genuinely serious concerns, hardly worth anybody's continued attention
example: Losing the deposit felt enormous until the harvest failed, after which it became small potatoes nobody mentioned again.

hindi: इधर-उधर की बातें — औपचारिक हल्की-फुल्की गपशप
definition: polite casual conversation about unimportant subjects, filling time pleasantly without discussing anything serious
example: They made small talk about the monsoon and the price of tomatoes until the doctor finally called their number.

hindi: दाल में कुछ काला है — गड़बड़ी की बू आ जाना
definition: senses hidden dishonesty behind smooth words before evidence proves that anyone actually lied
example: Three cousins suddenly offering to help move the almirah, and Papa began to smell a rat.

hindi: आँखों में धूल झोंकना — नज़र का धोखा
definition: dazzling surface display covering hollow substance, making real weakness appear impressive instead
example: Grandfather revealed his card trick as smoke and mirrors, then taught the children the whole clumsy secret.

hindi: पक्का सबूत — जुर्म साबित करने वाला निर्णायक प्रमाण
definition: conclusive evidence exposing hidden guilt, proving beyond argument the secret wrongdoing somebody worked carefully to conceal
example: The auditor found the smoking gun in a dull spreadsheet, one payment dated a Sunday nobody worked.

hindi: गाड़ी पटरी पर होना — सब सहज चलना
definition: period where everything continues smoothly, without trouble, resistance, obstacles, problems, unexpected delay
example: The first month of the bakery was chaos, but after they hired Meera it became smooth sailing.

hindi: आस्तीन का साँप — भरोसे में छिपा दुश्मन
definition: trusted companion hiding hostile intentions behind harmless friendly behaviour until betrayal finally arrives
example: She fed him lunch every Sunday for years before learning what a snake in the grass he had been about the land papers.

hindi: झूठी दवा — बेअसर चमत्कारी नुस्ख़ा
definition: worthless remedy sold with extravagant healing promises, curing nothing beyond seller's poverty
example: The stall promised height, memory and marriage from one bottle, which even the neighbours recognised as snake oil.

hindi: काम के बोझ तले दबना — फ़ुर्सत ही न मिलना
definition: buried beneath overwhelming quantity of tasks, unable to answer anybody properly
example: She was snowed under with wedding invitations, so her mother quietly took over addressing every envelope.

hindi: रजाई में दुबका होना — गर्म और आरामदेह
definition: extremely comfortable, relaxed, warm, settled somewhere sheltered, protected against cold weather outside
example: The children burrowed under three quilts while sleet rattled the window, snug as a bug.

hindi: अब तक सब ठीक — यहाँ तक तो निभ गया
definition: matters progressing acceptably until this moment, though nobody dares promising continued smoothness
example: Half the guests were fed and nothing had burned, so far so good, and Mummy allowed herself one cup of tea.

hindi: रिश्ते का इशारा भर — आधी तस्वीर से हिंट देना
definition: hinting about your relationship quietly online, showing your partner partially before announcing anything
example: The soft launch was one blurred elbow beside her coffee cup, which her hostel friends decoded within about four minutes.

hindi: दिल का कोना — किसी के लिए ख़ास नरमी
definition: quiet unreasonable affection toward somebody, forgiving faults nobody else would tolerate patiently
example: Grandmother has a soft spot for the neighbour's grandson, so his terrible singing receives applause nobody else earns.

hindi: चट्टान की तरह मज़बूत — भरोसे में कभी न डगमगाने वाला
definition: completely dependable, reliable, honest, steady, someone whose promises never weaken under pressure
example: Through the whole hospital month, her uncle stayed solid as a rock, arriving early, staying late, never once complaining.

hindi: बिल्कुल दुरुस्त होना — कोई तकलीफ़ नहीं
definition: enjoying excellent health, thoroughly examined afterwards with nothing whatever found wrong anywhere
example: Heart sound as a bell, the doctor said, and Papa forwarded that sentence to everyone.

hindi: वापसी का बिगुल बजाना — सबको पीछे हटने का इशारा
definition: signal that everybody should withdraw, admitting the attempted advance cannot possibly succeed against present resistance
example: Two hours into the leaking pipe, the plumber sounded the retreat and promised somebody stronger by Tuesday morning.

hindi: अंगूर खट्टे हैं — न मिलने पर बुरा कहना
definition: pretending scorn toward something desirable, disguising envy after failing to obtain
example: Calling the trophy cheap plastic was pure sour grapes, and even his younger sister said so at dinner.

hindi: बीज बोना — आगे के नतीजों की शुरुआत करना
definition: begin quiet actions certain to produce large consequences much later
example: That first shared tiffin box sowed the seeds of a friendship their families still talk about decades later.

hindi: जवानी की मस्ती — बेफिक्री भरे शौक
definition: indulging reckless youthful pleasures before settling toward responsible steady quieter living
example: He sowed his wild oats across two cities, then came home and grew tomatoes with startling seriousness.

hindi: काम में अड़ंगा — बनी बनाई योजना बिगाड़ देना
definition: sudden obstacle that wrecks carefully arranged plans, British phrasing for ruined arrangements
example: The power cut was a spanner in the works, so the wedding photographer shot the whole ceremony by lantern light.

hindi: नाम लिया और हाज़िर — चर्चा करते ही आ जाना
definition: cheerful remark thrown when somebody appears exactly while people discuss them
example: Speak of the devil, said Amit, as the very cousin they had been gossiping about walked through the gate carrying mangoes.

hindi: बिना बारी बोल पड़ना — बेमौका बात कहना
definition: offer unwelcome words at an improper moment, saying something tactless that others consider disrespectful
example: The youngest cousin spoke out of turn about the missing jewellery, and every spoon stopped moving at once.

hindi: एक ही भाषा बोलना — आपसी समझ पूरी
definition: share similar opinions and understanding with somebody, agreeing naturally without lengthy explanation
example: Two minutes into discussing bicycles they were speaking the same language, and nobody else understood another word.

hindi: पैसा पानी की तरह बहाना — बेहिसाब खर्च करना
definition: to spend money freely and lavishly, wasting large amounts without careful thought
example: During festival week the twins spend money like water, then survive on rice until the month turns.

hindi: राज़ खोल देना — छिपी बात मुँह से निकल जाना
definition: reveal secret information carelessly, usually before the proper moment arrives
example: Grandma spilled the beans about the surprise party while pouring the tea.

hindi: पूरी कहानी उगल देना — छिपी गपशप खोल देना
definition: share juicy private gossip eagerly, telling friends exactly what really happened
example: The moment the aunties left, my sister spilled the tea about the wedding budget while pouring everyone another round.

hindi: जहाँ के तहाँ रहना — मेहनत के बाद भी वहीं का वहीं
definition: expending steady effort without progress, working furiously while achieving nothing worthwhile
example: She spun her wheels rewriting the first paragraph until her sister took the pencil away.

hindi: बच्चों जैसा गुस्सा दिखाना — मुँह फुलाकर बिगड़ना
definition: lose temper childishly, sulking loudly whenever minor plans disappoint, said across Australia
example: Uncle spat the dummy over losing carrom, then sheepishly rejoined the game once someone poured him lemonade.

hindi: हूबहू नक़ल — शक्ल-सूरत में बिल्कुल एक जैसे
definition: person whose features closely resemble those of a relative, appearing almost identical
example: Grandmother held the wedding photograph beside her granddaughter and went quiet, because the girl was the spitting image of her at nineteen.

hindi: बीच का हिसाब कर लेना — दोनों तरफ़ बराबर छूट देना
definition: settle a haggle by taking the midpoint, so both sides make equal concessions and the compromise holds
example: The buyer wanted forty, the seller sixty, and they split the difference before the tea went cold.

hindi: एकदम दुरुस्त — रत्ती भर फ़र्क नहीं
definition: entirely accurate about something, chiefly British, correct enough that rechecking seems unnecessary
example: The tailor's guess about her sleeve length was spot on, measured only by looking, and she wore the kurta that evening.

hindi: आग की तरह फैलना — खबर बहुत तेज़ी से हर तरफ पहुँचना
definition: travel through crowds extremely quickly, reaching everybody before anybody bothers checking accuracy
example: News about the engagement spread like wildfire through the colony, arriving at her aunt's house before her own message did.

hindi: सौ काम अधूरे — हर तरफ बँट कर कुछ न कर पाना
definition: accepting excessive commitments simultaneously, performing every difficult task poorly through constantly overwhelmed hurrying
example: Between tuitions, temple duty and her brother's shop, she had spread herself too thin and slept through Sunday.

hindi: चौकोर आँखें — बहुत देर स्क्रीन देखने का ताना
definition: tired eyes blamed on watching screens endlessly, British teasing about staying indoors scrolling
example: Mum warned them about square eyes, then joined the film herself and stayed awake through both sequels.

term: square peg in a round hole
hindi: बेमेल जगह — जहाँ आदमी फिट न बैठे
definition: person badly fitted where placed, unable belonging comfortably within surroundings that suit everybody else
example: He was a square peg in a round hole among the accountants, and blossomed the week he moved downstairs to the workshop.

hindi: पीठ में छुरा — भरोसेमंद दोस्त का विश्वासघात
definition: secretly betraying trusted friends, harming someone loyal behind their unsuspecting, undefended back
example: Reading the forwarded messages, he understood that the compliment at dinner had only been decoration on a stab in the back.

hindi: पत्ते पहले से जमा लेना — छिपकर अपने पक्ष में इंतज़ाम
definition: arrange conditions secretly beforehand, unfair advantage bending rules against unsuspecting rivals
example: The quiz master had stacked the deck with questions about his favourite poet, which nobody discovered until round three.

hindi: बेईमानी भरी बाज़ी — पासा पहले से पलटा हुआ
definition: situation arranged unfairly beforehand, giving certain people advantages others cannot possibly overcome
example: Every applicant guessed the interview involved a stacked deck when the manager greeted the third candidate by his childhood nickname.

term: stand on your own two feet
hindi: अपने पैरों पर खड़ा होना — बिना सहारे खुद को संभालना
definition: support yourself independently, without money, help, or guidance from other people
example: After two years of tuition classes and cheap rent, he was finally standing on his own two feet and sending a little money back home.

hindi: अपनी जगह पर अड़े रहना — दबाव में पीछे न हटना
definition: refuse to retreat from your position despite considerable pressure from people opposing
example: The landlord raised his voice twice, but Priya stood her ground and read the tenancy clause aloud, slowly.

hindi: अपनी हद में रहो — जो आता है वही करो
definition: restrict yourself toward personal affairs and proven skills, without interfering elsewhere
example: The cousin who repairs scooters began advising surgeons at dinner, until somebody gently told him to stay in his lane.

hindi: राह पर अडिग रहना — तय रास्ते से न भटकना
definition: continue with the original plan despite difficult conditions, refusing to quit before finishing
example: Everyone told the bakery to switch to cheaper flour, but the family stayed the course, and the queue outside kept growing.

hindi: चट्टान की तरह अडिग — भरोसेमंद और स्थिर
definition: completely reliable and calm, staying untroubled while difficult pressure keeps building
example: Everybody else fussed about the hospital paperwork, while her brother stayed steady as a rock and simply queued.

hindi: जैसा चल रहा है वैसा ही चलने दो — कोई बदलाव नहीं
definition: keeping present course calmly, changing nothing while everything continues working steadily
example: The shop was finally paying its rent, so his father said steady as she goes, and refused every offer of expansion.

hindi: पतवार थामे हाथ — डगमगाती नाव में स्थिर दिशा
definition: calm dependable guidance keeping everything steady, reliable direction through confusing frightening conditions
example: During the flood the headmaster was a steady hand on the tiller, sorting blankets and children with the same unhurried voice.

hindi: छा जाना — दूसरों की चमक अपने नाम कर लेना
definition: attract complete attention, overshadowing performers whom audiences originally arrived hoping would impress them
example: The bride's small nephew stole the show, dancing alone through the entire second song while photographers abandoned everybody else.

hindi: श्रेय झटक लेना — दूसरे की तालियाँ लूट लेना
definition: claim attention or credit somebody else earned, spoiling their planned announcement
example: Her cousin stole her thunder by announcing the engagement first, then apologised with an enormous chocolate cake.

hindi: बीच का रास्ता निकालना — दोनों पक्षों से बराबर दूरी
definition: moving carefully between opposing sides, refusing either quarrel while keeping friendship with both
example: The eldest brother steered a middle course through the property argument, agreeing with nobody loudly and losing nobody's respect.

hindi: लक्ष्मण रेखा लाँघना — तय हदों से बाहर निकलना
definition: behave against accepted rules, openly defying those holding authority
example: One cadet stepped out of line to help a fallen classmate, and the instructor pretended not to notice.

hindi: आगे बढ़कर ज़िम्मेदारी लेना — मोर्चा सँभालना
definition: an American baseball phrase meaning accepting difficult responsibility willingly when everybody around hesitates nervously
example: When the caretaker fell ill, three neighbours stepped up to the plate before anybody thought about asking.

hindi: डटे रहना — मुश्किल के बीच अंत तक टिके रहना
definition: continue with a difficult effort until the finish instead of quitting early
example: The first winter in the mountain village was brutal, but Amina stuck it out, and by spring the neighbours were bringing her bread.

term: stick out like a sore thumb
hindi: भीड़ में अलग दिखना — बेमेल नज़र आना
definition: glaringly obvious and instantly noticeable among surroundings, because nothing else looks similar
example: His bright orange kurta stuck out like a sore thumb among the grey suits, which was exactly why his cousins loved it.

hindi: अपनी बात पर अड़े रहना — दबाव में भी अपना पक्ष न छोड़ना
definition: refuse to abandon your position under pressure, continuing to hold it despite difficulty
example: Everyone told him to soften the ending, but he stuck to his guns and the book was better for it.

hindi: ऊपरी पट्टी वाला इलाज — जड़ छोड़कर सतही मरम्मत
definition: temporary repair hiding serious underlying problems, British phrasing for shallow patching
example: Another sticking plaster solution, muttered the caretaker, tightening the same rusted hinge he had tightened every winter.

hindi: हाथ की सफ़ाई — चीज़ें चुरा लेने की आदत
definition: habitual tendency toward stealing small items quietly whenever nobody watches carefully enough
example: Everyone knew which nephew had sticky fingers, so the marbles moved onto the highest shelf before every family gathering.

hindi: मुश्किल पिच — संभलकर खेलने वाली हालत
definition: awkward difficult position demanding careful defensive handling, British cricket phrasing
example: Explaining the broken window landed him upon a sticky wicket, though his honesty softened his father surprisingly quickly.

hindi: पत्थर-सा धैर्य — दुख छिपाकर शांत बने रहना
definition: composure hiding suffering, which lets somebody endure painful hardship quietly without complaint before others
example: Grandmother kept a stiff upper lip through the whole hospital week, then cried quietly once everybody had gone home.

hindi: मूरत बन जाना — जड़ होकर खड़ा रहना
definition: motionless and soundless, holding every quiet muscle frozen while something frightening passes
example: The little boy stood still as a statue while the monkey inspected his packet of biscuits and generously left half.

hindi: आग में घी डालना — शांत माहौल में जान-बूझकर झगड़ा खड़ा करना
definition: deliberately provoke fresh quarrel among calm people, inflaming conflict nobody actually wanted revived
example: Every family lunch was peaceful until Mihir stirred the pot by asking who had really broken the old radio.

hindi: मधुमक्खी का छत्ता छेड़ना — बेवजह सामूहिक गुस्सा भड़काना
definition: provoke furious collective trouble, disturbing angry people whose reaction spreads beyond control
example: His innocent question about parking stirred up a hornets' nest, and the building meeting continued long after the samosas finished.

hindi: समय पर एक टाँका — छोटा उपाय बड़ा नुकसान बचाए
definition: small timely repair preventing enormous later damage, early attention saving greater expense
example: Tightening the loose hinge was a stitch in time, sparing them the gate collapse their neighbours suffered.

hindi: देखते ही थम जाना — इतना असरदार कि क़दम रुक जाएँ
definition: impress onlookers strongly enough that walking, talking, breathing briefly pause entirely
example: She descended the staircase quietly, stopping every uncle in their tracks halfway through arguments about property papers.

hindi: पहले खून रोको — सबसे पहले नुकसान थामना
definition: halt immediate worsening damage urgently before attempting slower complete repair afterwards
example: First they stopped the bleeding by cancelling the outing, then sat down calmly to rebuild the month's budget.

hindi: चाय की प्याली में तूफ़ान — छोटी बात का बड़ा हंगामा
definition: enormous noisy fuss about some genuinely trivial matter, British phrasing
example: The argument about parking turned into a storm in a teacup, settled eventually by two cups of tea.

hindi: तूफ़ान उठने को है — गुस्सा भीतर ही भीतर पक रहा है
definition: anger gathering quietly among people, promising serious trouble once patience finally breaks
example: Nobody mentioned the missing scooter keys, but from the clatter in the kitchen a storm was brewing.

hindi: हाथ तंग होना — फ़िलहाल पैसे की किल्लत
definition: short of money temporarily, unable to afford anything beyond urgent expenses
example: Strapped for cash before results week, the hostel boys shared one plate of noodles between four.

hindi: दिल के तार छेड़ देना — सीधे भीतर उतर जाना
definition: touching listeners' feelings deeply, resonating with private experience nearly everybody quietly recognises
example: The song about leaving home struck a chord, and half the hostel stopped talking to listen.

hindi: सोने की खान मिलना — खोजते हुए अप्रत्याशित रूप से बहुत क़ीमती चीज़ पा जाना
definition: finding unexpected fortune while searching patiently for something smaller and plainer
example: He went to the flea market wanting a kettle and struck gold with a signed first edition under the tablecloth.

hindi: किस्मत चमक जाना — अचानक बड़ा फायदा मिल जाना
definition: suddenly gaining fortunate outcome through chance rather than careful planning, chiefly British
example: They struck it lucky with the second-hand harmonium, which only needed dusting before filling the house with sound.

term: strike while the iron is hot
hindi: लोहा गरम है, हथौड़ा मार दो — सही मौका आते ही वार कर देना
definition: take decisive action during the brief favourable moment, before conditions cool again and the chance disappears
example: The landlord seemed unusually cheerful about the leaking roof, so Meera struck while the iron was hot and asked about the broken heater too.

hindi: लटकाए रखना — साफ़ जवाब कभी न देना
definition: sustain false romantic hope indefinitely, promising commitment nobody actually intends delivering
example: He strung her along until her friends staged an intervention with samosas and a very direct list of questions.

hindi: किस्मत का साथ — अचानक मिली खुशकिस्मती
definition: sudden fortunate happening arriving unexpectedly, improving your situation without deliberate effort
example: Finding the misplaced ticket inside an old library book felt like a stroke of luck worth celebrating with jalebi.

hindi: बैल जैसा ताक़तवर — अथक बल
definition: physically powerful and tough, lifting heavy burdens other people cannot manage
example: Her uncle is strong as an ox and carried the water tank upstairs alone while everyone else argued about pulleys.

hindi: ढर्रे में फँसना — एक ही घिसी राह पर
definition: trapped repeating the same dull routine, unable to move life toward anything fresher
example: Feeling stuck in a rut, he began cycling home along the river, which slowly gave his evenings back.

hindi: अकड़ू रौबदार आदमी — दिखावटी गंभीरता
definition: pompous humourless person clinging stiffly toward formality, considering themselves rather important
example: The new secretary seemed a stuffed shirt until somebody played old film songs and he sang every word.

hindi: नाम लिए बिना ताना — इशारों में तंज़
definition: posting pointed criticism about somebody without naming them, trusting readers recognise target
example: Her cheerful little post about certain flatmates carried enough subtweet energy that everybody quietly checked the kitchen.

hindi: बात घुमाकर कहना — कड़वी सच्चाई मीठे शब्दों में लपेटना
definition: present unpleasant truth pleasantly, softening painful details until nobody feels badly wounded
example: The doctor sugar-coated the truth about recovery time, then quietly explained everything properly to her elder brother outside.

hindi: सबसे अच्छी पोशाक — खास मौके वाला लिबास
definition: finest clothes kept aside, wearing them respectfully for worship, weddings, visitors, other formal gatherings
example: The children were scrubbed into their Sunday best, then warned sternly against going anywhere near the mango tree.

hindi: विदाई गीत — आख़िरी पेशकश
definition: final performance before retirement, last graceful appearance somebody makes before leaving altogether
example: His swan song was a quiet raga at dawn, played for the students who had followed him longest.

hindi: खून-पसीना एक करना — जान लगाकर मेहनत करना
definition: giving exhausting effort across long anxious hours, working yourself close toward collapse
example: He sweated blood over that little bakery, and the smell of fresh bread every morning was his answer.

hindi: सारे इनाम समेट लेना — हर मुक़ाबला जीत जाना
definition: capture every available prize, spectacular success leaving rivals defeated across separate contests
example: Their school swept the board at the district meet, and the principal ran short of shelf space before evening assembly.

hindi: बात दबा देना — गड़बड़ी छिपाकर मामला चुपचाप रफ़ा-दफ़ा करना
definition: quietly hide an awkward truth rather than facing something openly and directly
example: The family swept the whole quarrel under the rug and passed the rice around again.

hindi: पहले अपना घर देखो — दूसरों पर उँगली बाद में
definition: correcting your personal faults first before criticising other people's business, behaviour, choices
example: He was about to complain about his brother's spending when his wife suggested he sweep his own doorstep first.

hindi: एकदम बढ़िया — कोई शिकायत नहीं
definition: perfectly fine in New Zealand usage, agreeable, settled without complaint or further trouble
example: She asked whether swapping shifts caused problems, and her flatmate just grinned and said sweet as, handing over coffee.

hindi: मीठी-मीठी बातें — प्रेमियों की बेमतलब पर प्यारी फुसफुसाहट
definition: murmured flirtatious compliments between lovers, carrying romantic affection rather than actual meaning
example: The old couple still traded sweet nothings while queueing patiently at the ration shop.

hindi: पैरों तले ज़मीन खिसकना — आकर्षण में पूरी तरह बह जाना
definition: suddenly and completely enamoured, overwhelmed by romantic attention beyond ordinary resistance
example: Two letters and one rainy walk later, my sensible aunt was thoroughly swept off her feet.

hindi: धारा के विरुद्ध तैरना — प्रचलित राय के ख़िलाफ़ डटे रहना
definition: persisting through effort against constant resistance from prevailing opinion, which keeps progress difficult and lonely
example: He kept planting native saplings while everybody else wanted lawn, swimming against the tide of the entire colony.

hindi: जी चुराना — बहाने बनाकर काम से बचना
definition: avoiding honest work through invented excuses, leaving shared effort resting upon other people
example: His cough vanished the moment cricket started, and everyone knew he had been swinging the lead.

hindi: कहीं फायदा कहीं नुकसान — हिसाब बराबर हो जाता है
definition: accepting outcomes balance eventually, British phrasing where losses offset earlier gains
example: Rain spoiled the picnic but filled the well, swings and roundabouts, said uncle folding the wet blanket.

hindi: तेज़ दिमाग़ वाला — बात तुरंत पकड़ लेने वाला
definition: mentally alert competent quick-thinking (British), noticing important details other people carelessly overlook
example: The switched on intern rearranged the whole seating chart when she realised both grandmothers refused to sit together.

hindi: पीछे हट जाना — कमान दूसरों को देना
definition: withdraw into lesser position deliberately, letting others handle greater responsibility
example: After forty years behind the counter, her grandfather took a back seat and spent mornings teaching the delivery boys arithmetic.

hindi: हाथ जल जाना — सौदे में भारी नुक़सान उठाना
definition: someone suffers heavy money losses when a business investment collapses beneath them
example: She took a bath on the seaside flat, then joked that saltwater had swallowed everything except the view.

hindi: झुककर सलामी लेना — श्रेय स्वीकार करना
definition: accept deserved audience applause openly, acknowledging praise after finishing successful performance
example: Somebody baked those hundred samosas, mother, so please come here and take a bow.

hindi: गोली अपने सीने पर लेना — दूसरे की सज़ा ख़ुद भुगतना
definition: accept painful punishment or blame willingly, protecting somebody else from consequences properly belonging elsewhere
example: She took a bullet for the broken vase, and her little brother spent the evening pretending nothing had happened.

hindi: चुटकी लेना — बात-बात में ताना मारना
definition: criticise somebody with a quick pointed remark, mocking them briefly inside ordinary conversation
example: Between mouthfuls he took a dig at his brother's driving, and their mother pretended nothing had happened.

hindi: दाँव लगा देना — जोखिम उठाना
definition: an American phrase meaning risking money, effort, reputation upon uncertain venture despite having thin information
example: He took a flyer on the shuttered bakery, and neighbours queued for bread within the first month.

hindi: फिर कभी सही — अभी नहीं, बाद में
definition: politely postpone invitation, promising acceptance some later occasion instead
example: He took a rain check on dinner, though he stood chatting at the gate until the rice went cold.

hindi: गलत मोड़ लेना — गलत राह पकड़ लेना
definition: choose a mistaken direction, drifting steadily toward outcomes nobody actually wanted (British: turning)
example: She admits taking a wrong turning after college, though those wandering years taught her patience nothing else would have.

hindi: जो दिखे वही मानना — बिना परखे भरोसा
definition: accepting outward surface appearance without questioning whatever reality might hide beneath somebody's account
example: She took his apology at face value, poured the tea, and never mentioned the broken window again.

hindi: लानतें झेलना — दूसरों की गलती पर डाँट खाना
definition: receive heavy criticism from every direction, absorbing angry complaints about somebody else's unpopular decision
example: The delivery boy took flak for the cold parathas although the kitchen had sent him out forty minutes late.

hindi: उल्लू बनाना — दोस्ती के बहाने ठग लेना
definition: cheating trusting person steadily while pretending honest friendship, quietly taking their money
example: The travel agent phoned twice weekly, remembered his daughter's birthday, and took the whole family for a ride.

hindi: हिम्मत बाँधना — ढाढ़स मिलना
definition: gaining fresh courage during difficulty, feeling encouraged despite earlier disappointment
example: Take heart, said the coach quietly, remembering the same defeat that once taught him everything worth knowing.

hindi: सीना तानकर सहना — आलोचना या चोट हिम्मत से झेलना
definition: endure painful criticism or misfortune bravely without complaining about the unfairness afterwards
example: The judges tore his sculpture apart in front of everyone, and he took it on the chin, then sanded it down again.

hindi: मामला अपने हाथ में लेना — खुद कमान संभालना
definition: taking control personally, arranging difficult matters yourself instead of waiting helplessly
example: When nobody repaired the streetlight, Meena took matters in hand with a ladder and a borrowed bulb.

hindi: जो मिले सो सही — किस्मत पर छोड़कर चुनना
definition: accepting whatever chance happens offering without choosing, trusting random outcome cheerfully
example: With every stall closed, they took pot luck at the roadside dhaba and found unexpectedly excellent rajma.

term: take the bull by the horns
hindi: आगे बढ़कर मोर्चा सँभालना — मुश्किल का सीधा सामना करना
definition: confront difficulty decisively instead of hesitating, choosing firm action over anxious delay
example: Rather than wait another monsoon, Farida took the bull by the horns and knocked on the landlord's door herself.

hindi: दूसरे की सज़ा भुगतना — इलज़ाम अपने ऊपर लेना
definition: accept punishment publicly for something, often shielding whoever actually deserves blame
example: The assistant manager took the fall for the missing stock, and everybody understood exactly whose idea it had been.

hindi: बड़प्पन दिखाना — ओछी बात का जवाब शराफ़त से देना
definition: answer an insult with dignity rather than retaliate, refusing the provocation and keeping your patience
example: Instead of replying to the rumours, she took the high road and let her work speak all season.

hindi: इशारा समझ जाना — बिना कहे बात पकड़ लेना
definition: understand indirect unspoken suggestion, recognising meaning somebody deliberately avoided saying openly
example: When his aunt began stacking the plates loudly, the guests finally took the hint and reached politely for their sandals.

hindi: मुँह फुला लेना — नाराज़ होकर चुप्पी साध लेना
definition: become sulkily offended in Scottish and Irish usage, refusing further conversation afterwards
example: She took the huff when nobody praised her singing, and stirred her tea loudly until somebody finally asked for another song.

hindi: मज़ाक उड़ाना — हँसी में नक़ल उतारना
definition: tease somebody through imitation, British usage, copying their manner while everybody around watches laughing
example: The apprentices took the mickey out of his enormous new boots, and he wore them proudly anyway.

hindi: टांग खींचना — मज़ाक में किसी की नकल उतारना
definition: mocking somebody in British slang, teasing them relentlessly about something they cannot change
example: The lads took the piss about his lucky socks every Saturday, then wore matching pairs for the final.

hindi: दूसरे की गलती का इल्ज़ाम अपने सिर लेना
definition: accept blame plus punishment that properly belongs somewhere else entirely, shielding actual wrongdoers
example: The elder brother took the rap about the dented scooter, hoping nobody would notice his sister's helmet lying beside it.

hindi: घुमावदार रास्ता लेना — लंबा मगर सुंदर रास्ता
definition: travel a longer pleasant path, arriving late having enjoyed quieter roads
example: Grandfather always took the scenic route home, stopping wherever guavas were selling and arriving cheerfully late.

hindi: छा जाना — हर तरफ़ मशहूर हो जाना
definition: achieve sudden enormous fame everywhere, winning admiration from huge crowds almost overnight
example: Their little garage band took the world by storm before either brother finished college.

hindi: दुम दबाकर भागना — तेज़ी से भाग निकलना
definition: flee running, leaving danger behind quickly instead of standing firm
example: The monkey took one look at the broom and took to its heels across the terrace, still clutching half a guava.

term: take with a grain of salt
hindi: पूरा भरोसा नहीं करना — सुनी बात आधी मानना
definition: accept doubtful information cautiously, believing only partly until better evidence arrives
example: Take his fishing stories with a grain of salt, though nobody minds because he tells them beautifully every summer.

hindi: क़िस्मत आज़माना — जो होगा देखा जाएगा, जोखिम उठा लेना
definition: accept whatever outcome random chance delivers, proceeding without guarantees, control, or protection against failure
example: There were no tickets left, so they took their chances at the station and slept beside their bags.

hindi: कड़वा घूँट पीना — सज़ा चुपचाप स्वीकारना
definition: accept deserved punishment without complaining, enduring unpleasant consequences earned through earlier careless actions
example: She took her medicine quietly when the coach dropped her from the opening match, then turned up early every morning afterwards.

hindi: बक-बक करना — बिना रुके धाराप्रवाह बोलते जाना
definition: talking rapidly without pause, pouring endless words over every trapped listener
example: The moment her flight landed, Priya talked a blue streak the whole drive home, and her father just smiled at the road.

hindi: हवा में बात करना — बिना जाने बोलते रहना
definition: speaking confidently about poorly understood subjects, filling empty talk without real substance
example: Uncle was talking through his hat about monsoon patterns until the farmer beside him laughed gently.

hindi: खरी-खरी बात करना — साफ़ और गंभीर बातचीत
definition: discuss serious matters plainly, dropping evasive politeness before settling practical terms, chiefly American
example: The carpenter sat down, pulled out his measuring tape, and said quietly that they should talk turkey about wood.

hindi: मसालेदार ख़बर — ताज़ा गपशप
definition: freshly arrived gossip about somebody, exciting enough that listeners abandon whatever else they were discussing
example: She sat down, phone face-down, and announced the tea was piping hot before anybody had ordered dessert.

hindi: मास्टर जी का चहेता — शिक्षक का प्रिय छात्र
definition: pupil favoured openly by teachers, resented quietly throughout classroom among other students
example: Being called teacher's pet stung until the others realised she quietly shared every borrowed textbook.

hindi: धज्जियाँ उड़ाना — तर्क को चीथड़े कर देना
definition: attack someone else's argument with harsh criticism, leaving their reasoning publicly demolished
example: She tore his proposal to shreds in eleven polite minutes, then offered him tea and a better plan.

hindi: घर की बात बाहर कहना — भेद खोल देना
definition: repeat private gossip learned inside a trusted circle, embarrassing people outside
example: Grandmother warned us against telling tales out of school, then leaned closer with news about the neighbours.

hindi: शामत को बुलाना — बिना ज़रूरत खतरा मोल लेना
definition: behave boldly when the situation already looks dangerous, inviting serious trouble needlessly
example: She had almost reached the shore when she turned back for the paddle, tempting fate in that grey water.

hindi: दो कौड़ी का — मुफ़्त जैसा आम
definition: plentiful and cheap (British), found everywhere so easily that nobody treasures them
example: Opinions about the match were ten a penny outside the tea stall, though nobody there had watched beyond lunch.

hindi: सौ में निन्यानवे — पूरी संभावना
definition: very likely indeed, strongly probable judging from repeated earlier experience
example: Ten to one the power returns before dinner, said Nani, already lighting candles along the windowsill anyway.

hindi: अपनी क्यारी सँवारो — दूसरों के मामलों से दूर
definition: giving attention only to personal business, choices, faults, ignoring other people's affairs
example: After the reunion gossip exhausted her, she tended her own garden for a year and finished the book nobody expected.

hindi: दिन-रात इंटरनेट में घुसा हुआ — असली दुनिया से कटा
definition: spending countless hours online until internet quarrels matter more than actual surrounding life
example: Her cousin was so terminally online that he explained a stranger's argument twice before noticing dinner had gone cold.

hindi: पानी की थाह लेना — पहले माहौल भाँपना
definition: check a situation cautiously before committing, learning beforehand how people actually respond
example: He tested the waters with one poem at the open evening before showing anyone the whole notebook.

hindi: मोटी अक्ल का — जल्दी कुछ समझ न पाने वाला
definition: describes a foolish person lacking intelligence, unable to grasp ordinary simple ideas
example: Thick as a brick about phones, my uncle still calls the tablet a television and waits for advertisements.

hindi: गहरे यार — एक-दूसरे के बेहद करीब दोस्त
definition: extremely close friends spending time constantly together, sharing private secrets nobody else hears
example: The two grandmothers met at the temple every morning and walked home whispering, thick as thieves after forty years.

hindi: भरमार होना — जितने चाहो उतने मौजूद
definition: plentiful and easily found, British phrasing for something present everywhere around
example: Mango sellers were thick on the ground that summer, calling prices across the lane until dusk finally settled.

hindi: तीसरी बार बात बनी — दो नाकामी के बाद सफलता
definition: hoping success finally arrives after earlier attempts failed twice, chiefly British
example: Third time lucky, the scooter started, and both brothers cheered loudly enough to wake the sleeping street.

hindi: तीसरा पहिया — बेवजह साथ लगा इंसान
definition: awkward extra person accompanying romantic couple, feeling unwanted throughout their whole evening
example: He spent the entire film as third wheel, holding both popcorn buckets while they whispered.

hindi: गद्दारी की कीमत — पैसों के लिए अपने का विश्वासघात
definition: payment accepted while betraying trusting friend, choosing money above every loyalty
example: He sold the recipe to the new cafe for thirty pieces of silver, and never enjoyed the dish again.

hindi: छक कर पीये हुए — पूरी तरह नशे में
definition: thoroughly drunk, swaying unsteadily after drinking rather more alcohol than sensible
example: Uncle arrived three sheets to the wind, sang two film songs beautifully, and slept through the entire speech afterwards.

hindi: सुख-दुख में साथ — हर हाल में साथ निभाना
definition: staying loyally beside someone through every serious difficulty, never abandoning friends when trouble arrives
example: They had shared one umbrella, two exams and three bad landlords, so nobody was surprised the friendship had lasted through thick and thin.

hindi: जश्न मचा देना — शोर भरी दावत रखना
definition: hold a boisterous celebration in Irish usage, music continuing loudly until morning arrives
example: They threw a hooley when the youngest passed her exams, and neighbours arrived carrying chairs because the house had none spare.

term: throw a wrench in the works
hindi: पहिये में डंडा डालना — जमी योजना जान बूझकर बिगाड़ना
definition: deliberately obstruct carefully arranged plans, introducing sudden trouble that stops steady progress
example: Her cousin threw a wrench in the surprise party by mentioning the cake, and everyone pretended nobody had heard.

hindi: एहतियात छोड़ देना — जोखिम उठाकर आगे बढ़ना
definition: accepting obvious risk deliberately, abandoning careful behaviour whatever outcome eventually follows
example: He threw caution to the wind, ordered the largest kulfi, and worried about his cough some other evening.

hindi: उत्साह पर ठंडा पानी डाल देना — जोश ठंडा कर देना
definition: dampen enthusiasm about somebody's plan, listing problems until excitement quietly disappears
example: His brother threw cold water on the bakery idea, then surprised everyone by lending money the following month.

hindi: ललकारना — खुली चुनौती फेंक देना
definition: deliberately challenge another person into open conflict, inviting a public quarrel nobody expected
example: The quiet cousin threw down the gauntlet at the wedding, announcing she would out-dance every uncle present.

hindi: हार मान लेना — लड़ाई बीच में छोड़कर पराजय स्वीकार कर लेना
definition: to abandon a struggle already lost, conceding defeat rather than absorbing further punishment
example: After the fourth rejected draft he threw in the towel and went for a long walk instead.

hindi: पत्ते फेंक देना — मुक़ाबला छोड़ देना
definition: abandon your attempt entirely, accepting defeat rather than risking further painful losses ahead
example: After four soggy attempts at the sponge cake she threw in her hand, and everybody happily ate warm halwa instead.

hindi: तंज़ कसना — घुमा-फिराकर नीचा दिखाना
definition: criticise somebody subtly through indirect remarks, mocking them without stating disapproval openly
example: She threw shade at the wedding decorations by praising how brave the colour choices were.

hindi: साथी की बलि चढ़ाना — अपने बचाव में दोस्त कुर्बान
definition: sacrifice a colleague publicly, letting them absorb blame protecting yourself
example: He threw his oldest friend under the bus during the meeting, and never quite recovered the friendship afterwards.

hindi: पूरी सख़्ती से पेश आना — हर धारा लगा देना
definition: punish somebody with maximum severity available, charging every possible offence without leniency
example: The magistrate threw the book at those quarry owners, and villagers downstream finally slept without tasting grit.

term: throw your hat in the ring
hindi: मैदान में उतरना — दावेदारी पेश करना
definition: announce candidacy publicly, entering contest openly instead of watching others compete
example: She threw her hat in the ring for the housing society election, mostly because nobody else would fix the lift.

term: thrown in at the deep end
hindi: बिना तैराकी सीखे नदी में — तैयारी बिना कठिन काम
definition: forced starting difficult unfamiliar tasks without preparation, becoming overwhelmed almost immediately afterwards
example: Thrown in at the deep end on her second morning, she taught forty children while the regular teacher recovered.

hindi: फूला न समाना — ख़ुशी से बाग़-बाग़
definition: hugely delighted, beaming with cheerful happiness over something small that somebody arranged especially thoughtfully
example: She was tickled pink that the children had remembered her favourite cake, badly iced and entirely perfect.

hindi: सात फेरे लेना — विवाह कर लेना
definition: marry your partner formally, promising lifelong commitment before gathered family witnesses
example: They tied the knot under a mango tree, with forty relatives fanning themselves in the heat.

hindi: माँ का आँचल न छोड़ना — घरवालों पर निर्भर रहना
definition: sheltered from hardship by parents, protected and unable to decide anything alone
example: He phoned home before choosing a jacket, and his flatmates teased gently that he was still tied to the apron strings.

hindi: नशे में लबालब — झूमता हुआ
definition: heavily intoxicated after excessive drinking, swaying while insisting nothing seems wrong
example: By midnight the birthday guest was tight as a tick and explaining cricket strategy to a very patient waiter.

hindi: मुँह सिले रहना — पूछने पर भी कुछ न बताना
definition: unwilling to discuss secret matters, staying silent about hidden details while other people press hard
example: The doctor stayed tight-lipped in the corridor, saying only that the family should sit down first.

hindi: पेट पर पत्थर बांधना — खर्च घटाकर कम में गुज़ारा करना
definition: reduce household spending deliberately after money becomes scarce, accepting smaller comforts
example: After the shop closed the whole family tightened their belts, and nobody once said the word aloud.

hindi: बहुत लंबे, अंतहीन समय तक चलते रहना
definition: waiting endlessly, continuing much longer than anyone could reasonably expect
example: You can argue with my uncle about cricket till the cows come home, and he will still be pouring tea and disagreeing at midnight.

hindi: हवा से लड़ना — काल्पनिक दुश्मनों से भिड़ना
definition: pointless effort pursuing imaginary enemies, fighting troubles that never actually existed
example: Every summer my neighbour tilts at windmills, writing letters about a road widening nobody has ever proposed.

hindi: वक़्त पंख लगाकर उड़ता है — समय तेज़ी से बीतना
definition: hours passing astonishingly quickly, whole years vanishing while nobody notices anything
example: Time flies, she said, folding the school uniform nobody would wear again, before quietly keeping the smallest shirt aside.

hindi: हिमशैल का सिरा — असली मुसीबत छिपी है
definition: small visible surface portion whose modest appearance hides enormous trouble underneath
example: The damp patch above the stove was only the tip of the iceberg, as the plumber explained gently.

hindi: ज़ुबान पर आकर अटक जाना — याद फिसल जाना
definition: state where a familiar word stays almost remembered, escaping recall despite feeling maddeningly close
example: The actor's name sat on the tip of her tongue through three courses before her nephew mercifully supplied it.

hindi: इरादा ज़ाहिर कर देना — चाल समय से पहले दिखा देना
definition: reveal hidden intentions early, showing secret plans that careful players would rather keep quietly concealed
example: She meant to negotiate slowly, but her face lit up at the first offer and tipped her hand before the tea arrived.

hindi: राजसी ठाठ में पला — जन्म से ही ऐश्वर्य का अभ्यस्त
definition: accustomed since birth to inherited privilege, wealth, and effortless social ease
example: She poured tea for thirty guests without checking a single name, entirely to the manor born, while her husband hid in the pantry.

hindi: जीभ लड़खड़ाना — घबराहट में बोल न पाना
definition: unable to speak smoothly, silent because nerves knot every sentence before words arrive
example: He rehearsed the proposal for months, then went tongue-tied under the fairy lights.

hindi: पर निकल आना — अपनी हैसियत भूल जाना
definition: behaving with loud self-importance, pretending greater authority than your actual standing could justify
example: One promotion and the boy grew too big for his boots, correcting his uncle about cricket at the dinner table.

hindi: नतीजा कहना मुश्किल — बेहद कड़ा मुक़ाबला
definition: contest matched evenly, preventing anybody sensible from predicting eventual winner
example: The bake-off proved too close to call, so the judges split the ribbon and everyone ended sharing both cakes.

hindi: सपने जैसा सच — भरोसा करने लायक नहीं लगता
definition: seeming impossibly perfect, warning that somebody's charm probably hides unpleasant reality underneath
example: Handsome, punctual, fond of poetry and dogs, he seemed too good to be true, and her cousin started asking gentle questions.

hindi: अब पछताए होत क्या — देर से मिली नाकाफ़ी मदद
definition: effort or help arriving after the chance already passed, offering considerably less than circumstances actually needed
example: The extra tuition began in March, which everyone privately agreed was too little too late for the exams.

term: too many irons in the fire
hindi: एक साथ कई चूल्हे — बहुत काम एक बार में
definition: excessive commitments juggled simultaneously, risking difficult failures because scattered attention manages nothing properly
example: Grandfather counted the projects aloud and declared, with some pride, that his grandson kept too many irons in the fire.

hindi: सिर पर बोझ — क्षमता से ज़्यादा ज़िम्मेदारी उठाना
definition: carrying more responsibilities than capacity allows, accepting beyond reasonable workable personal limits
example: With exams, the shop and his grandmother's medicines, Vikram had too much on his plate, so his sister quietly took the shop.

hindi: बड़े अफ़सर लोग — जिनके फ़ैसले सब मानते हैं
definition: the most senior people holding authority, whose decisions everybody below simply follows without argument
example: The workshop floor cleaned itself twice over the morning the top brass announced an unexpected afternoon visit.

hindi: सिरमौर — सबसे ऊपर बैठा हुआ व्यक्ति
definition: the person ranked highest inside a group, better than everyone else around them
example: Two seasons after joining the club, the shy newcomer had quietly become top dog.

hindi: मुँहमाँगी कीमत — बिना मोलभाव पूरा दाम देना
definition: the highest amount of money buyers accept, an expensive price handed over without haggling
example: Collectors pay top dollar for his father's old cameras, though the shop once sold them cheaply.

hindi: सबसे ऊपर नाम — मुख्य आकर्षण
definition: given highest performance billing, drawing audience attention above every other performer appearing that evening
example: Twenty years after playing tiny village fairs, she found her name printed top of the bill in gold.

hindi: कक्षा में प्रथम आना — सबसे आगे रहना
definition: finishing highest among fellow students, achieving better examination results than everyone around
example: Standing top of the class embarrassed him, so he hid the certificate beneath his notebooks until evening.

hindi: डांवाडोल — नतीजा किसी भी पल पलट सकने वाली हालत
definition: uncertain moment where serious danger might overwhelm everything, narrow escape never fully assured
example: It was touch and go through the night, and at dawn the doctor came out smiling and everyone in the corridor stood up.

hindi: घास छूकर आना — असली दुनिया में लौटना
definition: leave heated online arguments briefly, returning toward ordinary physical reality outside screens
example: His sister took away the phone, handed him a watering can, and told him kindly to touch grass.

hindi: लकड़ी छूना — नज़र न लगे इसलिए टोक देना
definition: hoping present luck continues, British superstition warding away misfortune while speaking
example: The harvest looked healthy this year, touch wood, and father refused discussing numbers before threshing finished.

hindi: लोहे जैसा मज़बूत — हर मार सह जाना
definition: physically tough and durable, surviving rough treatment without complaint or damage
example: That little scooter is tough as old boots; it has carried three generations, two goats, and countless wedding sweets.

hindi: कठिन डगर — लंबा, थकाऊ और मेहनत माँगता काम
definition: long difficult task demanding steady effort, where progress arrives slowly against tiring, unrelenting resistance
example: Learning Sanskrit grammar at forty-two was a tough row to hoe, but Vidya kept her notebooks going every morning.

hindi: मज़बूत सहारा — मुश्किल में खड़ा रहने वाला
definition: dependable person offering steady reliable support through trouble, holding everybody together patiently
example: Through the hospital weeks his aunt was a tower of strength, cooking, remembering appointments, never once mentioning her tiredness.

hindi: फूँक-फूँक कर कदम रखना — बेहद सावधानी से आगे बढ़ना
definition: move carefully through a delicate matter, avoiding words or actions that might cause trouble
example: Her grandmother had just sold the old house, so everyone tread lightly at dinner and talked about the weather instead.

hindi: लक्षणों का इलाज — बीमारी की जड़ अछूती
definition: soothe visible discomfort without addressing underlying illness, giving relief while trouble quietly continues
example: Painkillers only treated the symptoms, so the doctor finally ordered scans nobody in the family wanted discussed.

hindi: चादर देख कर पैर पसारना — हालात के हिसाब से खर्च घटाना
definition: adjust your plans modestly, spending less while changed circumstances demand careful living
example: They trimmed their sails after the transfer, cooking together every evening and finding the smaller flat surprisingly cheerful.

hindi: मीठा ज़हर — तोहफ़े में छिपा खतरा
definition: harmless-looking offering hiding hostile intentions, welcomed inside before the hidden damage begins
example: The free television felt like a Trojan horse once the salesman came back about the monthly subscription.

hindi: खरा और वफ़ादार — मुश्किल में भी वफ़ा निभाने वाला
definition: unwaveringly loyal, honest, reliable, keeping promises even when loyalty becomes costly, inconvenient
example: Half the crowd changed sides after the scandal, but the old drummer stayed true blue and turned up for practice anyway.

hindi: शोर को अनसुना करना — बेमतलब बातों पर ध्यान नहीं
definition: deliberately ignoring gossip, drama, opinions, criticism that would otherwise drain your calm
example: Before his exams he tuned out the noise completely, leaving the group chats unread and the rumours entirely undiscussed.

hindi: आँख चुराना — जान-बूझकर अनदेखा करना
definition: deliberately ignoring wrongdoing while watching, pretending serious trouble never happened
example: The watchman turned a blind eye when children climbed the wall for mangoes, then scolded them loudly afterwards.

hindi: नज़रें खींचना — अपनी छवि से सबका ध्यान आकर्षित करना
definition: attract admiring, sometimes flirtatious romantic attention because someone looks strikingly impressive
example: She wore her grandmother's green sari to the concert and turned heads the entire evening.

hindi: पासा पलटना — हालात का रुख बदल जाना
definition: moment when circumstances reverse completely, changing which side seems likely winning
example: The turn of the tide came with one honest letter, and neighbours who had stopped greeting them began arriving with sweets.

hindi: चिकनी-चुपड़ी बातें करना — रिझाने में जुट जाना
definition: deploying practised warmth deliberately, dazzling somebody until their doubts quietly disappear
example: He turned on the charm with her mother first, complimenting the garden before anybody mentioned engagement.

hindi: नया पन्ना पलटना — सुधरकर नई शुरुआत करना
definition: begin behaving better deliberately, abandoning earlier bruising habits after honest decision
example: He turned over a new leaf in January, and by March the morning walk had become genuinely his favourite hour.

hindi: मोड़ पार करना — हालत बिगड़ना रुककर सुधरने लगना
definition: reaching the point where illness stops worsening and recovering towards better health finally begins
example: His fever broke on the fourth night, and everyone knew he had turned the corner.

hindi: गाल आगे कर देना — अपमान का बदला न लेना
definition: refuse to retaliate against an insult, answering provocation with patience instead of matching the anger
example: The shopkeeper turned the other cheek when the customer shouted, and quietly refilled the man's water bottle.

hindi: पासा पलट देना — हारती बाज़ी जीत में बदलना
definition: reverse a losing situation completely, gaining advantage over somebody previously winning
example: She turned the tables in the final round of carrom, and her brother demanded a rematch that lasted until midnight.

hindi: टें बोल जाना — चुपचाप दुनिया से चले जाना
definition: dying, describing somebody's quiet British death without lasting fuss
example: The old spaniel turned up his toes beside the fire, having outlasted three sofas and everybody's diets.

hindi: हाथ पर हाथ धरे बैठना — खाली बैठकर वक़्त काटना
definition: waiting idly through empty hours, sitting about longer than expected without occupation
example: The whole crew twiddled their thumbs beside a broken generator, inventing card games nobody remembered the rules of afterwards.

hindi: ज़ख्म में चाकू घुमाना — दुख को जान-बूझ कर बढ़ाना
definition: worsening existing suffering deliberately, pressing painful humiliation further instead of offering simple comfort
example: He could have twisted the knife about the forgotten tickets, and instead poured chai and mentioned tomorrow's show.

hindi: एक ही थैली के चट्टे-बट्टे — हूबहू एक जैसे साथी
definition: close friends remarkably similar, constantly together, sharing identical habits, tastes, stubborn opinions
example: Both order the same chai, both hate crowds, both laugh before the joke lands: two peas in a pod.

term: two sides of the same coin
hindi: एक ही सिक्के के दो पहलू — अलग दिखते, जुड़े हुए
definition: aspects belonging together inseparably, seeming opposite while sharing exactly the same source
example: His shyness and his careful listening were two sides of the same coin, something his teacher noticed before anyone else.

hindi: दो मुँहा — सामने कुछ, पीठ पीछे कुछ
definition: secretly betraying trusted friends, praising them warmly while harming their reputation privately
example: The compliments about her cooking sounded warm until she overheard the same guest being wonderfully two-faced beside the sink.

hindi: अनजानी राह — जहाँ पहले कोई गया नहीं
definition: unfamiliar situation nobody around here handled before, offering neither maps nor precedent
example: Teaching sixty children over a patchy video call was uncharted waters, so she invented rules nightly and apologised cheerfully every morning.

hindi: झूठे बहाने से — झूठ बोलकर काम निकालना
definition: tricking trusting victim into handing over valuables through deliberate false claims
example: He borrowed the wedding jewellery under false pretences, promising photographs that were never taken.

hindi: चौतरफ़ा हमले में — हर तरफ़ से आलोचना
definition: facing sustained criticism from many directions while still trying to continue working calmly
example: Under fire from every neighbour, the committee secretary kept watering the shared garden as though nothing troubled him.

hindi: ताले में बंद — कड़ी निगरानी में
definition: shut securely away under guarded confinement, whether prisoners, evidence, jewellery, dangerous documents
example: Amma kept the wedding gold under lock and key, though everybody knew exactly which cupboard hid that squeaking drawer.

hindi: एक ही छत के नीचे — साथ रहते हुए
definition: living together within the same household, sharing rooms, meals and daily expenses
example: Three generations lived under one roof, which meant arguments about the fan speed but also nobody ever ate dinner alone.

hindi: इलाज के अंतर्गत — डॉक्टर की निगरानी में
definition: receiving continuing medical treatment for ongoing illness, British phrasing meaning still supervised
example: He explained he was under the doctor about his knee, which excused him from carrying trunks up three floors.

hindi: चीर-फाड़ के नीचे — ऑपरेशन के दौरान
definition: undergoing surgical operation, lying helpless while doctors repair something dangerous inside
example: While his mother was under the knife, he counted floor tiles outside and answered relatives with the same three sentences.

hindi: किसी की नज़र में आए बिना — चुपचाप अपना काम करते रहना
definition: moving quietly without attracting official attention, avoiding notice while continuing whatever interests you
example: Their little terrace library ran under the radar for years, lending paperbacks to half the street without a single sign.

hindi: मेज़ के नीचे से — चोरी-छिपे लेन-देन
definition: arranged secretly through hidden payment, avoiding records, taxes, honest official permission
example: The clerk suggested settling things under the table, and Papa stood, thanked him politely, and joined the longer queue.

hindi: तबीयत नासाज़ होना — हल्की सी बीमारी
definition: feeling slightly unwell with minor temporary sickness, usually needing rest rather than medicine
example: She was under the weather all Sunday, so we moved the picnic and sent soup instead.

hindi: बाल-बाल बचना — समय सीमा से ठीक पहले पहुँच जाना
definition: finished barely before the deadline, arriving during the last permitted moment
example: Her application slid under the wire at the post office counter, the clerk stamping it while already reaching for his coat.

hindi: गुप्त रखा हुआ — समय आने तक सबसे छिपाकर
definition: kept completely secret from outsiders, hidden carefully until some chosen moment permits wider public knowledge
example: The bakery kept the wedding cake under wraps for three days, curtains drawn against the neighbours.

hindi: मुट्ठी में होना — किसी के पूरे दबाव में रहना
definition: forced to obey another person, following their wishes without visible protest
example: The whole cricket team was under the captain's thumb until a quiet spinner finally suggested a different field.

hindi: मौक़ा पहचान लेना — बिना बताए ठीक वैसा ही कर देना
definition: deliver exactly whatever the occasion demanded, judging clothing, timing, effort perfectly without instruction
example: Everybody else wore black, while Priya arrived embroidered head to toe and clearly understood the assignment.

hindi: बेवक़्त — अजीब सा असुविधाजनक समय
definition: inconvenient hours, unreasonably early morning timing which nobody willingly chooses
example: The flight left at some ungodly hour, so her brother drove through empty streets with flasks of tea beside him.

hindi: कठिन दौर में — भारी दबाव से जूझना
definition: facing difficult pressure with slender resources, position straining under overwhelming demands
example: With rain flooding the courtyard and guests arriving, her mother was truly up against it, yet somehow served everybody lunch.

hindi: बिफरे हुए — नाराज़गी में एकजुट
definition: loudly furious about some decision, protesting together with shared indignant anger
example: The whole colony was up in arms over the felled neem tree, and by evening they had planted three saplings.

hindi: अधर में लटका होना — कोई बात तय नहीं हुई
definition: still completely undecided and unsettled, waiting without any firm decision being reached
example: The picnic date stayed up in the air until Meera printed a calendar and made everyone circle a Sunday.

hindi: बोरिया-बिस्तर बाँधना — अचानक घर बदल लेना
definition: move your household suddenly elsewhere, abandoning settled arrangements without preparation (British usage)
example: One rainy Tuesday they upped sticks for the coast, leaving behind curtains, a garden gnome and a very confused milkman.

hindi: दाँव बढ़ाना — शर्त और जोखिम ऊँचा कर देना
definition: increase whatever everyone must risk, forcing rivals toward larger commitment or quiet retreat
example: When the neighbours offered free tuition alongside the flat, the other landlord upped the ante with a scooter parking spot.

hindi: बीच मँझधार में फँसना — बिना किसी सहारे संकट में
definition: stranded within serious trouble without rescue, where damaging consequences already appear unavoidable and worsening
example: The ferry left without them and the last bus had gone, leaving both cousins properly up the creek by nightfall.

term: up to your eyeballs in debt
hindi: कर्ज़ में डूबा होना — गले तक कर्ज़ में
definition: owing enormous debt, borrowed well beyond any realistic hope of orderly repayment
example: They were up to their eyeballs in debt, yet the shop stayed open because neighbours kept turning up.

hindi: चढ़ाई की लड़ाई — हर कदम पर विरोध झेलती कोशिश
definition: prolonged struggle against constant resistance, demanding heavy effort while progress remains slow, difficult, uncertain
example: Getting the neighbourhood library reopened was an uphill battle, three years of petitions before anybody unlocked the door.

hindi: पलड़ा भारी होना — बढ़त हासिल कर लेना
definition: holding decisive control over rivals, deciding matters while others merely follow
example: By the fourth over the bowler clearly had the upper hand, and the batsmen stopped attempting anything clever.

hindi: अब अपनी बारी — दूसरों को खुश करना छोड़कर खुद को चुनने का दौर
definition: deliberate phase choosing yourself first, refusing constant people-pleasing that earlier exhausted everybody
example: After years of covering everyone's shifts she declared her villain era and left work at six, guiltless, phone silenced.

hindi: जंगल में पुकार — अनसुनी चेतावनी
definition: sensible warning that listeners entirely ignore, leaving honest speaker feeling unheard
example: For years she was a voice in the wilderness about the cracked staircase, until it finally proved her right.

hindi: परदे के पीछे तैयार खड़े रहना — बुलावे के क्षण की प्रतीक्षा करना
definition: stay ready and unseen, waiting patiently until the moment arrives to step forward and take action
example: Her younger brother waited in the wings all evening, holding the guitar nobody had asked him to bring.

hindi: मेज़ छोड़ देना — बातचीत बीच में ही खत्म
definition: abandoning further discussion, argument, bargaining deliberately rather than continuing pointless engagement
example: After the third rewritten promise he walked away from the table, thanked everybody sincerely, and drove home relieved.

hindi: मंडप तक जाना — विवाह करना
definition: marry your partner during a formal ceremony, publicly promising lifelong commitment
example: Her father practised the slow walk down the aisle every morning for a week.

hindi: चुटकियों का काम — बिना मेहनत हो जाने वाला
definition: activity handled easily, pleasantly, without effort, strain, trouble, remaining simple, gentle, undemanding
example: He had trained on steep hills all summer, so the flat coastal race felt like a walk in the park.

hindi: फूँक-फूँक कर कदम रखना — किसी के गुस्से के डर से सँभलकर रहना
definition: behave with anxious caution around someone, avoiding words that might trigger angry confrontation
example: The whole house walked on eggshells the week before results, speaking only about weather and vegetables.

hindi: रस्सी पर चलना — ज़रा चूके तो गिरना
definition: managing risky delicate balance where smallest careless mistake would bring immediate disaster
example: Between his mother's opinions and his wife's patience he was walking a tightrope, and holding it rather gracefully.

hindi: पैर ज़मीन पर न पड़ना — ख़ुशी में उड़ते रहना
definition: delighted beyond measure, moving through ordinary chores lightly because happiness carries you
example: He swept the courtyard singing, walking on air since the phone call about the scholarship.

hindi: दिल गदगद होना — भीतर तक गर्माहट
definition: soothing comfortable feeling of warmth, sentimental cosy contentment spreading gently through your chest
example: The old photographs left everybody warm and fuzzy, until somebody produced the one with the terrible haircuts.

hindi: हाथ धो लेना — ज़िम्मेदारी छोड़ देना
definition: abandoning further responsibility completely, declaring somebody's troubles no longer your involvement
example: After the second postponement, Uncle washed his hands of the whole renovation and took up gardening instead.

hindi: पाई-पाई का हिसाब रखना — सोच-समझकर खर्च करना
definition: spend money carefully, checking every small amount before parting with anything from your purse
example: Dad watched the pennies at the market, then bought us all ice cream without blinking.

hindi: पानी पर से बूँद — असर ही नहीं होता
definition: criticism that leaves personal calm untouched, ignored instead of causing lasting distress
example: The comments about his cooking were water off a duck's back, and Vikram served second helpings to everybody anyway.

hindi: बीती बात — जो हो गया सो हो गया
definition: a past grievance nobody feels resentment about anymore, forgotten completely and no longer worth arguing
example: The argument about the wedding seating chart is water under the bridge now that the grandchildren have arrived.

hindi: सफ़ेद झंडा दिखाना — खुलेआम हथियार डालकर हार मान लेना
definition: to abandon resistance openly and signal defeat, inviting the other side to stop attacking
example: Two hours into the argument about the thermostat, Amma waved the white flag and fetched a blanket.

hindi: घर की बागडोर संभालना — घर में असली अधिकार रखना
definition: hold decisive authority within a household, controlling important family decisions alone
example: He joked about wearing the trousers, then checked with his wife before agreeing to sell the farmhouse.

term: wear your heart on your sleeve
hindi: दिल का हाल चेहरे पर — भावनाएँ छिपा न पाना
definition: showing private feelings openly, letting everyone notice affection, sadness, disappointment
example: Ravi wore his heart on his sleeve at the airport, weeping happily while everyone else pretended composure.

hindi: तूफ़ान झेल जाना — मुश्किल दौर में डटे रहकर उसे पार कर लेना
definition: survive a stretch of severe difficulty by continuing steadily until the pressure passes
example: The bakery lost half its customers that winter, and they weathered the storm on soup and stubbornness.

hindi: सिर से बोझ उतरना — बड़ी ज़िम्मेदारी हटने की राहत
definition: relief felt when heavy blame or obligation lifts, released from burden, finally free
