example: Handing over the last instalment on the loan was a weight off her shoulders, and she walked home the long way for once.

hindi: बाँहें फैलाकर स्वागत — पूरे मन से अपनाना
definition: greet arriving somebody with generous warmth, showing complete gladness that they belong comfortably here
example: The village welcomed the returning nurse with open arms, and three households fought politely over who would feed her first.

hindi: निहाल होना — दिल से ख़ुश
definition: delighted in northern British usage, genuinely pleased about welcome news somebody delivers
example: He rang round every cousin, well made up about the apprenticeship, before telling anybody the wages.

hindi: चढ़ा हुआ — पीकर खुलकर बातें करने वाला
definition: pleasantly drunk in Irish and British usage, loosened and talkative after steady drinking
example: By the second round of songs the quietest guest was well oiled and telling stories nobody had heard in twenty years.

hindi: तेल पिलाई मशीन — बिना रुकावट चलता इंतज़ाम
definition: group working smoothly and efficiently, every person handling their portion without friction
example: By the third morning the kitchen ran like a well-oiled machine, aunts chopping while cousins carried plates outside.

hindi: रंग में भंग डालने वाला — महफ़िल का मज़ा किरकिरा करने वाला
definition: gloomy companion dampening everybody's enthusiasm, spoiling cheerful gatherings with constant discouraging remarks
example: Being called a wet blanket stung, so he learned two card games before the next family holiday.

hindi: गाड़ी बिखर जाना — सब कुछ अचानक ढह जाना
definition: carefully arranged plans collapsing suddenly, losing control while trouble spreads through everything remaining
example: The wheels came off their little bakery when both ovens failed together, though regulars queued anyway for yesterday's bread.

hindi: जब सूरज पश्चिम से उगेगा — कभी नहीं होने वाला
definition: impossible, never happening however long anybody keeps waiting hopefully
example: He said he would learn cooking when pigs fly, and last month sent photographs of surprisingly respectable parathas.

hindi: मुसीबत की घड़ी में — असली परीक्षा के वक़्त
definition: during difficult moments when serious trouble arrives and somebody's character becomes clearly visible
example: When the chips were down after the shop fire, the quietest tenant appeared with buckets before anybody thought to call.

hindi: चेहरा सफ़ेद पड़ जाना — डर से रंग उड़ जाना
definition: drained pallid appearance following sudden fright, leaving somebody looking bloodless from unexpected shock
example: She came inside white as a sheet after the ladder slipped, and her father made her sit until colour returned.

hindi: सफ़ेद हाथी — जिसका खर्च फ़ायदे से ज़्यादा
definition: expensive useless possession costing more upkeep than benefit, embarrassing whoever owns something unwanted
example: The gifted piano became a white elephant until the youngest daughter decided, aged nine, that she would learn.

hindi: सफ़ेद झूठ — किसी का दिल रखने को बोला गया छोटा-सा झूठ
definition: harmless untruth told mainly to spare someone awkward feelings about something
example: He told a white lie about loving the sweater his aunt knitted.

hindi: जान हथेली पर — डर से मुट्ठी भींच लेना
definition: terrifying tense experience gripping somebody with fright throughout, although ending safely afterwards
example: The night bus down the ghat road was a white-knuckle ride, and everyone applauded the driver at dawn.

hindi: पूरा का पूरा — कुछ भी छोड़े बिना
definition: the entire extent of something, every trimming included rather than some partial version
example: For the wedding they wanted the whole nine yards, right down to marigold ropes across the terrace.

hindi: आकाश-कुसुम तोड़ना — असंभव के पीछे व्यर्थ भागना
definition: pointless effort pursuing something impossible to catch, wasting hours finding nothing
example: Four shops and one bus ride later, the hunt for cardamom ice cream turned into a wild goose chase.

hindi: चिढ़ाना — जान-बूझकर छेड़कर परेशान करना
definition: tease somebody deliberately until they become annoyed, British usage, joking because their reaction seems entertaining
example: His cousins wound him up about supporting the losing team, and he defended them loudly through the entire journey.

hindi: ऊपरी लीपापोती — सिर्फ़ दिखावे का सुधार
definition: attractive surface changes covering the absence of real substance beneath, arranged purely for appearances
example: They painted the school gate before the inspection, pure window dressing, while the roof still leaked over the library.

hindi: बिना तैयारी काम चला लेना — मौके पर सूझ से
definition: proceed without preparation confidently, improvising every answer while pretending careful readiness
example: He had read only three pages, so he winged it through the viva and somehow charmed the examiner.

hindi: जीत का सिलसिला — लगातार कामयाबी का दौर
definition: unbroken sequence of successes arriving together, making everything suddenly feel almost effortless
example: Their winning streak ended against the mechanics' team, and the boys still walked home sharing sugarcane juice like champions.

hindi: धूल में मिला देना — पूरी तरह हरा देना
definition: defeat rivals utterly in a contest, leaving them without answer or excuse
example: The junior team wiped the floor with last year's champions and nobody stopped cheering.

hindi: पुराना हिसाब मिटा देना — बीती बातें भुलाकर नई शुरुआत करना
definition: forget every past grievance completely and begin the relationship again without resentment or scorekeeping
example: On his first day back, the coach wiped the slate clean and handed him the captain's armband.

hindi: आधी रात का पहर — बेचैन अजीब घड़ी
definition: eerie midnight hours, restless period when children wake before morning, everybody feels strange
example: During the witching hour the youngest padded downstairs claiming shadows, and his mother sat reading beside him until dawn.

hindi: भारी मन से — दुख के साथ
definition: acting while feeling deep sadness, continuing reluctantly despite genuine private sorrow
example: With a heavy heart she locked the shutters her father had painted, keeping only the brass handle.

hindi: आँखें मूँदे हुए — पूरे आत्मविश्वास से
definition: managing something easily, confidently, without thinking, effort, hesitation, thanks toward thorough familiar practice
example: He walked the dark corridor toward the boiler room with his eyes closed, counting doors from memory.

hindi: बेल पर ही सूख जाना — बिना इस्तेमाल खत्म होना
definition: fade slowly through neglect, dying unused while nobody offers necessary support
example: The music room plan withered on the vine until one retired teacher quietly carried her harmonium there.

hindi: बिना किसी अड़चन के — निर्विघ्न
definition: completed smoothly from start until finish, without trouble, delay, problems, interruption, anything failing
example: Three hundred guests, monsoon clouds overhead, and the wedding still went off without a hitch.

hindi: बिना पतवार की नाव — दिशाहीन
definition: operating without leadership, direction, nobody steering while everything simply drifts along
example: The neighbourhood committee ran without a rudder for two monsoons, so the tank repairs waited while everybody blamed somebody else.

hindi: भेड़ की खाल में भेड़िया — साधु वेश में ठग
definition: dangerous person appearing harmless, hiding hostile intentions behind gentle friendly outward behaviour
example: The polite man selling insurance door to door was a wolf in sheep's clothing, and half the lane learned that slowly.

hindi: दूर पहाड़ी देहात — शहर से कोसों दूर
definition: somewhere extremely remote in New Zealand usage, distant countryside holding almost nothing commercial
example: Their bach stands out in the wop-wops, so visitors bring bread, batteries, and every conversation they have saved.

hindi: गधे की तरह खटना — बिना आराम लगातार मेहनत
definition: labouring exhaustingly through long hours, finishing heavy tasks without proper rest
example: He worked like a dog through the festival season, and his wife hid one afternoon from him by unplugging the doorbell.

hindi: बैल की तरह खटना — अथक मेहनत करना
definition: labour tirelessly through punishing hours, showing stamina other people quietly admire
example: The young cook worked like a Trojan through the feast, and the elders noticed, sending sweets to his mother afterwards.

term: work your fingers to the bone
hindi: हाड़ तोड़ मेहनत करना — थककर चूर हो जाने तक काम करना
definition: labouring through long punishing hours until exhausting effort leaves your body aching
example: Grandmother worked her fingers to the bone stitching quilts so the four of us could finish school.

hindi: टूटा-फूटा हाल — थका और घिसा हुआ
definition: tired and battered after strain, exhausted, with energy and freshness noticeably reduced
example: The team returned from the trek somewhat worse for wear, boots muddy and spirits high.

hindi: नमक-हलाल — अपने काम में खरा उतरने वाला
definition: deserving respect through proven practical experience, handling difficult work exactly as promised
example: A tailor worth your salt will measure twice before touching the wedding sherwani.

hindi: बात दिमाग़ में बैठाना — उलझी चीज़ समझ पाना
definition: understand something complicated after considerable mental effort, finally grasping confusing information
example: It took two cups of coffee before she could wrap her head around the electricity bill, which included somebody else's flat.

hindi: उँगलियों पर नचाना — किसी को अपनी मर्ज़ी से चलाना
definition: charmed into helpless obedience, ready to obey another person, granting their wishes without protest
example: Their granddaughter had the entire household wrapped around her finger before she could even walk properly.

hindi: रूई में लपेटकर रखना — दुख से बचाकर पालना
definition: sheltered from hardship and difficulty, protected until ordinary trouble becomes overwhelming
example: His parents never let him cycle past the gate, and at twenty he still felt wrapped in cotton wool whenever a train timetable confused him.

hindi: साफ़ चेतावनी — अंजाम पहले दिख जाना
definition: unmistakable warning signals showing trouble approaching, understood before other people accept them
example: The shutters stayed closed until noon three days running, and regular customers quietly read the writing on the wall.

hindi: निचोड़े कपड़े जैसा — पूरी ताक़त निकल चुकी
definition: completely exhausted, every trace of energy squeezed away after weeks without proper rest
example: He arrived wrung out from three weeks of night shifts, and his brother simply cooked without asking questions.

hindi: बीती बात — जिसकी चर्चा ख़त्म हो गई
definition: outdated, forgotten quickly because everybody stopped discussing this months earlier
example: The scandal that shook their lane became yesterday's news the moment a film crew started shooting near the temple.

hindi: बात हम दोनों तक — किसी तीसरे तक नहीं
definition: strictly confidential between speakers only, British phrase promising secret travels nowhere further
example: Between you, me and the gatepost, the caterer never arrived and they ordered chips instead.

hindi: ज़ुबान पर ताला — कुछ न कहना
definition: sealing your mouth shut, keeping news secret and telling nobody what actually happened
example: The twins zipped their lips about the broken vase, though their guilty faces gave everything away.
